364354.name: 魔女の一撃宅配便 (Witch's Shot Delivery Service)

364679.name: USPS: The Great American Mail Race

364994.description: Flags of all colors dance in the wind as Navirians converge to Trawl for the long-awaited Banner Festival. Generate the most profits for your trading house by selling goods, befriending the right suppliers, and making bets at the watercraft race. Opportunities abound in the floating market, but only the keenest trader will prevail! Each turn, aim to play the highest, mid, or lowest Merchandise card to unlock different actions. Utilize multi-use cards in dynamic trick-taking bouts to gain an advantage over your rival merchants. There are numerous paths to victory, but reading your opponents…
364994.name: Tidal Blades: Banner Festival

365513.description: Roar The Card Game puts you in charge of your very own dinosaur park. In this 2-4 player game you will compete against other players to build the best dinosaur park over the Cretaceous, Jurassic, and Triassic periods. But watch out an extinction event can disrupt your plans at any moment, and dinosaurs running around outside of your park are bad business. —description from the designer
365513.name: Roar: The Card Game

365555.name: Naasii: A Coyote & Crow Dice Game

365742.description: Bacon is a fixed-partnerships climbing game for 4 or 6 players that is all about going out early as a team. The only team that will score is the team that goes out first, but their score will depend on when the rest of the team goes out. If your team does NOT go out first, your job is simple: make the other team go out as late as possible. The rules also include the Applewood variant for 3 to 6 players: this is the no-partnerships version of Bacon. There are no teams; it’s every person for themselves. Your score will depend solely on the position you go out so go out early.
365742.name: Bacon

366351.description: Explosion in the Laboratory is a push-your-luck 27 card game where you mix chemicals to create valuable compounds and try not to cause a major explosion! Set in the Fire in the Library universe, it has the same press your luck and strategy from the base game, but in a small portable science-y version! In Explosion in the Laboratory, you are all chemists mixing compounds in an experimental laboratory. Caution! Being careless could cause disaster. A fire would be unfortunate, as there is a library not too far away. During the game players will take turns trying to score points by following a…
366351.name: Explosion in the Laboratory

366458.description: Short Zoot Suit is a trick-taking game that exists in the land of Bollywoods, or Bear Hollywood. The bears are out tonight, looking good, but making sure their suits aren't too short! Players try to balance the number of tricks they win with the number of times they played off-suit, or short-suit. At the start of the hand, players create a personal draw deck out of some of the cards they are dealt. Drawing from this deck can help players manipulate their hands for later play and short-suiting. The game ends when any player is out of cards, allowing for player-defined hand lengths.…
366458.name: Short Zoot Suit

36790.description: The players are pickpockets in a bar. The aim of the game is to leave the bar as rich as possible. A round starts by turning a card. On this card you see a number of lines (maximum 4). The players have to decide to leave the bar with the current earnings or to turn a new card. When they turn a card there is a risk of being thrown out of the bar if all the lines on the cards are broken. As long as there is one line that starts on the first card and ends on the last card without any interruptions in between they can stay in the bar to continue stealing. You can also turn a card that shows a…
36790.name: Pickpocket

368243.description: Once upon a time dodos were living carefree in the realm of Draghan. Especially the little dragons saw the funny birds as cuties, but everything changed when the Dutchmen arrived. With their ships they brought many animals that neither the dragons nor the dodos had set their eyes on before: rats, dogs, pigs... All these creatures hunted the dodos and ransacked their eggs. Unworldly and peaceful in mind, the dodos hadn’t been able to stand their ground against these reckless invaders. Can you help the dodos to hatch as many eggs as possible and save them from extinction? 'O Dodo!' is a push…
368243.name: World of Draghan: O Dodo!

368359.description: A light and very quick shedding game for two with an ordinary deck of cards. Players take turns exchanging cards with the deck to improve their seven card hand. But, in a game of chicken, either player can jump-start things by “running” and starting the race to play combos to shed all their cards. part of the "two-player triology" of climbing games: Eat or Run, Hedges, Tuhao.
368359.name: Eat or Run

368794.name: #GuiltyFoodTricks
publishers: AaAaAaGames (アーアーアーゲームズ)

369082.name: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre Board Game

369084.description: Tatsu is a trick-taking card game for 2 to 4 players in which you capture spirits to earn points by playing cards from your hand, while sometimes choosing when your opponent plays for you. Carefully choose when to play your strongest cards and when to press your luck with fusion cards to collect even more cards from your opponent. You and your opponent have the same decks, though, and they can fight back just as hard as you, so always think two steps ahead in order to claim the most cards and (most importantly) your opponent's multiplier spirits. Spirits are divided into two distinct clans:…
369084.name: Tatsu

369509.description: It's nighttime in the kingdom of Owlberta and the Knight Owls are standing guard — but five in the morning was never the best time to defend anything really, and they're all falling asleep. Can you allow enough of your Knight Owls to take a quick snooze, while not fully abandoning your post? Of What's Left is an "almost-shedding"/climbing game in which the moment one player sheds out, the other players score points based on the number of cards left in their hands. The fewer cards, the more points, so get as close to shedding as possible without doing so!
369509.name: Of What's Left

369806.name: Clank!: Catacombs – Dusty Map Promo Card

370325.description: Celebrate the fifth anniversary of Claim with a special limited Claim Anniversary Edition. In this edition, the factions that were released in Claim and Claim 2 are re-illustrated by five different illustrators, each with their own style. Next to these factions, the Anniversary Edition contains seven new factions: Automatons, Farmers, Folk Singers, Griffins, Racoons, Royals, and Vikings. This package also has four new scenario cards, S18 - S21. —description from the publisher
370325.name: Claim Anniversary Edition

370598.description: Trailblazers are the gutsy folks who pave and brave the trails of the great outdoors. Whether by hiking boots, cycling wheels, or river paddle, these tenacious travelers seek to feed their insatiable appetite for adventure. With a scenic wilderness ever ahead and a freshly charted path upon the heels, one mustn’t forget to eventually find their way back to camp. For there are always new environments to explore, further expeditions to undertake, and more trails to blaze. In Trailblazers, players compete to earn the most points by building biking, hiking, and kayaking loops from their campsites…
370598.name: Trailblazers: Travel Edition

370837.description: Curses & Covens is an all vs one game where one player takes on the role as the witch hunter, while all other players are towns trying to protect the friendly witches! The aim of the witch hunter is to capture 5 witches, while the towns want to form a coven of three witches of the same suit in one player's hand to win. The game plays through four main phases. These phases repeat until one side has won. Census, where all the towns’ cards are revealed. These will be a mix of witches, innocent villagers, rituals or a fake witch (scarecrow). Players win if they have 3 cards of 1 witch suit in 1…
370837.name: Curses & Covens

370911.description: This is a period of turmoil in the Quack-Quack dynasty. The corrupt officials who took over government power are eager to exploit, and the seeds of the revolution are sprouting among the people who are aware of the contradictions of the status system. Your goal is to survive this chaotic time. To do that, you have to trample on others and accumulate wealth. Sometimes be a corrupt official and rob the lower classes, sometimes be a secret royal inspector and punish the corrupt officials, and sometimes participate in revolutions that will overturn the world. The core system of the game is ladder…
370911.name: Quack-Quack, Corrupt Ducks

370979.description: Hero or Villain: Battle Royale –The Card Game- is a fast-paced game where you and your friends trade blows as super-powered individuals. Aside from combat elimination, the game also has social deduction and Russian-roulette mechanisms that will ensure only one is left alive by the time players go through one entire deck. The game is designed for 2 to 5 players, and takes 10 – 15 minutes to play. On your turn, you can play any number of power cards to influence the game, or try to attack other players to eliminate them. Players may verbally challenge you if they feel your character does not…
370979.name: Hero or Villain: Battle Royale – The Card Game

372573.name: Race to the Raft: Kickstarter Pack

372743.name: The Hunger: Alternate Starting Deck Promo

372882.description: So it begins… …the annual Gulyás Festival! Everything is ready for the year’s most prestigious event to be successful. Big cauldron. Quality ingredients. Awesome vibe. What could be missing? You probably got it by now... Yes, You! The famous Gulyás Masters. As soon as it turned out that you’ll be cooking the main course, many Gourmets and Locals flocked around the fire to see what you are up to. Their expectations are high and very much different. You will really have to get it together to impress these guys! And you will have to pay attention whether it is a critical kitty or a seasoned chef…
372882.name: Gulyás

373243.description: Slamapalooza is a fast-playing card game simulating a one-on-one pro wrestling match. Players use Basic Move Cards to create chains of attacks. Each move alters the stats: Stun, Control, or Potential to set up the next move. If played strategically, you can avoid a major reversal from your enemy. Use deception, luck, or physical challenges to raise the stakes at any time with Psychology Cards! Unlock your Signature Move by completing its unique Signature Sequence of Basic Move Types. Every time you pull off a Signature Move you go for the pin and might just win! —description from the designer
373243.name: Slamapalooza

373435.description: As a Mayan priest in Prophecy, your role is to interpret the cycles of creation and destruction on the different calendars. Make the most accurate prophecies to become the one and only Grand Priest. Sacrifice cards and try to win the corresponding tricks to prove your worth.
373435.name: Prophecy

373488.description: Pins & Needles is a climbing/shedding game for 2 to 3 players using 2 to 3 sets of double six dominoes. Your goal is to shed out all your tiles. The unique twist to this game is that you can climb up or down the ranks depending on the combination lead to the play. Each player gets a double blank tile, which is a wild tile, to offer flexibility. When you shed out, for each opponent with 5 or more tiles in their hands, you score bonus points. Therefore, you must skillfully shed out all your tiles while also denying others from getting bonus points. This game is inspired by Sean Ross’s domino…
373488.name: Pins & Needles

37380.name: Roll Through the Ages: The Bronze Age

373856.description: Cards have 2 letters on one side and 2 topics on the other (unrelated by theme but related through whimsical wordplay). Each round, 2 letters and 2 topics are simultaneously revealed, and then everyone has a minute to write as many words as they want, starting with either letter and relating (even tangentially) to either topic. After the minute, everyone reveals their answers and scores for how many they match with other players. Match 1 word for 1pt, 2 words for 2pts, 3 words for 4pts! If you match more than 3 words, you 'bust' and score nothing. Play 6, 10, or 15 rounds for a short, medium,…
373856.name: A Game About Writing Words, Aiming to Match Other Folk Exactly 3 Times.

373921.description: Set in the legendary science fiction universe of the Traveller roleplaying game, To Honor Grandfather lets players take on the role of young aliens (Droyne) competing to gain the favor of their leader (Grandfather). Using the custom dice, players will travel between a variety of unique planetary systems and engage with a huge selection of events, each with the potential to draw Grandfather's approving eye. Those with the most "honor" after all planets have been explored will be dubbed the victor! —description from the publisher
373921.name: To Honor Grandfather

374018.description: In ピンコンビトリオ (Pin Combi Trio), you want all the comedians in your hand to get time on the stage first before anyone else. Each player starts with a hand of cards from a deck numbered 1-80, and if you lead the round, you can play: • A single card (pin) • Two consecutive cards (combi) • Three cards that differ by the same amount, e.g., 2-4-6 or 1-11-21 (trio) Whatever you play, the next person has to play the same number of cards with their highest number being higher than yours or pass. Once all but one person has passed, clear the cards and start a new round. Whoever plays all their cards…
374018.name: ピンコンビトリオ (Pin Combi Trio)

374024.description: Fives is a trick-taking game for three or four players. The reverse side of the cards shows a magenta 5. The game is a must-follow game, with a fixed trump suit. In general, if you can follow suit you must, but in many cases you can play one of your cards face down as a magenta 5. However, only one magenta 5 may appear in any trick. The winner of the trick takes all cards played to the trick, with their card on top. At the end of the hand, points will be lost by any player whose top cards sum to more than 25, and points will be won for those whose cards sum to 25 or less, with the most points…
374024.name: Fives

374026.description: OPEN is a climbing and shedding game in which each person plays with four of their six cards face up on the table. At the start of each hand, players make a secret bet on which player they think will play all of their cards first. Points are awarded to all players but the last to go out. Points are also awarded to players who accurately predicted who would go out first. Rounds are played until one player reaches a given score, then the player with the most points wins.
374026.name: OPEN

374336.name: Trick Raiders
publishers: Southern Cross Games (サザンクロスゲームズ)

374461.description: Collect matter from the far corners of the Galaxy and fill the Wormhole at the centre before the ever increasing Voids consume the board! Play solo, as a team or in competitive mode to collect cards and bridge, boost and warp your way to victory. A good memory will help you find the cards you need, but with a limited hand, will you play it safe or push your luck? The more cards you play, the more Voids appear...so choose your path wisely! —description from the designer
374461.name: Voids: Memory Meets Matter

374487.description: In Only One Collection, players are collecting cards hoping to have the most of each type, and the player on their right to have the second most! On their turn a player can either add a card from the deck to a set on the table or take a set. A player cannot add a duplicate number to a set. The game ends when a certain card is revealed in the deck. Then, the player who has the most cards of each number earns 1 point and then earns 1 point per card of those numbers held by the player on their right. The person with the most points wins.
374487.name: Only One Collection

374594.description: There's work to be done in the fairy-tale kingdom, from transporting golden eggs to unblocking elven sewers. Can you assemble the best team of wizards for each job? You play as magical agents who are recruiting wizards as they walk into the local fairytale gathering-house looking for work. Chris invented and drew twenty-one original wizards - from Hercule the Impressive, master of mechanical magic to Small Norman, who is fairly good at not causing trouble. There's also a host of clients offering all sorts of gigs - your wizards might end up doing maze-building work for a Minotaur, putting in…
374594.name: Wizard Work

374866.description: A 3-player trick-taking game with a must-follow trump card, but there's a 4th player (a robot: 'Robo' in play). Suits are 1 to 13 in 4 colors. Robo will play cards according to their program, so it depends on their program whether to play small and large number cards when following suit. You can win up to 3 tricks out of 12 tricks, but if you win 4 tricks or more, you lose points.
374866.name: Robotrick

375151.description: EHCG is mainly deck construction, dice rolling and role playing strategy game set in world of ice hockey. Your task as a manager of ice hockey club is to pick your coach and lineup of 12 players, assign the role for each player, choose the tactics, and lead your team to the victory. Each player chooses unique situational cards, which can be used throughout the game. During the match, you have to guide your players in different situations from the faceoff to shot. Significant part of the game are 1v1 battles of players, where your preparation and skill can truly shine. If you are successful,…
375151.name: Elite hockey card game

376905.description: The year is 1954. The Algerian people are rising up against French colonizers who have oppressed them for over a century. But this is no regular war - victory will not be achieved on the battlefield, but by winning the hearts and minds of everyday Algerians. Insurgent: Algeria is a simple, asymmetric card game for 1 to 2 players which recreates the Algerian War for independence on your tabletop. Players take the role of the French government and the Algerian resistance [the FLN], which have separate faction decks with unique abilities. The game can be won in two ways - attrition and…
376905.name: Insurgent: Algeria

378040.description: 1% - A game of Strategic Chance! All you have to do to win is roll 0 with two 10-sided dice. Sounds easy? The chance is 1%! 1% is a fast and fun card game of strategy and probability, with a touch of misdirection! If you can outlast your opponents, you’ll be rewarded with a choice: Do you roll the dice and try to win? Or do you sacrifice this turn to increase your chances next time? If there is a next time, that is! Take too long, and another player could snatch victory away from you. —description from the publisher
378040.name: 1%: A Game of Strategic Chance

378255.description: In Unyielding Universe, 2-4 players attempt to make long and beautiful lifelines. They achieve this by drawing "Year" cards and then placing them within their lifeline chronologically, either by adding them at the end or replacing them. All the while the Universe will try to make their lives more challenging and complex. "Universe" cards that add a scoring adjustment or a gameplay modifier will be drawn, or "Life Complete" cards will be drawn and wreak havoc on your lifeline, not allowing you to play cards past a certain age. The goal is to score the most points at the end of the round.…
378255.name: Unyielding Universe

379102.name: Lock & Spell: A Game of Fortunes

379108.description: Speedy Delivery is a climbing game with a courier theme. In Speedy Delivery, each round one of four players will take on the role of a courier, attempting to deliver (shed out) their entire hand of cards before the other three players can prevent it from happening by shedding out first. Each round, players bid to determine who will be the Courier and who will be the Obstacles. The play is standard ladder climbing play, familiar to anyone who has played Tichu, Haggis, Chimera, or many traditional climbing games. One player leads with a card combination. Other players must follow with a higher…
379108.name: Speedy Delivery

379802.description: Welcome to Pairadice City, where the ground is overflowing with treasure ready to be found. You're racing to be the first to uncover as many treasures as possible all while avoiding any perils and dealing with the antics of your fellow miners! Will you sell treasures you've found to fund future expeditions and stall your race to the finish? Or will you keep them, push on deeper into the mines and risk losing it all to secure your victory? —description from the designer
379802.name: Undermined! Pairadice City

381249.description: Snow White, The Little Mermaid, Cinderella, and many other fairy tale princesses are celebrating a five-day party. The prince charmings, who have not been invited, will try to infiltrate the ball to propose marriage to the girls. As a princess, you have to avoid marriage proposals and remain single and independent after the celebrations. Rebel Princess takes place over five rounds, representing the five days of a party, and each round has a special rule that makes each game totally different. The general mechanisms are those of trick-taking games, in which each player plays a numbered card…
381249.name: Rebel Princess

381278.description: Many years after the confrontation with Van Helsing, Dracula landed in Whitby, England once again. The citizens of Whitby sought help from the vampire hunter, Professor Van Helsing. Will Van Helsing defeat Dracula before he transforms all the inhabitants into vampires? In Dracula vs Van Helsing, each player controls one of the title characters. Van Helsing must remove all of Dracula's life points to win, but if Dracula turns all four inhabitants of the same district into vampires first, Dracula wins. The game lasts at most five rounds. Each round, players play in turn (starting with Dracula),…
381278.name: Dracula vs Van Helsing

381833.description: Angry Raccoons is an exciting board game designed for 2-5 players, aged 10 and above. In this game, players take on the role of Hillbillies, with the objective of becoming the king of their beloved trailer par k by defeating their neighbors. To battle raccoons and other Hillbillies, players roll dice, aiming to win 2 out of 3 rounds. Each Hillbilly has special powers that can modify the outcome of their rolls, and all players have access to liquor cards that can alter the outcome of a round. With its simple mechanics and sudden twists, Angry Raccoons is easy to learn and provides a fun and…
381833.name: Angry Raccoons

382054.description: Woodland Wizards is a competitive card game where players assume the role of animal magicians and summon contest creatures to compete in rounds consisting of preparation, tournament, and evaluation. Each card has a value and effect that can be used to strengthen the player's own creature or weaken those of others. The winner of each round scores their summoned creature, and the player with the most points at the end of all contests wins. With no setup time, few rules, and a little bit of meanness, this game is quick to learn and fun for 2–6 players. In Woodland Wizards you start each…
382054.name: Woodland Wizards

382958.description: in Les Toits de Paris, you are one of the Magpies, a legendary gang of thieves who thrive on the roofs of Paris. At dawn, the Magpies fly from building to building, break into the most beautiful apartments of the City of Light, and vie to be the most daring to steal valuables and works of art. The more valuables of the same type a Magpie owns, the most prestigious it is in the gang. Watch out for Detective Nightingale though, and know that he won’t be your only opponent – the other Magpies will also try to have their go at you! Player turn is divided in two phases: Stealing phase and sharing…
382958.name: Les Toits de Paris

383201.description: Exploding Kittens is a highly-strategic, kitty powered version of Russian Roulette. Players draw cards until somebody draws an Exploding Kitten, at which point they explode and are out of the game. To avoid exploding, they can defuse the kitten with a laser pointer or catnip sandwich, OR use powerful action cards to move or avoid the Exploding Kitten. In this edition, you can also use the squishy Cat Burglar figure to steal cards from opponents. But be careful! Being a great burglar also makes you a great target! Cat Burglar is not compatible with non-English Versions of Exploding Kittens and…
383201.name: Exploding Kittens: Cat Burglar Edition

383412.description: Get rid of your hand quickly and win with an exhilarating feeling that can only be experienced in this game! Pass to forcibly draw one card from the top of the deck (6 cards), to increase the strength of your hand, and play 'plus' and wild cards to increase the strength of your melds. In addition, the charming characters and horror-themed worldview drawn by Sai Beppu is a must-see!
383412.name: Brokies

383450.description: Pies is a quick and tasty trick-taking game in which players play fruit cards over the course of three rounds with the goal of collecting combinations of ingredients to prepare the tastiest pies Each round consists of six tricks (five in a five-player game). One card is played by each player, with the person playing the highest-value card drafting one card from the trick into their display, with others following in order of descending card value, with the last player also receiving a Plum card. Special actions can be triggered at this point, allowing players to steal fruit cards or call the…
383450.name: Pies

383452.description: Lunar is a quick-playing, trick-taking game for two or four players in which players combine the phases of the moon and nocturnal animals to form cards played into tricks, which are combined to determine their value within each trick. Each round consists of twelve tricks played, and at the end of each round, a score is awarded based on the number of tricks and cards acquired. Once one player (or team) reaches 30 points, the game ends, and the side with the most points wins! —description from the publisher
383452.name: Lunar

383701.description: Tricky Time Crisis is a trick-taking game for 3-5 players with a Superhero and Time theme. It is a can't follow trick-taking game, where each player must play a different suit to the trick. If more than one card of the same suit would be played to a trick, two copies of the same person are in the same timeline and a paradox occurs with the hand ending early. In this game a time-jumping super villain named Dr. Tricky-Time is trying to destroy the timeline and it’s up to a group of heroes named Kid Cuckoo (the rookie), Double Take and Double Time (a pair of twins with the powers to double the…
383701.name: Tricky Time Crisis

383791.description: In the world of Savage Bowl, anything's game. Late hits, excessive celebrations, cheap shots, crushing tackles, bribing the officials — do anything you can to score in the flashiest way! While surviving all this carnage, your goal in Savage Bowl is to win an exact number of tricks (based on the player count). Play cleverly as the ref can penalize you for being too savage. In the first half of the game, they give yellow card penalties to the highest-value cards in each trick, then the second most valuable player wins the trick. The carded player also has to sit out the next round! In the…
383791.name: Savage Bowl
publishers: ぶれけけゲームズ (Brekeke Games)

386187.description: As autumn’s first cool breeze rustles through the tree branches, the squirrels begin their preparations for winter. Working together in pairs, they stash some acorns away in their trees, while eating others that will sprout too soon. The best-prepared Squirrels will be the strongest at the start of spring, ready to prosper in the new year. Acorns is a fixed-partnership, deck-shedding climbing game. Teams work together to be the first to shed their shared deck of cards. The rules also include a variant for two players.
386187.name: Acorns

386188.description: Greasy Spoon is a deck-shedding, ladder-climbing card game for two players. Be the first player to shed your entire deck by serving up menu items and menu combos to a diner filled with customers.
386188.name: Greasy Spoon

387015.description: Spring is here, and everyone on the block has decided to get rid of the clutter in their houses. Players will attempt to offload their excess items, but they have to organize them first. Players will need to make space in their houses to clean and will have to offer up some of their items to the rest of the neighborhood while also taking items from other neighbors if those items will help them organize better. Try to empty your house of your clutter first so that you can be the first to relax in the warm spring weather. In Spring Cleaning, players try to shed all their cards first, but must…
387015.name: Spring Cleaning

387099.description: Silk & Venom is a press-your-luck game about spiders building webs, catching bugs, and avoiding the rain. Build your web as big as your dare but be careful -- the rain might come and wash away all your work. Inspired by the Itsy Bitsy Spider, this game is for all ages and includes basic and strategic rules. Advanced rules add set collection and end-game scoring. On your turn, you can choose to build your web, catch bugs, or collect bugs from your web. If your web gets too wet (either from rain or drops on your web) it'll break. The bugs you collect might have additional effects that will…
387099.name: Silk & Venom

388225.description: Bah! Humbug! and the 12 Games of Christmas is a collection of 13 original holiday card games by 13 designers, reimplementing and expanding Bah! Humbug!: A Twelve Days of Christmas Bluffing Game into a versatile box of games. At the heart of the collection is a 78-card "12 days of Christmas" deck featuring Victorian-inspired animal art. The box also contains 34 wooden pieces, a detailed rulebook, and several additional card sets which may be combined with the base deck in various ways. The 2023 PnP/2025 boxed edition includes rules for these original games: Animal Menagerie (2 players) a…
388225.name: Bah! Humbug! and the 12 Games of Christmas

388720.description: A two-player, astronomy-themed climbing game released at Korea Boardgamecon 2023. Also, it was sold later at Tokyo Game Market Spring 2023. The goal is to win two of the three rounds by getting rid of their cards.
388720.name: Ptolemy

390321.description: A family-friendly, toilet-themed quirky trick taking game. The goal is to be the first to claim 400 poop points, or to score the most before one of the draw decks runs out. Players play poop cards into the play area, alongside toilet cubicles, to accumulate potentially claimable points. Once a poop is 'finished' players race to try to claim the points of that poop in play. Turns can be based on grabbing points, sharing points or sabotaging other players' options. Let chaos commence! —description from the designer
390321.name: Can't Go

391560.name: Four Clans Conflict
publishers: メリーアンドリューワークス (merry-andrew-works)

391985.description: Look, Enemy Anemone is a trick taking game featuring cards with numbers. There's not really a lot of theme here, but you've got to admit the name is pretty fun to say. Choose one suit per player; each suit has ranks 1-10. Shuffle the deck, then deal ten cards to each player. Set the nine anemone cards within reach. The start player plays one card face up in front of themselves. Each other player in clockwise order must play a card face up in front of themselves in a suit that has not yet been played into the trick. If a player cannot play a suit that has not been played, they discard a card…
391985.name: Enemy Anemone

393921.description: In this game each player takes control over their own realm, represented by standard playing cards. Realms & Royals is a simple racing/deck-building game where players try to expand cards on their hand in order to obtain the most valuable royal cards. Each suit represents distinct layer of the medieval society, and requires different combination of the cards in order to get it. When it's your turn, you may do one of three actions: buy a card - receive the social strata card from the common market get a random card - play some cards with value at least 5 points to receive the card from the…
393921.name: Realms & Royals

394691.description: Passions flamed and power waned. King Henry pursued Anne Boleyn for almost seven years before they were married. Those loyal to Catherine of Aragon did not accept Anne Boleyn, and considered King Henry’s first wife the rightful Queen. Those loyal to Anne Boleyn saw her as the future, the young wife who would surely give the King a son. The Six of VIII is a trick-taking game played on a timeline. Each Queen has her own suit which is trump during her reign. Players must capture tricks containing crucial courtiers and score the most points. The suits, and the years on the timeline, are…
394691.name: The Six of VIII

394865.description: 2024: "Soft-launch" featured first version of the game in Finnish language, for Finnish market. 2025: "Home Team Heroes: Season 1" Launched internationally with further developed game, in English language. Finally, a football card game that actually plays like modern football. Forget everything you know about sports card games. Home Team Heroes isn't another luck-driven simulator where higher numbers win. This is a tactical knife fight where every card placement matters, where tactical genius or good luck feel deserved, and where that perfect counter-attack you've been setting up actually…
394865.name: Home Team Heroes: The Football Card Game

395143.name: Davy Jones' Locker: Curse of the Ghost Ships

395667.description: Incubo is a cooperative deck-building game designed for 2 players, where they take on the roles of a child "Tommy" and his best friend cat, "Alpha", as they confront their fears to rescue their sister, "Nina". Together, they must build their decks by passing cards between each other, eliminating weaker or negative cards, and facing various adventures within the dream world. The game is divided into three R.E.M. phases, each culminating in a confrontation with a terrifying monster, such as a ball of yarn, a half-opened wardrobe, a pigeon, and more. These monsters are confronted simultaneously…
395667.name: Incubo

396334.description: In this trick-taking game, winning a Trick isn’t always desired because each card has a ‘Science’ (+) and ‘Madness’ (-) side that could challenge the balance of players’ Score Piles. Trick winners take an opponent’s card into one of their matching Score Piles - 2 suits of which are imbalanced from the start - with the goal to reduce each suit to 0. The lowest total score wins! —description from the publisher
396334.name: MAD

396337.description: Build out your domain by adding a card to the Kingdom each turn. At the end of the game, each player scores the largest area of each of the four land types from their point of view - your seat at the table matters! Expand carefully, as you can only score land if at least one unobstructed edge of that land is facing you. Your King and Queen can control land ANYWHERE in the Kingdom. However, land that is larger than 5 cards is too vast to score! The player with the most points rules the kingdom! —description from the designer
396337.name: FAR

396341.description: Shakespeare’s First Folio has players taking the role of printers in the early Seventeenth Century competing to print the first folio of Shakespeare’s plays. Players will utilize a combination of trick-taking and worker placement to collect as many plays as possible. The plays are suited - Histories, Comedies and Tragedies. There are also historical patrons and personages who will help the players out. A game ends immediately when the last Play is taken by a player. The most points wins and will print Shakespeare's First Folio!
396341.name: Shakespeare's First Folio

396953.description: Why is it called The Holiest Crap? Cuz self-righteous people are... holy pieces of crap! This strategic card game is inspired by the silly, self-righteous crap you and your friends do every day! It’s a game about people, not poop, where every card is like a meme making fun of the crap we all do. Just like in real life, you're competing to look better than everyone else – what fun! Hide your Vices (like your Bull Crap) by covering them with Virtues, so you look holy instead of crappy. Make other players look bad by attacking their Vices and exposing their crap to the world. Lift yourself up,…
396953.name: The Holiest Crap

397340.name: 週末へのカウントダウン (Countdown to the Weekend)

397614.name: Drakborgen: En färd in i det okända

398772.description: Stich für Stich is a highly suspicious crime card game for all sleuths, confidants, and knife guys! Four shady characters and seven dubious objects play the leading role here. Only one confidant knows who the perpetrator and the murder weapon are; all the other players are in the dark. But every trick is a clue because the murderer and the weapon always come up trumps, so the sleuths track down the culprit trick by trick. At the same time, the confidant who knows what's what tries to mislead their fellow players with nasty tricks. Only those who keep a cool head during the investigation and…
398772.name: Stich für Stich

399256.description: Kolonizacja - Kosmiczna gra karciana ("Colonisation - A Space Card Game") is a game in which players take on the role of the owners of a private space company, whose aim is to colonise as many of the valuable rocky worlds of our home star system as possible before their competitors do. The game mechanics combine elements of take that and push your luck. —description from the designer
399256.name: Kolonizacja: Kosmiczna gra karciana

401028.description: Restless Spirits is an easy-to-learn tactical card game where you play as a Spirit Guide, and you're helping Lost Spirits find their way home. Combining elements of set collection, tactical card drafting, ability combos, and push your luck, it's a race against your opponent(s) to free the spirits. There are 30 unique Light and Dark Spirits to encounter, with a different set of 3 Totem requirements listed at the bottom of each card. Every turn, you must decide where best to use your 2 Action Points: attracting Spirits to your board, buying Totem cards from a marketplace, and playing them to…
401028.name: Restless Spirits

401526.description: A group of divers take a part in a challenge. They try to collect the most various and the biggest collection of fishes. The deeper you dive the more fishes you can catch... but be careful! You can also loose everything. You can use fishing net and harpoon. A shrimp can replace every fish in a collection. Be aware of the wave - it can destroy all your collections. The game uses push your luck and set collection mechanisms. It is an entertainment for players who love colecting and taking a risk. There is a big interaction beteween players. The rules are quite easy and the time of play is quite…
401526.name: Underwater hunters

401795.description: In Battle of Gods, the fate of the world hangs in the balance as champions of Norse mythology clash in a fast-paced arena battle game for 2-4 players. Whether you prefer all-against-all or team-based showdowns, the choice is yours. Take command of legendary figures such as Thor, Freyja, Surtr, or Hyrrokkin, and battle your way to claim the title as the most glorious champion or the last one standing. Each champion boasts a unique array of abilities, from Freyja’s elegant Feather Cloak to Surtr’s blazing sword, activated through the power of strategic dice rolls. Throughout the game, you’ll…
401795.name: Battle of Gods

401882.description: You can compete alone or in pairs to take on the challenge of making the most impressive bouquets. Decide the leitmotif of your composition, and then pluck the finest flowers from under your opponents' noses, so you won't be left behind on this petal-strewn road. You earn points for the number of flowers in a bouquet (row of flowers) - simply put flower cards in the row on your team's side of the playing area. You have to match starting card with one of three attributes - a type of flower, its color, or ornament. As soon as there are at least 4 flowers in a row you can score, but more flowers…
401882.name: Flower Show

401979.description: Dive into the exciting world of paleontology with this addictive and fun card game! Collect and combine dinosaur DNA, creating a unique Jurassic Park. Competition is fierce, and the goal is to revive as many dinosaur species as possible. Jurassic Park awaits you! Digger is a competitive card game for 2-4 players and ages 8 and up. Each game lasts approximately 20-30 minutes. OBJECTIVE Obtain all the 5 different dinosaur tokens. GAMEPLAY ROUNDS: the game lasts 3 rounds. At the beginning of their turn, the starting player must decide which rule (or trick) they will follow during said turn. A…
401979.name: Jurassic Park Digger

402158.description: MILLRAT Pack! A collection of four unique board games created for the perfect game night. Featuring: Someone's Y - Everyone's a vowel in this deduction word game, but someone's Y. On your turn say a one word clue and see who takes a token. Use those tokens to pay for abilities and vote out Y! Don't be too obvious as to which vowel you are, because if Y is able to guess who's who, they win instead. Scrapbook - You're scrapbooking with your friends in this cooperative party game. Manipulate old images on your smartphone and place them in the frame to try and resemble the scrapbook card shown.…
402158.name: Millrat Pack!

402207.description: The Sunrise Islands, home of small but fierce animal folk; The Wooden Conclave, that reunites all the magical creatures of the Forest; The Wandering Market, that travels and trades without rest; The Mining Company, where the inventors create new technologies; The Floating City, where Magic and Technology find their balance; The Dragon Knight, sworn protectors of the land of Yro. From these factions you will recruit members for your guild, to create a powerful party and complete the most rewarding quests! In Yro you have to recruit adventurers in your guild and place them in a 3x3 grid you…
402207.name: YRO

402448.description: Band of Ogres is a push-your-luck, set-collection, auction card game with an ogre-musician battle-of-the-bands theme. First players assemble sets of ogre musician cards through Gin Rummy-style set-collection. Then they use a push-your-luck deck in an effort to get as many matches as possible between the push-your-luck cards and their set of ogre musician cards. Then they use the gold they gained through these matches to bid on “Win” cards that provide victory points or special powers. —description from the publisher
402448.name: Band of Ogres

402453.description: Death Valley: Highs & Lows is the second entry in the Death Valley series. Its 18 cards can be played as a standalone game or combined with the previous Death Valley game to create an all-new set of 18 cards every time you play. In this tableau-buillding game for 1-2 players, each traveler is striving to assemble the best mix of cards in their Journey and Scrapbook to win the game. Each turn, the active player chooses whether to add a card to their Journey row or to Rest and move cards from their Journey to their Scrapbook row. Adding new cards runs the risk of revealing too many Hazards of…
402453.name: Death Valley: Highs & Lows

402510.name: Gettysburg:  Will Lee Turn?  Lee Has Turned!

402674.description: "We sink!" shouts the elephant, “That mouse is too heavy!” "Don't worry!" whispers the lion, "If I eat the giraffe, we can lose a little weight." In All Aboard! you must get your gang of animals to safety in the different boats, but be careful not to exceed their capacity, or else they will sink. Designed by Paco Yánez and illustrated by Monsuros, this fun card game can be played as a couple or in groups of up to 5 players, from 7 years old, in games lasting about 20 minutes. Before starting, each player receives a set of 12 cards with the 12 different animals in the game (mouse, peacock,…
402674.name: All Aboard!

402744.description: Compete to find and collect magical items. Powerful action cards will help or hinder you along the way. The stakes rise with each card played. Balance the desire for points wisely as you push your luck. Play it safe or risk it all in the contest for victory. The goal of the game is to collect the most Magic Marks. Players collect Magic Marks by gathering sets of Talismans into their Trove. Each turn a player must draw at least one card and try to place it in the Enchanted Forest. Drawing additional cards will depend on how far they are willing to push their luck. Players try to complete…
402744.name: Toil & Troublez

402985.name: Östergötland (fan expansion for Ticket to Ride)

403107.name: Harry Potter: Hogwarts Magical Mayhem – 3D Board Game

405212.description: When your parents tell you to cook your own food. Hot Pot, also called Steam Boat or 火鍋, brings friends and family together over a simmering feast. All the cards are dealt out evenly amongst the players. Players take turn loading up the pot with their favourite ingredients, such as shiitake mushrooms, pork belly, wombok and crabsticks. Keep an eye on what's cooking and scoop them up before anyone else. Wait too long and you might end up with nothing! There's a few action cards thrown into the mix, to spice things up. Stop! It's not cooked yet! Timing is everything if you want to enjoy the…
405212.name: Hot Pot

405460.description: CATsle Builders / 猫の城大工~ is a trick-taking game for 3-5 players. Players aim to build a more robust castle by aligning five types of buildings as planned. The structures that will be built will change depending on the ranking of the battles held during each round. Adjust your ranking while predicting your and your opponent's hands, collect cards according to the blueprint, and aim to become the best castle builder! (Additional information: This work is a remake of "Anou", which won the Trick Taking Party 2017 Grand Prize) CATsle Builders は3~5人用のトリックテイキングゲームです。…
405460.name: CATsle Builders

405683.name: Мавка: Між двома світами (Mavka: Between Two Worlds)

406238.description: 隅田川 ("Sumida River") is a card-shedding game in which you can't play the same number of cards as the previous player. The deck contains 52 cards: three 3s up to ten 10s. The game includes a swapping rule that allows you to exchange all the cards in your hand, picking up an "almighty" card each time you do so, giving you the opportunity to make weak cards stronger.
406238.name: 隅田川 (Sumida River)

406299.description: The Crew: Family Adventure crossed the gameplay of The Crew: The Quest for Planet Nine with the setting of The Swiss Family Robinson. Players find themselves stranded on a deserted island and have to find their way around together. Eating, sleeping, making decisions — how will the adventure end?
406299.name: The Crew: Family Adventure

406320.description: The card game L.A.M.A. Kadabra plays similarly to the 2019 game L.L.A.M.A., but with a few additions that complicate gameplay and your choices of what to do. Let's start with the basics of L.L.A.M.A.: Each player starts a round with six cards in hand; the deck consists of llama cards and cards numbered 1-6. On a turn, the active player can play a card, draw a card, or quit. To play a card, you must play the same number as the top card of the discard pile or one number higher. If a 6 is on top, you can play a 6 or a llama, and if a llama is on top, you can play another llama or a 1. If you…
406320.name: L.A.M.A. Kadabra

406692.description: Obix Frutaventura is a casual card game in witch curious creatures will compete to get the most fruits before they run out. But be careful, there are many dangers lurking around. Accumulate points by collecting your favorite fruits and leaving the ones you don't like for others. But don't be too ambitious, because with every step you take away from home, predators are closer to you. At the beginning of each turn, it is up to you to continue looking for more fruits or go home and secure the one you already got. Keep in mind that if the predators find you, you will lose all the fruit you have…
406692.name: Obix Frutaventura

407173.description: How well can you play the same cards as someone else? In the first round of LOOP, each player receives a hand of eleven cards from a deck of three suits, with each suit having cards numbered 1-15. They each choose two cards to set aside face down. The lead player starts the first trick by laying down a single card, a pair of the same number, or two or more consecutive cards of the same suit. The next players in turn must play a higher matching combination of cards or pass, although a player who passes can re-enter the trick later. Once everyone passes, the player who won the trick leads…
407173.name: LOOP

407581.description: Sweet Takes is a trick-taking game in which each suit played into a trick will have a winner. The deck contains multiple colors of cards numbered 1-10, and you use one more color than the number of players. Each player receives a hand of nine cards and three face-down cards that they cannot look at. The lead player in a trick plays a card, then the next player must play this color, if possible, throwing off a different color if they can't. The third player must play the first color, if possible, or the second color if they can't, throwing off a different color if they can't do either, etc.…
407581.name: Sweet Takes

408992.name: Powers & Bananas: A Game of Balance

409704.name: MLEM: Space Agency – BLEP: Cosmic Pioneers

409787.description: "Animal Poker" Series No. 2! After "Neko" is "Inu"! This game is a game that collects 7 kinds of "Inu Card" (A to G) and aims for high points. All players leave the "Card they want" at the same time and give the "Other cards" to the person on the left! Let's aim for the highest point in hand while watching the scoring condition that is released one by one. In addition to the card, there is also a score sheet for score recording. 100 points (one! handlet)! Changes from draft poker: The number of players is changed when playing with 2 to 3 people. In addition, round rules and score sheet are…
409787.name: Dog Poker

410097.name: ザ・カカポ　バディ＆パーティ (The Kakapo: Buddy & Party)

410112.description: Shinobu no Gakkō, roughly, Shinobu School, is a climbing game where each player has two hands of cards and is adding and removing cards from a central tableau. Players are dealt a hand of cards, and then divide, as they'd like between a closed hand they hold traditionally, and a face up hand on the table. Two cards are dealt face up to the table that form the initial cards the players will add or subtract from. Players can play higher or lower cards than are currently on the table, and play them to that end of the column. Players must play at least the same number of cards as what is present…
410112.name: 忍のがっこう (Shinobi no Gakkō)

410275.description: Play as your favourite Mr Kiasu* characters in this push-your-luck card game about going to a sale and grabbing the best deals. Each turn, pick an item from the sale display. But beware - the items with the most points may be the hardest to fit into your bags! Each of the player's three bags can only carry items of the same discount and different type, or the same type with a maximum of 100%! One player for sure will shop until they DROP (a bag), so don't be the one to lose your shopping. Which player can grab the best discounts over the sale weekend? Mr Kiasu is perhaps the most well-known…
410275.name: Shop Until You Drop

410292.description: It’s your wife Sharon’s birthday, so you decided to surprise her at work with some roses and that expensive chocolate she’s always craving. Your marriage has been in a bit of a rough spot lately, and you were hoping today would be a bit of a turning point. Little did you know that as you arrived at Kobayashi Tower, a group of terrorists were securing the building and rounding up everyone inside as hostages. You managed to elude them, but your wife has been taken and is somewhere in the building. Now, you’ll have to work your way through the skyscraper, take out the terrorists, and rescue your…
410292.name: Hunted: Kobayashi Tower (2nd Edition)

publishers: Red I Games (レッド・アイ・ゲームズ)

410345.name: Trick Runaway
publishers: Southern Cross Games (サザンクロスゲームズ)

410705.description: In Clans and Glory, you take part in an ancient ritual: the free people of the Scottish Highlands have come from near and far to the meeting place to join a clan chief. Can you win the most followers? To set up, lay out 4-6 landscape boards depending on the player count and place random cards from the deck in certain locations. Each card is one of seven colors and is valued 3-8. On a turn, a player places a card from their hand in an empty space next to or across from a card of the same color or value, then optionally places one of their five clan tokens on the same location board where they…
410705.name: Clans and Glory

411062.description: This Game Is Shit is a humorous party game where your objective is to make your opponents shit their pants and be the only one with clean underwear. The simple and accessible rules make it the perfect game for entertaining party with your friends, even those not keen on board games. This Game Is Shit combines luck and skill, requiring you to make hard choices. At the beginning of each turn, you'll deal with a unique mechanic: draw two cards and choose only one. With this small variation in the drawing phase, you'll be able to develop your strategies, hoping not to regret your decisions. Use…
411062.name: This Game Is Shit

411542.name: Harry Potter Miniatures Adventure Game: Wizarding Duels Starter Box

411613.description: In Zirkhaki everyone acts as diggers, digging for treasures and trying to gain wealth by collecting as much treasure as possible. It works for 2 - 4 players, but combining two sets of cards can extend that from 5 - 8 players. First, the players will make a "discard" pile by removing the lowest value card from each type and putting them aside. Then they will shuffle all the rest of the cards and put them on the other side of the table, creating a "dig pile". The distance between the dig pile and the discard pile is the "dig site". Then each player will start their turn by flipping a card from…
411613.name: زیرخاکی (Zirkhaki)

41185.name: Europa: Paris ist ja klar, aber wo liegt Córdoba?

412115.description: In Express Zirkhaki, much like the original Zirkhaki, players act as diggers trying to dig for treasure and accumulate as much points as they can. The players first will remove the lowers numbered item from the deck and shuffle them and put them on one side as the "discard pile", then shuffle the rest of the items and put them on the other side as the "dig pile". The distance between the dig pile and discard pile is the "dig site". Then the first player is chosen, and they will turn over the top card from the dig pile onto the dig site. Each item has a special power that then will be…
412115.name: زیرخاکی سه سوت (Express Zirkhaki)

412381.description: You've joined a hot air balloon festival in which the goal is to go higher than your opponents. Dump as many sandbags as you can — and try to gain rockets as well! — to send yourself higher and higher to win. Sandbag is a trick-taking game of avoiding tricks, manipulating trump, and reconfiguring your hand of cards. In each of the three rounds, you configure your basket with two face-up cards; the most common color among all players' cards is the trump suit. Each trick, players either play from their hand, play a sandbag (to sluff, that is avoid winning the trick), or play one of their…
412381.name: Sandbag

412633.description: Embark on a treacherous journey as a cunning Scavenger, working for Diabolical Drilling Co.- an intergalactic drilling company known for its low morality and insatiable greed. Delve into 10 sinister contracts, plunder breathtaking worlds, and tackle dispicable missions for some of the galaxy’s most nefarious figures. To win this solo/co-op game, you must navigate your scavenger vessel through uncharted solar systems , fulfilling missions and mining valuable minerals to complete 10 contracts. Strategic decision making and skilful navigation are crucial to impressing management and securing a…
412633.name: Diabolical Drilling Co

413526.description: Welcome to Anne Bonny's: Malediction! Embark on an epic adventure on the high seas, where treasure and intrigue are intertwined in every wave. In this exciting game of interaction and strategy, you will face the ultimate challenge: join the legendary crew of Anne Bonny, one of the most feared pirates of all time. Your mission is simple but challenging: roll the dices and do the actions using your cards to collect 20 gold coins meanwile other players try to change the type of your dices, steal your cards and your money. Earn Anne Bonny's respect and trust and secure a place on her intrepid…
413526.name: Anne Bonny's Malediction

413527.description: They have just put the food to all the pets and they want to get there first. During your turn, you will choose two of the three animals you have, and turn a card to see who pets advance. If it´s the same pet you choosen, It will advance as many spaces as the card said. Besides, you can disguise your pets to cheat another players and advance faster. Will you be the owner of the pets that arrive first? A game of prediction, deception and luck. —description from the publisher Acaban de ponerle la comida a todas las mascotas y quieren llegar primero. Durante tu turno, elegirás dos de los tres…
413527.name: Pet's Run

413784.description: In Lucky Xmas you are allowed to use Santa's magic to alter the outcome of the biggest lottery ever. Our aim: give everybody a great Christmas. The winner will become Santa's helper. On your turn you will choose 1 card to add to your tableau in row 1, 2, 3 or 4. Once a row consists of 3 cards, you raise money for Santa’s lottery. You try to maximize the score of each row by matching symbols: 4 of a kind, full house and special patterns of 6 cards. Depending on the row and the symbols on the cards of that row, you will gain Special Powers to alter the outcome of future rounds.
413784.name: Lucky Xmas

413838.description: Sakana Stack is a climbing/shedding card game in which players play stacks of seafood from their hand with the aim of having the most valuable stack in play. Stacks can be played of matching numbers, but they must match the last played card by suit or number. Players score the top card from their stack if the next player passes, so the bigger the stack, the higher the scoring opportunity. Play continues until a player sheds all cards in their hand, or the draw pile runs out twice and all cards scored are counted and recorded. Play a number of rounds equal to the number of players to determine…
413838.name: Sakana Stack

414302.description: In the card game Xylotar, you’ve found the long-lost xylotar schematics for the instrument originally designed by Bobby McColdsnap and Keifer Basset. This unique musical device was based on both xylophone and synthesizer technology in the mid-80s and was created as an alternative to the keytars of the era. Without knowing exactly how it should work, play until you discover the sweetest sounds. The player who scores the most points has found the perfect balance of 80s synthesizer rock and modern carimba-style melodies. Only then can you mass produce the xylotar, succeeding in your goal of…
414302.name: Xylotar

414661.description: Dirt and Glory is an adrenaline-pumping card game set in a post-apocalyptic world in which speed, tactics, and a bit of luck are the keys to success! Take on the role of a fearless leader, then race for dominance, guiding your convoy through the treacherous wasteland to claim the richest territories. Each round starts by revealing a location card, which gives players a target number they try to reach with their convoy as close as possible. Players can press their luck playing cards from their deck, and whoever gets closest to the target receives the best reward. Topping the target makes you…
414661.name: Dirt and Glory

414892.name: PNW: Card Games Inspired by the Pacific Northwest

414944.description: It was a beautiful day in Hawthorn Heath. People were dancing, reading, playing. Suddenly the weather changed. No one was ready. Except for you, a clever merchant. Sell umbrellas when it rains, ice cream when it’s hot, tea and coffee when it’s cold, kites when it's windy, and lanterns when it's foggy. But customers are savvy, so only the merchant with the last lowest price will make the sale. Park Life: People is a trick taking game with set collecting and tableau building about careful timing, profiting from opportunity, and adapting to other player's strategies. Park Life has 5…
414944.name: Park Life: People

415108.description: Crisps is a ladder-climbing card game for 2 players. Crisps selects and recombines ingredients from several climbing games to serve up as a light & delicious snack that will leave you craving for more. Players attempt to be the first person to empty their hand of cards. Like many climbing/shedding games, players can play single cards, sets, runs, or runs of pairs. The following player must play same rank or higher to beat the previous meld. After someone passes, players then must draw a card. The trick winner gets to pick a card first either face-up or from a face-down pile and then the trick…
415108.name: Crisps!

415472.description: It takes two to tango, but only one dancer will stand tall in this trick-taking game for two players! In Tango, players play cards (both from their hand and from their face-up display), in order to perform the best possible dance steps. Plan ahead as best you can, but remember your opponent knows some of the steps you will take! Will you be named lord or lady of the dance? —description from the publisher
415472.name: Tango

415936.description: This is the Second Edition of Vossa Excelência - O Jogo Político. In Vossa Excelência (Your Excellency), each player takes on the role of a newly elected congress-person who, in order to stay in power, must use their four-year term to ensure re-election. They must seize every opportunity, utilizing allies, privileges, and all their influence to gain voters and (a lot of) money. The new base box has several cards replaced, modified, or rebalanced. In addition to the 130 "basic" game cards, the box includes the second edition of the Power Project expansion, completely revamped with 60 cards…
415936.name: Vossa Excelência: O Jogo Político (Second Edition)

415949.description: Valiant Wars: Call to Arms is a standalone Valiant Wars game with all-new champions and locations. It can be played by itself and combined with Valiant Wars. Valiant Wars is an aggressive press-your-luck deck-builder where you must fight to capture lands of the once-great kingdom. Your rivals will resort to trickery and sabotage in their attempts to bring down your forces. Be warned! As you assemble larger armies and conquer more territory, you’ll be haunted by dark visions of a world in ruins; too many of these Dark Omens and withdrawal becomes necessary. Step up and claim the Valiant…
415949.name: Valiant Wars: Call to Arms

415981.description: The latest edition of the Seers Catalog has everything you need for stopping werewolves. Can you limit yourself to the essentials in time to save the village? Seers Catalog is an almost-shedding card game in which each player tries to get rid of almost all of the cards in their hand. Each round, players have a unique set of artifacts that give them asymmetric abilities to help manage their hand of cards. When one player runs out of cards, the round is scored: Each card is worth -1, but if you have five or fewer cards in your hand, the lowest value on those cards is worth positive points!…
415981.name: Seers Catalog

416282.description: Teech for Two is a climbing/shedding game for exactly two players. It was designed by Larry Levy to meet the need for a two player climbing game when there were none readily available. The goal of the game is for a player to shed out their entire hand before the other player. The gameplay is standard climbing play. One player leads with a combination. The other player must follow and play a higher version of the exact same combination. Teech for Two was inspired by David Parlett's "The Bum Game", which was Parlett's preferred way of playing Daihinmin. What makes Teech for Two original and…
416282.name: Teech for Two

416296.description: The dark and gritty action of Warhammer 40,000: Darktide slips from the screen to the tabletop in a new card game by Cubicle 7 – publishers of tabletop RPG Imperium Maledictum and more. Darktide: The Card Game is a fast and deadly cooperative caper for one to four players, battling hordes of Chaos-warped monsters and traitorous Guardsmen across six missions decreed by their merciless Inquisitor. The set includes over 260 cards, six player boards, and all the rules and tokens you need to play out missions packed with nerve-wracking decisions – after all, you’re merely Rejects, and the mission…
416296.name: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide – The Card Game

416494.description: Murray the A**hole Frog is a game of set collection and set destruction with random end triggers. On your turn, you have full access to the cards in your hand and limited access to a common deck and a small pool of revealed cards. The card set includes insects — common flies (fruit flies, midges, houseflies, and mayflies), royal flies (fireflies, robber flies, damselflies, and dragonflies), and wasps — and Murray. Common flies are useful for building swarms and getting more cards. Royal flies and wasps are useful for building swarms and for their unique special abilities. Your main goal is to…
416494.name: Murray the A**hole Frog

416537.description: You’re the hosts of a dinner party, and your guests are people of history. Convince characters like Marie Curie, Cleopatra or Gandhi to join your table, use their special abilities and treat them to drinks from the bar. Send Adolf (who came uninvited and insists his invitation “got lost in the mail”) to the table of an opponent to ruin their evening, and make sure to keep your own guests entertained so other players won’t be able to charm them away from you. Only one can have the greatest party ever when the game ends and dinner is served! Dinner Party is a quick, dark-humoured, dice-driven…
416537.name: Dinner Party

416952.description: In ONDA, players use cards from their hands to compose wave formations superior to those of their opponents according to the current tide. Your goal is to be the first to play all your cards; failing that, try to have as few cards as possible since you lose points based on what's left in your hand. In more detail, at the start of play the tide is coming in, that is, high numbers are better than low. In each round, each player starts with a hand of cards, placing two cards face down in front of them; these cards are now wild and still considered part of their hand. To start the trick, the lead…
416952.name: ONDA

417224.description: Onstage is a "must follow" trick-taking game in which you play as a theater company competing for the best performers to join your troupe. By winning tricks, you claim performers onstage. The trump suit is determined by the most valuable performers currently onstage and will change throughout the game as you recruit and manipulate the line of performers. The deck consists of 36 cards, numbered 1-9 for each of the four suits. Each suit has three performers, one each valued at 1, 2, and 3 points, which represent the featured, supporting, and lead actors respectively. The values 1, 4, and 7 of…
417224.name: Onstage

417429.description: It is the thirty-first century. For generations, the Great Houses of the Inner Sphere have been at war, squabbling over the scraps of the long-dead Star League. Centuries of fighting have led to the formation of countless mercenary commands willing to take on the tough missions that the Successor States can't—or wont'—take on themselves. These mercenary commands live and die by two things: the almighty C-bill and their reputation among their employers that they have what it takes to get the job done. Encounters: BattleTech is a fast-paced, push-your-luck dice and card game. Players act as…
417429.name: Encounters: BattleTech

417820.description: Flagships is a competitive card game with a unique asymmetric twist. There is no deckbuilding, but players will pick from a wide variety of playstyles. Players must weigh the odds in a battle before fully committing their cards. There are two ways to win: militarily by having the higher strength over your opponent, or economically by scoring 5 points through various card effects. —description from the designer
417820.name: Flagships of the Imperium

418447.description: A card game in which your objective is to roast the perfect mallow by placing it on the campfire. Watch your gooey points stack up as the longer your mallow is on the fire the more points it's worth. Beware however this makes your mallow vulnerable to attack from the other players and you must be clever when you take off your mallow to keep it from getting too crispy ! Players have the chance to destroy your fluff pillows and you must be carful of unsavory characters. You will have a chance to defend yourself with the mighty mallow knight but fate can be a cruel mistress so be warned. There…
418447.name: Roast

418556.description: Snow White, The Little Mermaid, Cinderella, and many other legendary princesses are celebrating a five-day party. The prince charmings of the land, who have not been invited, have infiltrated the ball to propose marriage. As an independent princess, you have to avoid marriage proposals and remain single. Avoid the most proposals and become the Rebel Princess! Rebel Princess takes place over five rounds, representing the five days of a party, and each round has a special rule that makes each game totally different. The general mechanisms are those of trick-taking games, in which each player…
418556.name: Rebel Princess: Deluxe Edition

418763.description: Naturalia is a board game set on an ecological tourist ship that exhibits native and endemic plants of Chile. The players will be aspiring "exhibition masters" and will have the mission of organizing the species in the best possible way according to the captain's indications and the plants' characteristics in order to obtain the greatest amount of "charm" from their visitors while trying to overcome the obstacle of water scarcity and other events that develop throughout the game. —description from the publisher Naturalia es un juego de mesa ambientado en un barco de reserva ecológica…
418763.name: Naturalia

419195.description: In Fishing, you try to catch as many tricks as possible over eight rounds, with each card you catch being worth 1 point. You then use your caught cards for the next round — and if you didn't catch enough tricks to fill your hand, you'll draw fresh cards from the ocean stack, which will introduce new cards for you fishers to fight over. In more detail, at the start of each round, you have 8-13 cards in hand, depending on the player count and the round. In the first round, the cards go from 1-10 in four colors. Standard trick-taking rules apply, with players needing to follow the color led and…
419195.name: Fishing

419416.description: The Phantom of the Opera is a tense two-player trick-taking duel inspired by Gaston Leroux’s classic tale. One player is the Phantom, striving to compose a perfect musical score, while the other is Christine, trying to disrupt his melody and break free. Over two rounds of ten tricks each, players follow suit when possible, use trump and “super trump” (superior to trump) suits to capture or evade tricks. The “Number on the Seal” adds tension by triggering card exchanges and high-stakes scoring. To succeed, the Phantom must win and lose specific tricks as shown on the music sheet, while…
419416.name: The Phantom of the Opera

419536.name: Tåg till Rydsgård: andra upplagan (fan expansion for Ticket to Ride)

419662.description: Verzamel hout om verschillende soorten meubels te maken. Maar pas op voor houtwormen. De eerste die alle meubels heeft gemaakt, wint. Tijdens je beurt kun je meubels maken met het eerder verzamelde hout. Elk type meubelstuk vereist een andere hoeveelheid en soort hout. Of je kunt hout verzamelen in het bos. Het bos wordt weergegeven door de kaarten die met de afbeelding naar beneden over de tafel verspreid liggen. Je draait kaarten om en verzamelt ze totdat je besluit te stoppen of een speciale kaart om te draaien. Wanneer je een speciale kaart omdraait, voer je de actie van de speciale kaart…
419662.name: Houtwormen

419784.description: It’s the summer of 1986, you just graduated high school and you have one more week of summer before it’s time to head off to the real world. Last Week Of Summer combines turn programming and worker placement with a variety of mini games. Each game, players set up their town using 4 or 5 of the possible locations: Pick up a movie at the Video Store, get high scores at the Arcade, grab some Fast Food, hang at the U-Mart, get the coolest (but not too cool) albums at the Music Store, or learn some tricks at the Skatepark. Each of these locations links 80's theme to a classic mechanism - set…
419784.name: Last Week of Summer

420017.description: Snow White, The Little Mermaid, Cinderella, and many other legendary princesses are celebrating a five-day party. The prince charmings, who have not been invited, will try to infiltrate the ball to propose marriage to the girls. As a princess, you have to avoid marriage proposals and remain single and independent after the celebrations. Rebel Princess takes place over five rounds, representing the five days of a party, and each round has a special rule that makes each game totally different. The general mechanisms are those of trick-taking games, in which each player plays a numbered card…
420017.name: Rebel Princess: 2nd Edition

420385.description: In The Yellow House, inspired by artists like Van Gogh and Gauguin, you’ll engage in debates about which elements are most crucial in the arts. Your goal is to empty your hand during these debates. On your turn, you can either play a card to make a claim, or strengthen your arguments by discarding cards if the topic you bring forth is not stronger! With cunning, you’ll be able to say the final word and, that way, win the debate of the century! —description from the publisher
420385.name: The Yellow House

420760.name: Requiem: Downfall of Magic – Gifts of Death

420766.description: You can't win just by taking tricks! The ‘7’ super card is covered in gold foil. A very simple trick-taking game with special win conditions such as ‘Taking the 7’ or ‘Make 13 by playing another suit’. In this game you must-follow the lead suit. Tricks are won face down (not worth any points), or face up (worth 1 point) if the trick is won by a special win (including a 7 or adds up to 13 if suit wasn't followed). The winner is the one who achieves two points first wins face down! There are two conditions for special wins: taking a seven, and having a card in a different suit that adds up to…
420766.name: Trick & Snipers

420767.name: Requiem: Downfall of Magic – Merciless Hunt

420862.description: As you enter the Cathedral, you're suddenly gripped by the magnitude of the challenge ahead. Compose with color and light to leave your competitors in the shadow! In this trick taking game, hold your cards in your hand without looking at them. While you know the suits, only your opponents know the values of your cards. Look at your opponents' hands to deduce the value of your cards and bet the number of tricks you think you will win. —description from the publisher
420862.name: LUZ

420891.description: There is no master today. That's right, why don't you all try using forbidden books? No problem, as long as you clean it up by the time you get back. Wow, beautiful magic is coming out of this book. Is this supposed to… Too bad, I have to use the forbidden book to close the forbidden book! Shut the Books is a trick-taking game where you bid with cards. Aim to win the trick with a card of the same color or number as the card you played. The number of tricks performed also changes depending on the number of cards played.
420891.name: Shut The Books

420927.name: Aircraft, Battle Force:  The Ships that Held the Line

420932.description: The horse you are in charge of runs based on the result of the tricks. The hand you decide at the start of the game will be carried over throughout the game, so you will gradually learn about the characteristics of the horse. This is a unique game where you can enjoy the thrills of trick-taking and horse racing predictions at the same time.
420932.name: Trick Stakes

421365.description: In this tactical game with deckbuilding elements, 1-4 players become one of the Jomsvikings - an elite mercenary group capable of accomplishing even the most impossible tasks. You set off to different planets of the Nine Realms to gain glory while figthing anything your employers want you to fight! The game consists of 3 rounds, during which players fight the chosen monsters (each of them separately), but can either help or hinder other players. Each round takes us to a different planet, with various conditions, that can impact combat. By investing in new cards and new equipment it can become…
421365.name: Jomsvikings

421948.description: Well, it happened. It's the apocalypse, people. Due to [classified] mutants have taken over the country. The last ship is leaving soon and Your rag tag group of survivors must scavenge the lands looking for valuable materials to ... Ensure... That the ferry captain lets you on board. Only one group will leave for the new land. 3 to 6 players scavenge, trade, beg, and backstab each other in this casual, family fun, resource management card game. Players send out scouts to collect cards in the hopes of finding the rate fresh fruit to bribe the ferry captain. The player with the most fresh fruit…
421948.name: I.I.T.A.P.: It is the Apocalypse, People!

422022.description: In the enigmatic city of Ulthar, it is well known that no feline can suffer the slightest offense. Thus, countless cats, with their piercing and mysterious gazes, are drawn to this adorable refuge. However, even these innocent-looking creatures have arcane desires and earthly needs such as food, hydration, fun, and rest. Who can help the Cats of Ulthar? We present a card game for 1 to 4 participants, recommended for ages 4 and up, where players are challenged to satiate the hidden desires of these kittens. Among the needs to be satisfied, the one who fulfills two of these will emerge…
