422022.name: Gatos de Ulthar

422146.description: Pizza Roles is a ten-minute "filler" hidden roles game where your role is what you want on your pizza but are too timid to say. Play simulates a conversation about what kind of pizza to order with each player vying for what they want while trying not to seem overbearing. Eight Topping cards represent the game state. Gameplay consists mostly of moving these Topping cards back and forth between the "not on the pizza" zone and the "on the pizza" zone. Each player is dealt a secret Role card showing their objectives in the game and a small hand of Conversation cards they can play to manipulate…
422146.name: Pizza Roles

422368.description: Lepidoptery is a climbing, deck-shedder and connection game for 2 players. Players try to form 4-in-a-row on the board in their own player color, or shed out their deck to win. Take turns playing stronger and stronger combinations while dropping tokens into the columns matching your played combination types. Unlike many climber-shedders, you are allowed to play combinations of different types on each other (e.g., sets on singles). As columns fill up, their combination types become blocked from play, and any previously filled columns are emptied. —description from the designer
422368.name: Lepidoptery

422590.description: In Petty Kingdoms, you play as rulers of rival villages competing to be the first to reach kingdom status! Recruit the best and most diverse population of tradespeople to build the most powerful kingdom. Add buildings to your village to take advantage of abilities or hinder other rival kingdoms. Petty Kingdoms is a competitive city building game with a play time of 45-60 mins. This game is easy to teach, packed with strategic decisions. Gameplay allows for multiple paths to victory. Construct buildings to attract specific citizens to your village and gain bonus actions. Build the most of any…
422590.name: Petty Kingdoms

422685.description: Embark on a thrilling adventure in Dogs With Jobs! You’ve just been hired by your city to recruit a team of working canines and answer the call of those in need. It’s your first day on the job and your goal is to outperform other recruiters for the greatest amount of reward points possible! Some jobs will call for grit, others for clever tactics. But each recruiter will face the challenge of organizing the most efficient team and utilizing each dog’s unique skills. With just 8 short hours in your day, every decision is crucial and unanswered jobs could cost you the win! Will you emerge as the…
422685.name: Dogs With Jobs

423307.description: Zero to Hero is a tile-based trick-taking game for 3-5 players. The twists in the game are that you can either win or lose points for winning a trick. You can also win or lose points if you are second in a trick. Who wins or comes second is not always the player who plays the highest value tile; it's actually determined by summing the values of each played suit, then seeing who played the highest tile of the strongest suit. To add some fun to the mix, you can win a trick with a 2 if you are the only player to play a tile of that suit. Finally, if the game is going really badly for you and you…
423307.name: Zero to Hero

423315.description: Stone Shedding Game is a dynamic card game with a ladder-climbing mechanic where players make sets of stones for the shared garden. The goal is to get rid of all the cards on your hand and gain the most Victory Points for your stone set. Players can't shuffle their hand and must play sets of cards with consecutive or identical numbers to beat the previous one. If you can’t beat the last opponent’s combination, you can pass and exchange some of the cards on your hand. Create the ultimate winning combination and profit from other players’ actions in this dynamic card battle! —description from…
423315.name: Stone Shedding Game

423432.description: Ahoy, mateys! Time to grab your pirate hats and set sail! Ready to claim the bounty of a lifetime? Skull Queen is a trick-taking game in which you determine before the game starts whether you will win or lose tricks for every suit. The player who chooses wisely and outplays their opponents will be victorious. You’re each the captain of a pirate ship, and your lookout has just spotted a ship full of bounty on the horizon. You need to line up your pirates so they are ready to board when you attack. Start by placing each Pirate on any one of the 5 spaces on your Plank. Once you’ve all played all…
423432.name: Skull Queen

423517.description: Once upon a time, there was a magical book of fairy tales that had three chapters. You will now live through that book in 3 Chapters, a trick-taking game with three game phases: • Chapter 1: Start with eight cards in hand, choose one, then pass the remaining cards clockwise. Continue doing this until all cards are drafted. • Chapter 2: Play one card each. The highest card wins the trick and receives two points. Additionally, compare the skills on your cards with one another as this can earn you additional points. • Chapter 3: Finally, evaluate the skills within your selected hand cards. They…
423517.name: 3 Chapters

423547.name: Lands of Galzyr: Dreams and Mysteries

423674.description: The backyard housing market in Johannesbug was fine until the lawn was laid. Now every bug needs a six-figure down payment to wrangle even the most humble abode. Add to that, a competing couple seems to be making bids faster than you and yours, so hurry and make an offer! Bug House Millionaire is a climbing/shedding game where you'll be working with a partner to corner the bug housing market! Players will play 2 simultaneous, 2 player climbing/shedding games where the cards they capture will go to the hand of their parter. They'll also have to hurry as the players are on the clock and the…
423674.name: Bug House Millionaire

423816.description: Trickadee is a clever trick-taking game where sometimes you win by coming in last. Play birds to the feeder and collect them into flocks. Cleverly play the right birds to come in first, third, or last place to gain abilities that allow you to make better flocks. —description from the designer
423816.name: Trickadee

424575.description: In Otters, you play the role of a playful otter who searches for the most valuable pearls. In your turn, pick a card and play one of your cards. Pick pearls, attack other otters, defend yourself and avoid sea urchins. If at the end of your turn you have two sea urchins in your hand, you are out, but you can still win because, at the end, the value of the pearls you have collected counts. —description from the publisher
424575.name: Otters

424885.description: You just adopted new houseplants. Now you just need to keep them alive! But with a growing plant collection, sprouting your plant babies is far from easy. To succeed, give your houseplants the right nutrients. But give too much and you'll wilt your leafy friends! Sprout is a cozy, yet thrilling push-your-luck strategy game for 2-5 plant parents. Players take the role of roommates trying to sprout their newly adopted houseplants. Choose how long to stay in your apartment collecting nutrients including Sunlight, Water, Plant Food, and even Love! The longer you care for your plants, the more…
424885.name: Sprout

424984.description: Bitter Rivals is a build-em style party game where the first player to build their fruit controlled mecha suit wins! There are two decks, the lemon deck and the lime deck. players use Sour Street cards to pick up from the lime deck and build their mecha suits, they end their turn by picking up from the lemon deck. You can use action cards to slow other players down, like flipping their armour cards over, slicing an armour piece back into the lime deck, swapping a piece of yours with a piece of theirs or by playing battle cards to directly steal from another player. Slice, Yoink, Flip and…
424984.name: Bitter Rivals

426603.description: A climbing game that combines cards and polyhedral dice into a game where melds of cards and dice can only be played if no one else has played that kind yet. Every game of Tip of the Diceberg is different since you reveal cards from the diceberg deck at the beginning of each game to find out what types of melds will be allowed in the game. —description from the designer
426603.name: Tip of the Diceberg

426765.name: Dungeon Saga Origins: The Dice Game

427361.description: Find your flock and a home to roost in this exciting new take on Rummy for two to five players. Compete to have the most birds gathered on your island. But beware, these fowls are quite fickle, as other players can play cards to attract birds from your flocks to theirs. Will you play it safe and send your birds home to roost, or risk it all in a bid for more points? Draw a Card Take Two Play Actions Flock (Play a Set of Three Matching Birds) Matching Birds Join Your Flock Birds from Your Flock Can Fly Away! Roost (Play a Run of Three Birds) Play from Hand or Board Roosted Birds No Longer Fly…
427361.name: Flock!

427456.description: Guildmasters of Aurelia is an epic board game that immerses you in a magical world, where you write your own adventures as a guildmaster. In this game, you will hire new adventurers, equip them with the best gear, and send them on dangerous quests. The rewards you earn from quests will help you enhance your guild by building new structures, increasing your power, or acquiring more skilled adventurers and superior equipment. Your goal is to craft a successful strategy and take risks at the right time to complete all the quests needed to defeat the great danger that threatens the world—before…
427456.name: Guildmasters of Aurelia

427635.description: Mirianth Pets is a thematic adaptation of the shedding game Ambiente Abissal/Planet etuC, set in the captivating world of Mirianth. In this game for 2 or 3 players, you will have the opportunity to control six fantastical animals from this magical universe, using their unique strength to win the game by getting rid of their hand. The cards in the game represent the six mystical animals of Mirianth, each with different strengths and weaknesses, depending on the number of players. Each animal has a rank and power, allowing for various ways to outmaneuver your opponents' plays. The game proceeds…
427635.name: Mirianth Pets

427904.description: It's time to dive into the delicious world of Hot Pot Holic, the trick-taking game as tasty as tricky! The pot is bubbling - can you scoop up your favorite ingredients before the other players do? Enjoy this drooling game with friends and family, but beware of overeating! Hot Pot Holic is a trick-taking game. Each round players can either take cards from the table to their plate or "swallow" their cards to the stomach to score points — the number of cards they can take or swallow depends on their turn order of that round. Managing your turn order is tricky but crucial to victory!
427904.name: Hot Pot Holic

428018.description: There is a town, unguarded, and you are intent on raiding it and leaving with a massive bounty of loot! But be careful, there are others who share a similar interest… Play your cards right and take home the biggest stash!​ STASH is quick, simple, and easy to learn. Designed to be endlessly re-playable by both casual partygoers and dedicated strategists, STASH will have you hooked. It has the simplicity of UNO, the anticipation of Poker, and the interaction of Unstable Unicorns. Released by the independent Australian game developer in 2025, STASH received overwhelmingly positive feedback from…
428018.name: STASH Card Game

428082.description: Enlightened is a climbing card game inspired by traditional Chinese favorites like Big Two, Da Lao Er, and Zheng Fen. Players vie to be the first to empty their hand, but with a unique twist - there's no trump suit! Instead, you'll harness the dynamic interplay of Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, and Water. Each element has its place in the cycle, mirroring the balance found in nature. The Wu Xing destruction cycle determines the elemental ranking: Fire melts Metal, Metal chops Wood, Wood parts Earth, Earth absorbs Water, Water extinguishes Fire. Objective & Scoring: The object of the game is to get…
428082.name: Enlightened

428162.description: Jogo Exploradores is a board game where the objective is to create exploratory campaigns, each with an initial cost. Players collect numerical cards ranging from 2 to 10, and any campaign that accumulates more than 20 points starts generating profit. Special cards, such as Funding and Great Treasure, are aimed at maximizing this profit. The campaigns begin with an archaeological excavation and progress through scientific environments until they reach international media, culminating in fame, prestige, and fortune. In this highly competitive environment, setbacks like blockades or even…
428162.name: Jogo Exploradores

428238.description: Blizzard Blitz is a fast-paced card game of toboggan racing. Outmaneuver rivals and race to victory in this frosty showdown! In Blizzard Blitz, you and your friends are brave toboggan racers hurtling down a treacherous, snow-covered track. But it’s not just about speed; strategy, snowballs, and sneaky maneuvers are essential to your success as you race to the finish line. Outmaneuver your opponents, unleash snowball attacks, and collect powerful boosts to claim victory! How It Plays Each game of Blizzard Blitz takes you through a series of quick, intense turns where you have to push your…
428238.name: Blizzard Blitz: The Card Game

428269.description: When was the last time you looked under the bed? You'd be surprised what oddities you find there. Monsters, Wraiths or a stinging moustache? The only winner in this game is the first one to fall asleep with no fear, but be careful because you can easily get in each other's way. In Mumusok, a player can draw as many cards as he wants in his turn to get sleep points and advance on the scoreboard. But if he encounters 3 Mumus from the deck he will be caught and lose the points he scored in that round. However, the deck also contains action cards and event cards that you can use to either advance…
428269.name: Mumusok

428358.name: Clank!: Catacombs – Mister Wizkers Promo Card

428409.name: Violet and the meddlings of Madame Kamila

428538.description: A 5 card game compendium with 4 decks of custom cards comes with rules for several games: Chai Tea Jazz: Modern version of Coiffeur-Jass with all the fixings. Hodge Podge Dodgeball: Team Avoidance game as you play a must-not-follow trick-taking Bug House Millionaire: Climbing/shedding game about passing your partner cards in real-time Short Zoot Suit: Trick-taking game about short-suiting. Through the Zoo: Meta game about standard deck games —description from the designer
428538.name: Zoo and More

428540.description: Skybirds is a climbing/shedding game where you’ll fight for dominance in the skies over the battlefields of the Great War (which later came to be known as World War I). Aerial combat is simulated by – and this is a little weird but work with us – winning rounds of a ladder-climbing, empty-your-hand card game. If only real war could be so civilized! Players start out even in skill, but as play progresses the winner of a given round of cards will be able to improve their squadron incrementally more than the second-place finisher, both of whom will improve more than third place, etc. Except in a…
428540.name: Skybirds

428776.description: Prove your worth and become the Pirate King by facing challenges that will test your luck. In Pirate King!, every decision matters, and only those capable of mastering their ambition will claim the pirate throne. Across 7 rounds, you'll compete against other captains to build the best deck of cards while avoiding the dreaded curses lurking in the seven seas. Each player starts by choosing a captain and an initial deck, while the market and monster cards are placed in the center of the table. Every captain is unique, so choose wisely, as their abilities will aid you on your journey. During the…
428776.name: Pirate King!

428891.description: Everyone was happily working on toys and getting ready for Christmas when all of a sudden Jack Frost and an army of minions showed up. They kidnapped Santa, scattered the elves, and are trying to ruin Christmas! Now, you’ll have to work your way through the North Pole and rescue Santa before Christmas is canceled. All while Jack Frost’s minions try to hunt you down. Take on the role of one of Santa’s elves in order to sneak your way through the North Pole, defeat Jack Frost, rescue Santa, and save Christmas. But be wary, Jack's minions are searching for you to put a premature end to your…
428891.name: Hunted: North Pole (2nd Edition)

429293.description: The Fellowship of the Ring: Trick-Taking Game is a co-operative card game that plays out over eighteen chapters that lead players through the events of the novel The Fellowship of the Ring. The chapters can be played in any order, but ideally you play them in sequence. In each chapter, each player takes a different character role — Frodo, Gandalf, Sam, Pippin, Farmer Maggot, etc. — and each character has a condition that must be met in order to pass the chapter and advance in the story. Frodo needs to capture ring cards, for example, while Pippin wants to take as few tricks as possible. As…
429293.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring – Trick-Taking Game

429379.name: We Need To Talk: A Trick-Taking and Shedding Game About Letting Go

429467.description: In this fast-paced ladder-climbing game, players race to be the first to run out of cards. But there's a twist—when a higher set is played, you can retrieve your previous card to power up for a bigger play. Beware, though—holding onto it too long could cost you the game!
429467.name: DOTS

429491.description: Celestia, the multi-award-winning reference in push-your-luck games, comes in a Big Box including: the base game, the 2 expansions, all playable goodies, exclusive Twinples, stickers for the cards, and even a fully customizable aircraft! Ready to embark on extraordinary journeys? —description from publisher
429491.name: Celestia: Big Box

429508.description: It's the classic card game you've always loved...since right now. Partner with a friend, or deal yourself in with a hand of cards in four blazing colors, plus one that's wildfire. Win the most tricks and take the most flame tokens to win. Fuego is played over a series of rounds in which you play tricks. Clever card play and well-timed strikes will win you a trick and let you take flame tokens from opponents. Extinguish your opponent by taking all of their flame tokens or have the most flame tokens at the end of the round to win. The first player or team to win two rounds wins the game! High…
429508.name: Fuego

429649.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring – Trick-Taking Game: Gifts of Galadriel

429768.description: In Entrenched: Gallia Guards, you take on the role of a French commander during the fierce trench warfare of World War I. As the leader of your forces, it's a 1 vs 1 battle where strategy and foresight are key. Before the fight begins, you must carefully select your units, each with unique strengths and abilities, to engage in the coming combat. This deckbuilding game challenges you to use your cards as essential resources for giving orders, deploying reinforcements, and launching attacks. Your hand will determine how effectively you can move your units and dominate the battlefield. In…
429768.name: Entrenched: Gallia Guards

429943.description: Vampires has lost their war against humans and now has to live and feed in the shadows under the rules of the humans in the streets of the ancient city of Drachenburg. Are you going to be the one who returns the power to the Blood Dynasty? Players in their hand can have numeric cards or special cards. Numeric cards on their hand represents hunger and in the streets pile represents preys. The players on their turns has two options, play a special card with various effects (gain life, attack other players in various ways, etc) or they can choose to satisfy their hunger looking for preys across…
429943.name: Blood Dynasty

430023.description: In Catopomp, you are the new supervisor of a team of cat psychopomps. To ensure that no lost souls are left behind, you must lead your furry subordinates to guide these souls into the afterlife. The goal of the game is to play all your cards and not be the last player with unplayed cards. Whenever you play cards from your hand, you must also reveal one additional card and place it in front of yourself. Over time, this will form a set of revealed cards that you will need to play as well. To help you with your task, once per round, you can use one or two dice from a shared pool to enhance your…
430023.name: Catopomp

430379.description: In Lazarus Rising Games' modern revival of the classic card game, OverPower sees players assembling a team of 4 characters and building a custom deck containing associated Special cards for their team, numerical Power cards, and other tactical actions. Each character possesses a "power grid" which defines their proficiency in the areas of Energy, Combat, Brute Force, and Intelligence -- represented by a numerical value from 1 - 8. Characters also have a Threat value which determines how many points they count towards for assembling a legal team less than or equal to the maximum point…
430379.name: OverPower

430472.description: Step into a fierce battle of nature! In this card game, each player controls a set of cards numbered 1 through 9, representing different levels in the food chain. Players face off by placing cards face down, concealing their strength until revealed. Higher numbers dominate lower ones, allowing you to capture the previous card and build powerful chains. The game ends when all cards are played. The player with the highest scoring sets would win the game. With all nine cards played each round, careful planning and keen guessing are key to outsmarting your opponent. Will your cards reign supreme…
430472.name: Ocean Frenzy

430575.name: King of Tokyo/New York: Monster Pack – Luchador

430780.description: In Grunling: Fantastic Fruits, players take turns building the most valuable set of Grunlings, each with unique scoring methods. Many Grunlings prefer to be collected in sets, and some sets are modular, varying from game to game to keep things fresh. Each turn presents tactical choices, from playing Action cards and managing your Fruit Basket to drawing new cards, with a memory element adding strategic depth. Watch out for the ever-shifting Nature Effects, which change in order and type every game and often wreak havoc, and the mysterious Darklings, who limit your discard options. On your…
430780.name: Grunlings: Fantastic Fruit

430901.name: Dinner Party: Time to Get Served

430921.description: In Quattro Trick-Taking, players lay their cards into shared tricks as in a normal trick-taking game, but each player has a different bidding method for scoring, so you're not necessarily fighting over the same cards throughout the round. A four-player game lasts four rounds, and in each round you'll use a different method for bidding. You can take colored chips to indicate the color of the winning card that you'll play in a trick, or you can indicate the sum of the cards that you'll collect over the entire hand. You can indicate which colors and/or ranks (even or odd) you will not use to win…
430921.name: Quattro Trick-Taking

431024.description: Flush is a shedding card game between 2-6 players where the aim of the game is to release all of your cards, resulting in the rest of the table accruing points. Once a player reaches a set limit of points (30 is recommended), they are removed from the game. The last remaining player wins. Alternatively, the Arena format of Flush plays the game in the same way with no eliminations. Instead, 5 rounds are played with players accruing points as normal. The 5th and final round is double points. The player with the least amount of points at the end of the 5th round is the winner. The game has a…
431024.name: Flush

431082.description: Welcome to Cluckaneers, a strategy game where you and your pirate chicken crew embark on a daring adventure to collect treasure and outwit your opponents. In Cluckaneers, you and your friends become captains of pirate chicken crews, each vying for the most loot. The game combines strategic betting with push-your-luck and set collection mechanics. You'll need to manage your crew wisely and outsmart your opponents to become the wealthiest Cluckaneer Captain. Use your loyal crew members in open auction style fights for loot. Collect loot all while drafting your new crew for the next round! Be…
431082.name: Cluckaneers

431466.name: Tricky Time Crisis: the Spawn of Time

431478.description: Devious is an anti-set collection card game. Build the strongest faerie alliance over five rounds and claim the crown. To do so you must play and hold in your tableau a single faerie from each of the faerie tribes, of the highest rank possible. But be wary, a second faerie of a given tribe negates your score - and more than two plunges your score into the negatives. Seek only the highest ranking faerie from each tribe for the strongest alliance possible. But each tribe has a unique power and the ability to manipulate faeries from around the table, including your own. Gaining the upper hand…
431478.name: Devious

431680.description: DiceKeepers: EndHaven invites players into a realm of high-stakes fantasy where strategy and luck collide with the roll of the dice. Take on the roles of heroic adventurers tasked with defending the town of EndHaven from encroaching dangers—dragons, witches, vampires, and other fearsome creatures beyond imagine. Take them head on with unique allies at your side and compete to become the most renowned hero of the land. Players will take turns leading the day and completing Adventure Cards by covering all their Number Dice Slots with dice. Completed Adventure Cards net players Reptutaion Points…
431680.name: DiceKeepers EndHaven

432052.description: Tornei is trick-taking games, under the theme of joste. There are 14 cards in hand for seven tricks per deal, and players bid at each trick, using two cards per trick. Translated Introduction from the rulebook: In medieval Europe, the medieval jousting tournament was initially a training exercise and mock battle, but it evolved into a popular form of entertainment. Players take on the role of a powerful noble, leading a knightly order, and competing for honor through their order's victories. However, they also secretly bet on the outcomes of each match. This game is designed for fans of…
432052.name: Tornei

432807.description: One legendary stretch of evenings in 1970, Miles Davis and his band of the moment played a rollicking series of sets at The Cellar Door in Washington, D.C. For almost 40 years, the only way to hear these blistering cool performances was via the album, Live Evil, where producer Teo Macero expertly blended them with studio recordings. This album was also the only recording where longtime band member, John McLaughlin, could be heard playing with Miles Davis live. In this game, players will attend the early evening jam session to collect jazz personnel to form bands before the show begins. The…
432807.name: Live Evil

433378.description: Do you dare set foot inside the enchanted forest to face the Great Evil lurking within? Gather together a band of weird and wonderful heroes as you collect imps, go on side quests, and start fights with your opponents in 50 Heroes. Compete to be the first to beat the villain and save the day.
433378.name: Hero Slam

433560.description: A high-stakes memory game where strategy and risk-taking determine your survival. Outsmart your opponents by making calculated moves, shooting wisely, and using your resources to your advantage. In Trigger Warning, you have one goal: be the last survivor. Players build an 8-card gun magazine from a set of 13 chamber cards (6 CLIC and 7 POW!). On their turn, they may use any number of items and then target another player or themselves. Lose all 3 life tokens, and you’re eliminated. The game continues until only one player remains. Items are used to heal you, protect you, amplify damage, and…
433560.name: Trigger Warning

433797.description: Dino Trix: Tarot Adventures is a collection of three tarot games: Hold My Beer, Oopsie and Thread the Needle. All three trick-takers utilize a tarot deck and share similar card play and special powers. However, with scoring differences and different player counts, each game provides a distinct experience. Hold My Beer is a 3-player only game with bidding and special powers. Oopsie is a twist on Hold My Beer but is a fixed partnership game with slight differences in special powers and scoring. Thread the Needle is a 4-5 player game that shares the same basic card play and similar special…
433797.name: Dino Trix: Tarot Adventures

434082.description: As a member of an elite order of mages, you must harness your magical skills to defeat the dark sorcerer Dalthor. Roll dice to cast a variety of spells—each with unique effects and risks—strategically planning your moves to outwit and overpower Dalthor’s dark magic. —description from the designer
434082.name: Hexslayer

434143.description: Push your luck to complete your sequences…but your opponents also suffer the consequences! Bango is an easy to learn, easy to play card game for the whole family. Your goal is to score the most points by building up to 3 sequences of cards in front of you. Fill up your hand by revealing cards one by one, but make sure you stop at the right time to prevent an explosion! Avoid penalties by ridding yourself of excess cards before you play your cards down. When the game ends, your score depends on the length of your sequences and the most frequent color in each sequence.
434143.name: Bango

434152.description: In Entrenched: Kaiser Kompanie, you take on the role of a German commander during the brutal trench warfare of World War I. This version of the game introduces a more rigid strategic approach, where foresight and long-term planning are crucial to success. It’s a 1 vs 1 or 2 vs 2 battle that can be played in conjunction with Gallia Guards, adding new dimensions to the fight for dominance. Unlike the French forces, your deck is pre-set, giving you a solid foundation to build from, but only later in the game will you have the opportunity to expand your options with additional cards. This…
434152.name: Entrenched: Kaiser Kompanie

434170.description: Burglar’s Blitz is a strategic push-your-luck card game where players take on the roles of burglars attempting to sneak into mansions, steal valuable loot, and escape before the police arrive. Thematically, it immerses players in a high-stakes heist scenario filled with risk, competition, and clever maneuvering. Each player must manage their limited loot bag capacity, make critical decisions about which items to take, and contend with the unpredictable effects of action cards. The gameplay revolves around drawing and managing cards. Players can draw cards from the deck or a junk pile, adding…
434170.name: Burglar's Blitz

434348.description: Ready for a bird-fun push-your-luck game in which you flip each off? In this crazy game, you draw cards from the deck and place them face down or face up in the row of cards. Whoever correctly recognises whether there are already too many birds in the row of cards shout ‘You've got a bird!’ to the person whose turn it was before and receives cards that later earn valuable points. But be careful: If you risk too much or make a mistake, you will give the other players the points! The game ends when the draw pile has been used up. The winner is the funniest bird, er ... the person with the most…
434348.name: Bei dir piept's wohl!

434422.description: Pirates are plundering Celestia's flying cities and escaping. Embark on a perilous chase in your aircraft to catch them before it's too late! Coordinate efficiently to foil numerous ambushes... but without being able to tell each other everything. Includes 2 3D aircraft to assemble! The Celestia universe expands in this cooperative game for 2 players with limited communication, mixing chase, risk-taking and strategy. During your journey, cleverly share cards to foil ambushes. Anticipate your partner's hand, because if one of you, on his turn, can't fight a die, the aircraft will take damage.…
434422.name: Celestia Duo

434870.description: Strange fish swim beneath your boat. Things with too many eyes, too many teeth. These eldritch anomalies are worth a small fortune, provided you’ve got a dauntless heart and an iron stomach. Shallow Regrets is the leaner cousin of Deep Regrets. Pull up unsettling curiosities in this strategic horror fishing game. Who knows what strange creatures lurk below the water's surface? Each turn, the active player reels in 2 fish from the shoal(s) of their choice. They may choose one to keep in their boat. Unkept fish return to the shoals. Each fish has a strength value: to keep it, the player must…
434870.name: Shallow Regrets

435652.description: In Ptit Pois ("Easy Peasy" in English), get rid of your cards and end the round when you think you have the lowest score... But be careful, you don't know all your cards! Will you take the time to reveal them? On your turn, play your cards on one of the 2 discard piles, respecting the direction set by the Up&Down card: either go up in value, or go down. Don't hesitate to change this direction to gain an advantage and slow down your opponents! Anticipate your actions to get rid of the cards you have in your hand or in front of you at the right moment (some of which are hidden at the start) to…
435652.name: Easy Peasy

435806.description: You’ve all been naughty, but which one of you will get caught? You and your classmates are becoming restless and messing around in the classroom while the teacher is writing on the board. However, the teacher can hear you and it is really starting to annoy him. Sooner or later, he is going to turn around and catch one of you in the act; it had better not be you! It is a card game which is played in 3 rounds. Players receive 6 cards will play 1 card from their hand simultaneously during each turn. Each card has a number which will have 2 functions: 1. The card will be worth that amount of…
435806.name: Detention

435838.description: Form your Bear Paws to obtain the coveted Honey Jar for your Bear-tastic friends with Bear With ME!!! In this fast-playing card game, the goal is to collect the best combination from the Bear Runs to make your Bear Claws. Score points for making Full Bear Claws with your Bear friends. Through strategy and a little luck you will be ready when the Bear Paw appears. But be sure to empty your hand of high points or else lose the points you gained. Gather the most points and consider yourself the bear-ist of friends. Earn 3 Honey Jars so you and your friends can be proclaimed the Bear-tastic…
435838.name: Bear w/ Me

435846.name: Paper Pinball: Season 2 – Escape the Vent

435871.description: Awaken the trickster in you! Introducing another 18+ game from Black Mamba, this time offering a fresh twist on the classic game of Blackjack (21) like you’ve never seen before. Build your own deck throughout the match with the most unexpected cards inspired by pop culture and other famous games, giving you a wide variety of effects to help you “outsmart” your opponents and break the casino’s bank! Manipulate your results without going over 21 in this thrilling deck-building game for 2 to 4 players, where cheating is allowed—as long as you don’t get caught, of course...
435871.name: Gambetto

435873.description: Sadhana: The Path, is a climbing card game designed for exactly three players, where they take on the roles of Lamas (Tibetan monks) seeking balance on their spiritual journey toward enlightenment. Players perform Sadhana (meditative practices) using Yidam (guiding deity) cards throughout their many reincarnations, striving to reach and tame the elephant meeple—an allegory for "The Great Mind"—on a path formed by cards. Sadhana is a race for wisdom, where the winner is not the one who reaches the end first (transcending to the state of Buddha), but rather the one who successfully tames their…
435873.name: Sadhana

435946.description: RollDown is a 1 on 1 strategic dice/card game. players pose as gods acting out holy wars from a heavily abstracted point of view, all just to score points against one another. Each player commands six martyrs represented by dice of ascending sizes. players also receive three blessing cards that they can use for powerful effects that can directly change dice values or reroll multiple dice at once. Capturing an opponent’s die requires you to sacrifice one of your own. you and your opponent will always have an equal number of dice in play. The player who makes the final capture takes all the…
435946.name: Rolldown

435967.description: Dive into a wacky world where the most absurd conspiracy theories come to life. Your mission? Be the first to collect 7 cards from the same category (Space, Technology, History, etc.) while outsmarting your opponents. But beware: with devious Action cards, chaotic Events, and the mysterious Shepherd and his Sheep, everything can change in an instant. Cunning, strategy, and a dash of luck will be your best allies to outmaneuver the competition! Simple, explosive, and fun for everyone! With rules that take less than 2 minutes to learn, this hilarious party game is perfect for both beginners and…
435967.name: Petits Complots entre Amis

436.description: Canyon is a trick-taking game in which players try to predict exactly how many tricks they will take. The number of cards in a hand increases and then decreases in size. A correct prediction gives your marker movement points around a scoring track depicted on a river in a canyon, whose main feature of interest is a section of "rapids" near the finish line where your marker will be "caught in the current" and sent back a few spaces if you go too many hands without a correct prediction. Re-implements: Bid & Bluff Expanded by: Grand Canyon
436.name: Canyon

436118.description: The game is a competitive fishing adventure where players take on the role of fishermen, exploring various fishing locations and attempting to catch the most valuable fish. Players use dice rolls, strategic card play, and bait management to outwit their opponents and maximize their score. Each fishing location is represented by a stack of fish cards, and the game board provides multiple areas for players to compete over prime spots. On each turn, players can perform one main action, such as casting their line by rolling dice to form sequences that match the requirements of fish cards. Players…
436118.name: Риболови (Fishermen)

436178.description: Bid Coin is a trick-taking game where players try to win a number of tricks over several rounds in ways that sum to combinations a 1, 2, 3, 5, and 7. When a player wins a trick, if it exceeds their current bid, they must use one of their current bid cards to increase their bid. If at the end of a hand, they have won a number of tricks equal to exactly their bid, they discard the bid cards used that round. The first player to discard all of their bid cards wins. There are also 0 bids and if no player is able to discard all of their bid cards after a few rounds, then the player who has the…
436178.name: Bid Coin
publishers: 卸売センターサンエイ (Oroshiuri Sentaa San'ei)

436401.description: Not all wars end, nor do the good guys always win. There are eternal battles where sometimes the bad guys win. Good versus evil is one of these endless confrontations... until today: The day when you can put an end to this endless bickering, or let it continue again and again until the end of time. Good & Evil is a simple and fun, fast-paced card game in which 2 players choose a side—Angel or Devil—to play against each other. The goal is to capture as many enemies in their cages as possible.
436401.name: Good & Evil

436489.description: In Mankind Madness, a secret nationality, a trip around the world, and a bunch of prejudice cards you can use to your own advantage or against others help you race to the cities of the world. But beware, your actions can also damage the environment and ultimately lead to Armageddon, thus "Game Over" for everyone. Each player in Mankind Madness starts with a secret identity and a random Ideology - which gives specific player traits. The goal of the game is for players to visit a number of cities and be the first to return to your home city. The gameplay is turn-based and begins with the first…
436489.name: Mankind Madness

436788.description: Monkey Thieves gathers from 2 to 8 thieves in the packed Indian city streets. Throughout the game, you will seek to outsmart your opponents with the help of cheeky monkeys to become the most successful of the thieves. To do so, you must skillfully manage your hand of cards, steal and retain valuable items, and perform actions to give you an edge or thwart your opponent's moves. There are three game modes to choose from, each with its unique objective.
436788.name: Monkey Thieves

436820.description: A cheeky party/card game about Real-Life S#!T! Everyone gets dealt some S#!T to Deal With (cards). Players take turns trying to deal with their "S#!T" to earn sweet-sweet good-feels (victory points) and win. Fine upstanding players will play Healthy Ways to Deal cards and spend coins to deal with their S#!T (cards). Players can use cards and coins from their own hand, or negotiate for additional cards and coins from other players. Chaos agents and desperate players might turn to the Unhealthy Ways to Deal cards that will help in the short-term.... but for a PRICE! A little luck, good choices,…
436820.name: Deal With Your $#!%

436935.description: The cutie pie corgi pups just want to snuggle. They cluster and clamber, making adorable doggie pyramids. Sadly, it’s not always so easy to climb and some pups will be left below the pile. But at the end of the day, for a little corgi pup, that may not be such a bad thing. After all, no one wants to fall off the top of a big corgi pileup! Corgi Pileup is a trick-taking game in which only the last trick counts. During each trick, you must “climb” by playing cards greater than or equal to the highest card played so far, or else play your lowest card. Each round, you score your final card and…
436935.name: Corgi Pileup

437051.description: Das wurmt is the short card game about long worms that get longer until they are short enough. There are worm ends on the playing field, each with a head card in the same colour. If you turn the head, you ‘discover’ a worm appendix, which makes this worm grow longer. However, the actual ‘growth’ only becomes visible when the next head is played and the previous head is turned over again. As not all worm appendages are the same, some worms can grow faster and others slower, depending on which card is played. Worms that appear at the ‘ideal length’ earn their discoverer bonus points, while…
437051.name: Das wurmt

437109.description: Makoto, which means “sincerity" in Japanese, is a climbing card game with hidden depths and beautiful illustrations that show the journey of a Ronin through the countryside of Japan. Each player starts a round with a hand of cards that range from 1-16, and a number of cards are dealt face up in the center of the table as a "blind". The lead player of a round plays a combination — a set of one or more cards of the same value or a run of at least three cards — then players in turn either play the same combination (with at least one higher card) or pass, which does not remove you from the round.…
437109.name: Makoto

437177.description: Join AriZona in their fight to stop inflation! Use your cents card to reach 99 cents without going over. On you turn, play 1 card and announce the new total, then draw back up to 4 cards. If you hit 99 cents, you get a can, and the round continues at 99. Keep it at 99 cents: get a can! Go over 99 cents: lose a can, start a new round. Collect your favorite AriZona tea flavors including green tea, watermelon & sweet tea! Rules: Add your cents cards to the center pile to raise the pot to 99, but don’t you dare go over Get to 99 by throwing down special cards to influence the pot For every 99…
437177.name: Arizona: Great Buy! 99 The Game

437183.description: Jurassic World Cage Breaker is a game full of thrill and excitement! Can you rescue the Velociraptor out of the cage safely? Winning or losing the game depends on the card you pick…! Rules: Take a card from either pile and flip it over. Select a dial and turn it as many times as indicated on the card. Blue breaks out of the cage randomly! —description from the publisher
437183.name: Jurassic World: Cage Breaker

437268.description: Hello, my name is Eli and welcome to Twosocks. I only wish it was under better circumstances. Once a thriving and prosperous market town, Twosocks, under the rule of the Evil Lord Zadorf, has become a deceitful, uncivil place populated by thieves and beggars. For many years now, I have compiled a compendium with the aim of defeating the evil lord and liberating my town from his tyranny. Alas, just when I have the secrets to his defeat, age and ill health render me powerless against his might. I therefore implore you, my friend, to undertake this quest for me. I know I ask a lot but the…
437268.name: Twosocks

437349.name: Zoo King: Dice Tower Promo Cards

437886.description: Each player has their own deck of Fl!p52 playing cards(regular deck of cards + 5 Wild Cards), or the Fl!p52 App which can take the place of a deck of cards. The game board represents the 52 cards in a regular deck. Players place their 50 chips in "stacks" on the board to represent the cards they want. Players then start flipping cards off their deck in sequence. If they flip a card the matches their stack on the board, they remove that stack. The players race to be the first to remove all of their stacks from the board. Chips remaining on the board are counted and tallied. There are factors…
437886.name: Fl!p52

438119.description: A fearsome dragon is threatening to burn all the villages in the kingdom! Luckily dragons are greedy, so if you can bribe him with treasures from the battlefield like a barbarian's axe or a phoenix feather, you might persuade him to spare your village. Unfortunately, other villagers in the kingdom have the same idea. Who can best time their bribes to ensure their treasures are most valued by the dragon when the game comes to an end? In Please Don't Burn My Village!, which is set in the world of Castle Panic, you want to bribe with the right treasure at the right time to keep the dragon's…
438119.name: Please Don't Burn My Village!

438452.description: Compared to Krass Kariert, the differences are: Different hand sizes for a 5 player game. Krass Kariert has four lives (ends when a player can't hand in a chip). Combo Up has three lives (ends when a player hands in their last chip). Combo Up has additional new rules for the new Pick Up card (all other players take a card). Combo Up has additional new rules for the new Pass Along card (all other players take a card).
438452.name: Combo Up

438511.name: Rebel Princess: Deluxe Edition – Happily Never After

438519.description: In Azardtia: First Impact, players compete on a ruthless prison planet, using strategy and resource management to overcome obstacles and outmaneuver opponents. Only the most cunning will escape in this dice-and-card-driven board game. On their turn, players roll two ten-sided dice to determine movement, choosing between their sum or the difference between both values. Landing on certain spaces may lead to confrontations or force the drawing of action or penalty cards. Additionally, players draw and play cards that provide strategic advantages, hinder opponents, or alter the game state.…
438519.name: Azardtia: First Impact

43868.name: The Adventurers: The Temple of Chac

438733.description: Sauros is a dinosaur themed trick-taking, puzzle game where players win tiles to then place on their player mats to align suits and symbols for dynamic scoring. The twist is the trump suit changes with each trick! Featuring five asymmetric player mats and unique scoring conditions, each mat representing one of the five dinosaurs present in Sauros. The game is played in a series of rounds. At the end of each round, the player mats are rotated. Once each player has played each mat, the points from all rounds are tallied and the player with the highest score wins. —description from the publisher
438733.name: Sauros

438736.description: Dive into the magical world of the Alebrijes! In this colorful card shedding game, the goal is to get rid of all your cards. Improve your hand and strategically play cards with special effects to outplay your opponents’ combinations. Try to play all your cards before everyone else. At the end of each round, any cards you haven’t played will give you negative points. The game ends after the third round, and the player with the fewest negative points at that time wins. —description form the publisher
438736.name: Alebrijes

438827.description: Fast-Paced Family Fun for All Ages: Protect your carrots from a sneaky rabbit in this quick and easy family card game full of laughs, comebacks, and unexpected twists. Perfect for kids, teens, and adults who want fun game night moments without complicated rules. Draw, React, and Save Your Carrots: On each turn, draw a card and take action. Gain carrots, lose carrots, or grab them all. But watch out, if the Carrot Bomb appears, you must defuse it fast or lose every carrot you collected. Quick to Learn, Easy to Replay: Designed for ages 6 and up, Carrot BOOM plays in just 10–15 minutes and can…
438827.name: Carrot Boom!

438840.description: Numberwang is a must-follow trick-taking game with a trump suit that cannot be led until it has been broken. Shared incentive bidding warps the gameplay of this simple trick-taking game with a standard deck of cards. Before each hand, look at each player’s cards and bid how many tricks you expect them to take. Everyone’s seen your cards, so trip them up by making counterintuitive bids and surprising plays. Score points for bids that you hit exactly, and score bonus points if you can force other players to miss their bids. Earn the most points to win. Let’s play Numberwang! —description from…
438840.name: Numberwang±

438975.description: Assemble your crew, captain your ship, and take on the high seas in this legacy co-op trick-taker! In Sail Legacy, you and your best matey will go on an adventure across thirty unique missions. Upgrade your ship, outfit your characters, and tune the deck itself to avoid a watery grave! Sail Legacy evolves from the core Sail game mechanisms as you cooperatively use "must-follow" trick-taking to take on the unforgiving ocean — and the mythical beasts that call it home. Based on the combination of symbols in the trick, you'll steer the ship, charge ahead, or fire the cannons. Throughout the…
438975.name: Sail Legacy

439190.description: In this clever card game, you score points mainly by collecting sets of coloured Easter eggs. But different colours score differently, and the value of a set is not proportional to the number of cards in it! The challenge is to decide whether to lay down a set with fewer cards or wait for more cards to maximise your score. You begin your turn by drawing cards. You can draw up to 3 cards this way – unless you draw a bunny card. If you already have a bunny, those two will give you points and you can continue drawing, otherwise you must stop. In the second phase, you can do various manipulations…
439190.name: Hímes tojások

439298.description: A ruthless card game of deception, betrayal, and strategy! The Krazy King has a deadly illness, his many children come to his deathbed and he says a parent should not have a favourite child so will throw the Crown and the Fortune in to the middle of the Ocean but if he only had 1 child he would leave everything to them — creating greed within the hearts of all the Royals. In Fight for Inheritance, you’ll need to outmanoeuvre, outwit, and outlast your rivals by avoiding assassination to be the last one standing and claim the crown. Players use deception, alliances, wealth, and sabotage to…
439298.name: Fight for Inheritance

439643.name: Tiny Tina's Wonderlands: The Chaos Chamber

439654.name: Trick Tac Toe: A Cat's Game

439721.description: The Swindler's Chest includes all gameplay content from Emerald Skulls and Goblin Vaults. The chest also includes a double-sided playmat (one side for each game) and 3 plastic trays for easy game setup and storage. Additionally, the larger box supports sleeved cards for both games! This Swindler's Chest includes the following items (all sold separately): Emerald Skulls (base game content) Emerald Skulls: 7-8 Player Expansion Goblin Vaults (base game content) Goblin Vaults: Gundur Pack + Chaos & Order (Mini Expansions) Swindler's Playmat Admin Note: This entry is set up to reflect the above…
439721.name: Swindler's Chest

439743.description: Jirafas y Chacales 3 ("Giraffes and Jackals 3") is a fun collaborative game to apply Non-Violent Communication. With giraffes and jackals as protagonists, players must achieve "Collective Growth" and "Group Openness", without drama or impositions, before falling into "Endless Communication" or "Mental Saturation". Does it seem easy to you? It is! It is easy to learn to play, but not to win! Will you be able to maintain humanity in this crazy conversation? Each side of the card has a phrase. The game consists of having a crazy conversation and saying the phrase of the card you play. First we…
439743.name: Jirafas y Chacales 3

439758.description: In Monkey Mayhem, players race to get the lowest hand until BANANA! Someone grabs the banana and ends the round. But look out: if the WRENCH gets grabbed, then suddenly the HIGHEST hand wins! Monkey Mayhem is guaranteed chaotic fun for monkeys of all ages!
439758.name: Monkey Mayhem!

439771.description: You never imagined that it would come to this… The Earth shakes. The Air is foul. Fires burn. Waters rise. So much destruction. So much chaos. So much knowledge lost… And now, magic itself is dangerously out of balance. The Elements pool. The leylines are… off. None still alive remember what pattern the leylines used to take, what the magic is supposed to look like, to feel like. The lore contradicts itself. Some accounts describe magic as a network of energy, connecting all living things, a web of sorts. Others describe a great circle surrounding and maintaining our world. However; one…
439771.name: Charge the Circle

439803.description: A card game about collectively baking bread, while trying to let the others do the work. You’re all employees in the L’Oaf bakery, but you’re just here to get paid with as little effort as possible. When it gets to baking bread, you rather let others do the work. However, you don’t want the bosses to catch you loafing. If you collectively don’t bake enough bread, the lazy among you might just get fired! Every round, players get an order with the amount of bread they collectively need to bake. Each baker secretly contributes a work card from their hand of cards, valued 0 through 11. Failing to…
439803.name: L'oaf

439804.description: Dive into a whimsical world where adventurers bring their slimy, grimy, and cursed items to be cleaned by your mischievous goblins. Collect valuable treasures while navigating the risks of handling too much dirty laundry. Will you strike it rich, or will you get burned by a cursed relic? This chaotic game requires a bit of strategy and a lot of luck to determine your success! In this card game, adventurers bring their slimy and cursed items to be cleaned by your mischievous goblins. Each round, players draft dirty adventuring gear into their own and opponents’ baskets, aiming to maximize…
439804.name: Goblin Laundromat

439881.description: Mythiko is a trick-taking, shedding card game where you play as a god of Ancient Greece, influencing humanity in Music, Literature, Tragedies, and Science—but make sure to take credit for your divine gifts! The game unfolds over five ages (or three for a shorter game). In each age, players compete to empty their hands by playing sets of cards that must be higher than the previous set played. The player who plays the highest set before all others pass starts the next round. This continues until all but one player have played all their cards. Scoring: The first player to go out earns the most…
439881.name: Mythiko

44.description: This game adds a very interesting twist to the standard trick-taking genre. There are five suits and players must follow suit, if they can. However, the winner of the trick is the highest card played, regardless of suit. The winner gets all the cards from the trick, minus the card he won it with. That card is given to the player that played the lowest card. After all tricks have been played, the scoring begins. Players score the face-value of the cards in the suits that they only collected one or two of, and one point per card for suits with more than two. The player with the most points…
44.name: David & Goliath

440157.description: Bandits have stormed Main Street, and the Law stands as the town’s last defense. In this fast-paced, 18-card asymmetric dueling game, every showdown is a test of wit, risk, and tactical decision making. With clever team construction and ever-shifting strategies, no two duels play the same. Each side — the Law and the Bandits — commands eight unique units. Select four to take the field, while the other four will load into your ammo deck. Do you play it safe with a steady hand, or gamble on high-risk, high-reward shots? With tense 5–10 minute rounds, every match provides a chance to test…
440157.name: Quickdraw: Battle for Silver City

440214.name: Grendel: The Game of Crime and Mayhem

440282.description: Don't let the cuteness fool you! Fluffypede is a quick, easy to learn but very deep card game where players are building a series of Fluffypedes while trying to out-score the rest. Take turns adding Part cards to one of the 3 Fluffypede Heads in play. Each Head has its own goal: how many parts and of what type they need, influenced by a dice. Part cards have two sides, with a different number and type of body parts each, and you decide in which way you play them. But beware: Only the player who puts the card that makes the Fluffypede reach exactly the goal it needs, scores all of it! Each…
440282.name: Fluffypede

440321.description: Paws, Paper, Scissors – a fun family card game where you play as teenage monsters competing with classic rock, paper, scissors combinations. On your turn, choose a gesture card to beat your opponent’s move. Use strategy and quick reflexes to be the first to get rid of all your cards and earn a token. The player who collects two tokens becomes the champion in this monstrously fun twist on the classic game! —description from the publisher
440321.name: Paws, Paper, Scissors

440394.name: Bannish!!
publishers: ぷあぷあイデオロギー (Poor Poor Ideology)

440474.description: Roll. Battle. Steal. Loot. Dungeon-crawling mayhem in your pocket! DuelGeon is a 1–4 player PvPvE extraction game packed with wild loot, brutal monsters and dungeon-crawling chaos. Pick your hero, Fighter, Rogue, Sorceress or Wizard, and dive in. Fight monsters, mini-bosses and bosses for treasure. Keep an eye on your rivals, because the best loot is the loot you take from them. Then get out alive with your haul. Play solo and push your luck for a high score, or battle up to three rival adventurers to see who escapes the richest. Every card is hand-inked black-and-white art by Buster Cagle.…
440474.name: Duelgeon

440505.description: How long can you climb the highest snowy mountains on the planet? Rely on your partners in Snow Climbing, managing your resources in an innovative cooperative climbing mechanic. Be careful not to lose important items and try not to cause an avalanche. Surviving the cold is only part of this extreme challenge! In this ladder climbing game, cards represent the players' gear when climbing the mountain. In each turn, a person plays a card that has a larger number than the card on the top of the climbing pile. Another possible action is to "Change Route", adding the values of two cards of the same…
440505.name: Snow Climbing

440544.name: トリック帝王-秩序の魔女 (Trick Emperor: The Witch of Order)

440619.name: Best Board Game Ever: Build Your Board Game Empire

440749.description: This is a unique climbing game for 2 to 5 players, inspired by Korea’s traditional tightrope walking culture and its rich storytelling. Just like a Flying Artist maintaining a precarious balance in the air, numbers fluctuate, and suit powers shift dynamically, creating an engaging and strategic experience. Feel the thrill of skillfully playing your cards while immersing yourself in the vibrant colors and cultural essence of Korean tradition. —description from the designer
440749.name: Gokyesa: The Flying Artist

440850.description: Captain "Mako", a veteran of the sea, stood at the helm of his fishing boat, the Invincible, as a storm raged around him. The waves rose like menacing giants, lashing the ship with relentless fury. The wind howled like a hunting wolf, but Mako did not waver. His eyes were fixed on the horizon, where he knew the perfect catch awaited him, hidden in the tumultuous depths... Welcome to The Fisherman, the board game that puts you in command of a deep-sea fishing boat ready to sail uncharted waters in search of the perfect catch. Choose your ship, your crew, the items to load on board, and prepare…
440850.name: The Fisherman

440869.description: Watercolor is a game of gentle oneupsmanship. Two players will play higher and higher numbers in hopes of being the first to run out of cards in their hand and collect a Prize card. Players will use digit cards to compose their numbers (for instance, a 5 and a 3 can make a 53 or 35). Every time a player plays a number, they’ll have to take a card that was already on the table into their hand, which means their best-laid plans will oft go astray in dynamic and exciting ways. Players will get a new Skill card each round, and can use them to disrupt their opponent or buttress their own plans.…
440869.name: Watercolor

441614.description: 3 Tricky Pigs is a thematic trick-taking game for 3-5 players. Players take on the role of the 3 little pigs, where the laziest pig will win each trick if there is no wolf around. However, if a wolf is in the trick, the highest card will win. Players earn points by making correct bids on how many tricks they will win each round. The player with the most points at the end of 4 rounds is the winner. —description from the publisher
441614.name: 3 Tricky Pigs

442078.description: Animal Parade is a solitaire game for kids and adults. The deck comprises beautiful animal cards, which help you be the first to complete your parade! You must be the first player to earn 10 points on the scoreboard to win the game. This game is designed for Adults and kids to enjoy. In "kid mode," you can play with younger kids. —description from the publisher
442078.name: Animal Parade

designers: Suzuki Takayuki (鈴木 タカユキ)

442315.description: Jump Away! is a cooperative game where players unite to help a brave knight escape the dragon and return to his kingdom. By playing platform cards and using special abilities, players work together to build the fastest and safest path. But beware—every mistake brings the knight closer to the dragon's hungry jaws. Will the knight make it home in time, or will the challenges prove too much? The goal of the game: collect four golden keys before the dragon catches the knight. Each turn, players lay out platform cards for the knight to jump on. Each platform brings either a bonus or a…
442315.name: Jump Away! The Platformer Card Game

442337.name: Kansas City: The Tricks and Trains Expansion

442412.description: Area 51 Pick Up is a fast-paced, push-your-luck card game where players take on the role of Bun-Aliens (adorable alien bunnies) attempting to rebuild their spaceship and escape from Area 51—all while dodging agents determined to capture them! Gameplay Overview: On their turn, players draw cards from the pile, aiming to collect all six spaceship pieces needed for escape. However, every draw presents a risk—hidden among the cards are agents and hazards that could jeopardize the mission! Players must decide whether to push their luck for more rewards or play it safe to secure their progress.…
442412.name: Area 51 Pick Up

442438.description: Bunnington Valley invites players into a light-hearted, charming world where they embody crafty and adventurous bunnies on a mission to collect the most valuable harvest from the local farms. The journey is filled with excitement and challenges as players travel from farm to farm, dodging the watchful eyes of farmers and their ever-alert farm dogs. Each turn as a bunny “traveler” presents a mix of strategy and surprise, with opportunities to gather precious Harvest Items and deliver them safely to their Cellar. But beware—every step of the journey is fraught with risks like Farm Dog chases,…
442438.name: Bunnington Valley

442512.description: Movie Tricks is a unique trick-taking game: Play cards to determine turn order. In turn order, grab cards from the market. All played cards form the market for the next round. At the end of the game, score points in different categories, like Best Movie, CGI, Props, Roles, and Soundtrack. If you do not win, you may at least brag about the coolest title! —description from the designer
442512.name: Movie Tricks

442639.description: In The Adventures of Tintin: The Trick-Taking Game, players must uncover the hidden plot cards of their opponents by searching for clues in locations scattered across the world. Each location card has a different rule for winning tricks, so the player who wins the trick in a given round can ask a question about the plot card belonging to the owner of the location card — provided they meet the requirements of the character cards played that round. As the game progresses, players eliminate false leads in their notebooks until someone reaches a conclusion and correctly deduces another player's…
442639.name: The Adventures of Tintin: The Trick-Taking Game

442646.name: スートアタックモンスター (Suit Attack Monster)

442903.description: Welcome to New Droptown, a city pulsating with neon lights, urban graffiti, and an unbreakable passion for street soccer. Born from Incident Zero, a mysterious blackout in the summer of 1987 when the global AI system S.O.C.C.E.R. (Sports Observation, Coordination, Control & Evaluation Routine) crashed and reshaped the world, this town lives and breathes for street soccer and games. How It Plays In Street Side Strikers, each Player controls a Team of Kids in a fast-paced, arcade-style street soccer brawl, powered by a wild and glitchy AI System called S.O.C.C.E.R. At the start of every Round,…
442903.name: Street Side Strikers

442992.description: 단청은 단청토큰이라는 새로운 시스템으로 전통 윷놀이의 전략과 난이도는 유지한 채 현대적인 룰로 재해석해 만든 보드게임입니다. Dancheong: Yut-nori with cards (Disney edition) Dancheong - Beautifully decorated by drawing patterns in various colors on traditional korean wooden structures. It is a card game that reinterprets the traditional Korean game of yutnori in a modern way. When it's your turn, you can open up to five yut cards. Move the meeple as much as the opened cards. You can't move the meeple if you get a Yut card of the same color during the opening! Instead, the left player moves the meeple. If you get the same color card, except for the…
442992.name: 단청 : 카드로 하는 윷놀이 디즈니 에디션 (Dancheong: Yut-nori with cards – Disney edition)

443074.description: In Rebel Princess, the princesses fought off unwarranted marriage proposals from pesky princes. Twenty-eight days later, the princes returned...as zombies! The zombie horde is growing. It began with the princes, but it has spread to the local villagers, the adorable woodland creatures, and even our noble knights! The rebel princesses are the last of us. If they fail, the kingdom will fall forever into darkness — a true and horrific Zombieland! Zombie Princess is the sequel to Rebel Princess. Just as Rebel Princess was a thoughtful modern spin on the classic trick-taking card game Hearts,…
443074.name: Zombie Princess

443195.description: Looming high above a forgotten village stands the remains of a forgotten cathedral. On cloudy nights such as this, only the flickers of a few candles light the empty aisles, bringing warmth to the five sole inhabitants: Parm, Brie, Gouda, Jaq, and Colby. With only embers of light to shield them from darkness, the purring wind wraps and winds its way through the pews, fueling the fears of our five little mice. Spine-chilling specters of carnivorous creatures haunt their dreams. Images of cat claws, glistening snake fangs, and ominous owl eyes lurk in every corner of their minds. Will their…
443195.name: Haunted Mouse

443210.description: Dans la cour d’école ("In the schoolyard") is a quick and interactive card game for 3 to 6 players, ages 6 and up. It recreates the nostalgic feeling of school recess, where players secretly embody a character and try to collect the best combination of playground treasures hidden beneath a pile of fallen leaves. Each turn, players draw three cards — marbles, toy cars, bricks, or chestnuts — and must choose wisely: one card is kept, one is given to another player, and one goes back under the pile. Some cards trigger fun mini-games like Rock-Paper-Scissors, adding surprises and disrupting…
443210.name: Dans la cour d'école

443314.name: Operation CanCon: Canadian Eighties Music Shopping Gamebook

443408.description: Brushstroke Mayhem is a card game of chaotic creativity. Players build abstract artworks while outmaneuvering each other in a strategic mess of color and control. Players choose a Painting from the Open Market at the beginning of the game. They gain new ones later on. On their turn, players layout cards from the Brushstroke draw deck into either a shared canvas or their personal canvas. They then use these cards to match the abstract painting cards. The first player to complete 3 paintings, wins the game. Advanced rules bring extra mechanics like color effects and disruption to add more…
443408.name: Brushstroke Mayhem

443489.description: Chikki is a competitive ladder-climbing game using dominoes for 2 players. The objective is to play all of your tiles first. In Chikki, players can match, or play higher ranked combos to shed tiles. The combos can suddenly escalate to higher combination types when a six suited meld is played. Also, players will have to draw tiles during the play and struggle to keep the lead. —description from the designer
443489.name: Chikki

443490.description: On the 18th of June 1815, Napoleon was defeated at Waterloo. The allies decided to exile him to the remote volcanic island of Saint Helena in the South Atlantic. A few plots were made to save the former Emperor from his exile between 1816 and 1820, but none of them succeeded. But what if one of them had succeeded? Here is YOUR chance to rewrite history by rescuing the Emperor from his exile! Needless to say: it won't be an easy task. Release the Eagle is a hand management/deck building card game. In their turn, the players will be able to draw, play or reveal certain cards on one of the 7…
443490.name: Release the Eagle

443530.description: In the swirling currents of a feeding frenzy, even the smallest fish can rise to power… if they stick together. In this vibrant, underwater card game, schools of fish compete to dominate the feeding grounds by grouping up and chasing each other off. Outsmart your rivals, time your plays, and try not to be the one left behind when the food runs out. Gunjo Gradation is a climbing game where cards of the same number can be grouped to form stronger plays, letting weaker fish gang up on bigger ones. But leftovers matter: unplayed cards cause penalties at the end of each round, and only matching…
443530.name: Gunjo Gradation

443601.description: This is a modded version of Palace, also known as Shithead or Karma. We made it more intuitive so kids can pick it up easily. We also made it more vengeful by introducing mechanics to get back at the person on your right (the one who's usually bullying you). Here are some of the changes: Redesigned and simplified the card hierarchy: 1 to 10. No suits, no color, no faces, no aces. Special cards now have unique designs instead of numbers (BURN, RESET, GHOST). New special cards were added to get back at the person on your right: SKIP, MIRROR. This increases the deck size from 52 to 58 cards.…
443601.name: Payback

443651.name: Vineyard: A Winemaking Game – Local News Mini-Expansion

443942.name: The Little Flower Shop: Open for Business

443965.description: Players manage a row of four face-down cards, secretly viewing only their edge cards at the start. Each turn, choose to either take a visible card from the discard pile or draw blindly from the deck. When drawing, decide whether to keep the new card by swapping it with one of your hidden cards, or discard it immediately. The challenge lies in remembering which edge cards you've seen while strategically improving your hand through careful swaps. Special action cards add tactical options: peek at your own cards, steal from opponents, or force unwanted exchanges. The round ends when a confident…
443965.name: CatutO!

444302.description: VARZ TCG is a tactical trading card game set in a modern world where urban legends come to life. The game is played with custom card decks, a hex-based battlefield map, and tokens used to track life, damage, and positioning. It is primarily designed for two players, though alternate formats allow up to six. In a standard match, each player brings a Hero, a 30-card Main Deck, a 9-card Skill Deck, and two Portal Decks placed in the opponent’s territory. At the start of the game, players set up the hex-grid battlefield, place their Hero, and position their Portals. Players then take turns…
444302.name: VARZ TCG

444479.description: Crisis is a card-based party game set in a fictional, unstable world where nations are constantly pushed to the brink of collapse. Instead of competing for dominance, players lead countries desperately trying to survive waves of unpredictable global and local crises. The setting is grim and dramatic, yet the tone of gameplay remains light and accessible, focusing on clever interaction and tactical card play. The game supports 2 to 4 players, each managing their own country represented by population and territory cards. Players draw from a shared event deck, which contains both useful cards…
444479.name: Криза (Crisis)

444684.name: Operation CanCon: Canadian Nineties Music Shopping Gamebook

444693.name: 7th Sea: City of Five Sails – Fate and Fortune

444879.name: TroubleZ Run! Revenge of the Jellynator

445029.description: A western boom town falls square onto a poker table! Most points wins! Worker placement with poker chips! Multi use cards! Super streamlined design! Generous doses of engine-building and player interaction! follow the design journey on Instagram! @theLimestoneCowboy —description from the designer
445029.name: Hold'em High

445123.description: In Lunar Trick / ルナトリック, you need to win exactly one, three, or five tricks in a round to score points — and to collect tricks, you need to manage the phases of the moon. To start a round with three players, deal ten cards to each player and set the remaining card aside. Cards are 1-15 (rising moon), 16-30 (falling moon), and the lunar eclipse card. Each player reveals a numbered card at the same time to determine the trump and three suits. For example, if rising moon had more cards played, then it's trump. If the cards are, e.g., 5, 12, and 24, then the three suits are 6-11, 13-23, and…
445123.name: Lunar Trick

445142.description: Depot is a climbing/shedding card game that can be played by 3 to 5 players. The goal is to get rid of all your cards before the other players. You can reduce your hand by playing a card with a higher value than the previous player. Even if the number is smaller, you can still play cards if the combination contains more cards.
445142.name: Depot

445143.description: Not all hands are created equal but in this game, you get to rewrite your fate. In a high-strategy twist on classic Daifugō, players use special “segments” to alter the digital numbers on their cards, transforming weak hands into powerful plays. Whether you're adding bars to a 1 to make it a 7, or trimming a 9 into a 3, the key to victory lies in clever rewiring. Segnum is a ladder climbing and shedding game inspired where players manipulate the numeric values of their cards using physical segment chips. Each turn, players may play cards, pass to earn segments, or spend them to modify card…
445143.name: Segnum

445426.description: Deal the cards according to the number of players, create the deck, and start the round! The order of ranking for the round is determined by the players who run out of cards first. Earn points based on your ranking in each round. If you reach 5 points, you get a "check" (one step away from victory)! If you take 1st place during your "check," you win!
445426.name: Birds

445476.description: Off With Their Heads! is a clever reveal-and-write game where players serve as loyal Card Soldiers tasked with keeping the mercurial Red Queen pleased. Influenced by a wide range of classic card games including poker, hearts, and euchre, players secretly choose and reveal cards from their hands to compete for position in each bout. The ranking of the revealed cards determines whether you place highest, lowest, or somewhere in between, and that result dictates where you record the card’s value on your personal score sheet. Each section of your sheet rewards a different strategy. Claim the…
445476.name: Off With Their Heads!

445503.name: Clumsy Room Maids
publishers: 卸売センターサンエイ (Oroshiuri Sentaa San'ei)

445510.description: Odyssey sends players on a perilous journey across the Mediterranean as soldiers trying to return home after the Trojan War. Guided (and often hindered) by the whims of the gods, players must earn offerings and navigate divine favor carefully. Too much pride or neglecting rituals risks invoking the gods’ wrath, delaying the voyage back to Ithaca. Odyssey is a trick-taking game where players can play not only from their hand but also from a shared field of cards. Winning exactly the right number of tricks allows players to advance their ship along the board, with progress tied to the offerings…
445510.name: Odyssey

445513.name: 仲良シふれんず りにゅーある (Nakayoshi Friends Renewal)
