publishers: 限界サムズアップ (Maximum Thumbs Up)

445518.name: トリックハンティング (Trick Hunting)

445521.name: The Magic Hand and Three Elements
publishers: もんきちゲームズ (Monkichi Games)

445540.description: You are farmers, recruiting cows as allies to try eliminate enemy farmers. Scientists tried making cows with more desirable beef and heightened breeding effiency. Although their original experiment was a success, it came with a strange side effect, a thirst for weaponry. Common Cows is a fast paced card game where the aim is to survive the longest. Each player takes turns playing a card from their hand to either grown their own health or to damage others. Watch out as you hand can be stuffed by the portable stuffing cards, which may force you to play cards you don't want to.
445540.name: Common Cows

445613.description: Being like everyone else is boring! In this trick-taking game, embracing your unique identity is the path to victory. Each player secretly declares how many tricks they aim to win, even negative numbers are valid, by using two cards from their hand. Then comes the battle of bold plays, bluffing, and unpredictable results as players try to match their declared outcome. Identity is a trick-taking game with a unique bidding system and a custom Must Not Follow rule. Each trick, players must play face-up cards that differ in both number and suit from cards already on the table — if they can.…

445617.name: ゲボドバ Bar (Gebodoba Bar)
publishers: 世紀末Games (End of the Century Games)

445621.description: In a chaotic contest of animals with strong opinions and no fixed rules, players race to empty their hands but the rules of play change as often as the cards themselves. When you're stuck and can't play, there's only one solution: change the rules! Whether you're guided by a boar’s brute logic, a crab’s sideways thinking, or a dung beetle’s questionable taste, this game embraces absurdity and spontaneity in equal measure. A Boar, Crab, Dung Beatle is a fast-paced, rule-shifting shedding game where players take turns playing cards to the center pile, aiming to be the first to run out. But when…
designers: イワムラ タクヤ (Takuya Iwamura)
445621.name: A Boar, Crab, Dung Beatle
publishers: キューハチドッグ (Que Hachi Dog)

445643.name: Quintet
publishers: メリーアンドリューワークス (merry-andrew-works)

445646.name: Puppy Stars: Master, Look at Me!

445671.name: Operation CanCon: Canadian Classic Music Shopping Gamebook

445785.description: In Club of Cthulhu, 2–4 players assume the roles of daring researchers performing forbidden rituals to glimpse the secrets of ancient gods. Each turn, players “sacrifice” a manuscript into one of five arcane decks, invoking omens and triggering deity powers as they push their luck in a delicate balance between revelation and madness. Omens drawn from the ritual circle reveal which gods are stirring. Matching three or more signs of the same deity grants that god’s blessing—and unlocks powerful abilities. But each blessing also limits your endgame scoring, and drawing too much divine attention…
445785.name: Club of Cthulhu
publishers: Play With Us Design (玩聚設計)

445847.name: In the Shadow of Neon Lights

445851.name: Turf War: Unicorn City – The Expansion

445918.description: Match Fixer's High / 大体八百長レース is a climbing game in which players take turns playing stronger combinations of cards to advance along the race track. Every time you play a combination, your meeple moves forward a number of spaces equal to the number of cards played. Reach the ninth space or beyond to cross the finish line. Just keep two simple things in mind: First, race to first-place with true sportsmanship, and enjoy the glory of a shiny but not-so-useful trophy, or Team up in the match-fixing scheme and finish second to walk away with cold, hard cash — which is worth more than honor, isn't…
445918.name: Too Sloth To Win

446065.description: In Bog Hollow Brigade, you play as imaginative friends exploring the wilds of Bog Hollow, using everyday items to take on daring Adventures. Each round, choose a Careful or Courageous approach and push your luck through a series of Challenges using cards from your personal deck. Manage your hand, press onward, and make the most of every outing. When Nightfall arrives, the player with the most Glory in Loot and Awards wins! A game of Bog Hollow Brigade is played over several rounds called Adventures. Each Adventure consists of Challenge and Loot cards revealed one by one by the Leader. Players…
446065.name: Bog Hollow Brigade

446078.description: In a strange little kingdom of competitive climbers, each team evolves through five seasonal battles. With each match, new cards are added, and the rules change — demanding clever adaptation and precision planning to reach the top. Tabletop Climber is a climbing game played over five rounds, where players build a hand from an expanding pool of cards. Each round introduces a new rule that reshapes which plays are strong or weak. Victory depends on crafting the right hand for the moment, managing card strength and combos, and outmaneuvering rival teams through changing conditions.
446078.name: Tabletop Climber
publishers: ハレルヤロックボーイ (Hallelujah Rockboy)

446142.name: 私だけの晴天 (Watashi dake no Seiten)

446143.description: Inchiki Daifugo is a ladder-climbing card game built around variant rummy-style grouping and strict hand management. Your goal is simple: be the first to empty your hand. Despite the name “Cheat,” there is no bluffing—success depends on numerical ordering, combination efficiency, and careful timing. Low cards and high cards are equally important, and precise hand control is essential. Normal GroupsCards can be played as standard groups, such as multiple cards of the same number (e.g., 3-3-3-3). Up to two colors may be mixed within a group. Variant Groups (“Cheat”) In a “Cheat” group, the…
446143.name: /Slash
publishers: 篠原遊戯重工 (Shinohara Yugi Juko)

446162.description: Adorable, ferocious animals appear out of nowhere and survival is not an option. You can’t fight them, you can’t reason with them, but you might trick them into fighting each other while you slip away. Outsmart the chaos before you're the last one left… and the one who pays the price. Ratel is a climbing game where players try to shed their hands by playing cards with values from +5 to -5. Cards must be played in ascending order, but each card has a twist: positive numbers are strong but add that many cards to your hand, while negative numbers are weak but let you discard extra cards. The…
446162.name: ラーテル (Ratel)

446163.description: It’s summer break, and your mission is clear: finish your homework, chase after bugs, and write the best summer journal of all. But as you climb the social ladder of insect collecting, only those who take clever risks and manage their energy well will return with the best memories — and the most tokens to prove it. Enikki is a climbing game for 3–4 players where hands are played out in traditional Daifugō style, but with a betting twist. At the start of each round, players place a hidden or open token bet on their performance. The top performer collects two tokens, middle ranks get one, and…
446163.name: 絵日記 (Enikki)

446164.description: In this reality-bending version of Daifugō, a mysterious pair of ruby-red glasses changes what you see — and what you can play. Hidden numbers, redacted information, and lucky dice rolls create a party full of surprises as players race to empty their hands while navigating shifting visibility and unexpected turns. It's Daifugō… but with a twist of optical illusion. Ruby Eye Daifugō is a climbing game where players attempt to shed all their cards using traditional Daifugō mechanics with a twist: some cards contain hidden numbers revealed only by removing or wearing ruby-colored glasses. During…
446164.name: ルビーアイの大富豪 (Ruby Eye Daifugō)
publishers: ルビーアイの大富豪 (Ruby Eye's Billionaire)

446166.description: In the grasslands of Africa, bigger meerkats command more attention—but sometimes size is just a bluff. In this cheeky battle of wits, players take on the roles of clever meerkats trying to rise to the top of the pack. But not every claim to size is real. Can you play your cards right or call out your opponents' lies and come out on top? Shake It Meerkat is a climbing and bluffing game where players aim to shed their hands by playing increasingly stronger sets. Each card has a numeric value and an illustration of a meerkat. The bigger the number, the larger the meerkat image. Players can lie…
446166.name: Shake It Meerkat

446218.description: Sobresaliente is a competitive "push your luck" board game, quick, simple, and with tremendous replayability! In Sobresaliente, players compete to get the highest score in the exam, but it's not about answering academic questions. The game tests your strategy, intuition, and ability to manage risks, while trying to accumulate points without going over the limits. Objective of the game: The goal of Sobresaliente is to be the player who gets the highest score in the exam at the end of the game. To achieve this, players must make decisions on when to take risks and when to stop, trying to…
446218.name: Sobresaliente

446269.description: The demon Mephisto offers Faust worldly honor, wealth, and pleasure. Seeing this as a chance to pursue his ideals and satisfy his boundless curiosity, Faust accepts the deal. Faust vs Mephisto is a two-player trick-taking game where Faust must resist Mephisto's temptations and explore four domains for two rounds. If Faust takes all or none of the cards in any suit, Mephisto claims that domain. If Mephisto claims two or more domains, he wins the game. Otherwise, victory belongs to Faust. Whose ending will you choose—Faust's redemption or Mephisto's triumph? —description from the publisher
446269.name: Faust vs Mephisto

446286.name: KUSOGE TRICK
publishers: Bodoge Radio Kenkyukai(BoardGame Radio Study Group)

446314.name: In the Shadow of Neon Lights: the Expansion

446442.description: The fiery feline spirits, released from their sealed book, are up to mischief again today. They do as they please, meddling with others' plans just for fun. Freed from the pages of ancient books, the mischievous fire-cat spirits known as Quashars roam the world in search of chaos and fun. Driven by impulse and mischief, they chase their whims while sabotaging the plans of others. Every round is a new prank, a new diversion, and a new challenge. You are one of them... can you cause the most playful mayhem? Quashars is a trick-taking game with a unique condition-based bidding system. The bid is…
446442.name: Quashars

446466.description: A tranquil summer camp deep in the woods turns into a blood-soaked nightmare. Shadows stretch long under the moonlight, and somewhere out there, a killer is stalking the cabins with a crimson blade. You and your companion must gather your courage and supplies to escape this slasher’s hunt. Your only chance is to work together, outsmart the darkness, and survive the night. The Slasher is a cooperative trick-taking game for two players that blends deduction, tension, and cardplay. Players face off against the game’s system by playing tricks under restrictive and evolving conditions, attempting…
designers: タカハシ カツナリ (Katsunari Takahashi
446466.name: The Slasher

446469.description: In Payback, cunning is your currency and survival is your only strategy. Each player builds their own stage of play, using card combinations not only to rid their hand but to strike at opponents to the left and right. As players rush to go out first or outlast the chaos, every move could provoke retaliation, or open the door to fortune. Payback is a climbing and shedding game where each player plays combinations to their own personal board instead of a shared central pile. There are only two types of valid combinations, simplifying choices while sharpening strategic tension. Every play can…
446469.name: PAYBACK
publishers: シュピールディスオーダー (Spieldisorder)

446492.description: Climb the social ladder — or kick it over. The trick-taking game Tax the Rich features a deck depicting characters of various social ranks from the Poor to the President. Each round begins with a simple bidding phase to determine both the trump color and the number of tricks required to score bonus points. The winner of the bid must then acquire the required number of tricks, together with their ally. The game is played as a trick-taking game in which the highest social ranks are the strongest cards. However, if at any time all remaining cards in your hand have a flag symbol, you may trigger…
446492.name: Tax the Rich

446693.description: The Galaxolotls had a great time on Earth! But now it’s time for them to return to their home planet. However, as soon as they land, the old rivalry between the two big Galaxolotl families rears its head. Who arrived there first? And who will claim the best spots? Exciting thrills and risky decisions are guaranteed! The player with the most star points at the end wins the game! Thrills through exciting risk-taking decisions Simple rules, clever tactics Features hilariously alien Axolotl cards —description from the designer
446693.name: Galaxolotl

446811.description: Bear Beware is a two player competitive game of survival. Collect supplies by drawing from the supply deck to build up your camp. Each set of supplies gives you a new ability in game, but be careful... There's bears out there! The goal of the game is to survive the entire year, as you play through each month (starting in winter). The further along in the game, the more bears awaken and the more dangerous the game becomes! If both players survive the full year, then the winner is decided by points gathered along the way. —description from the publisher
446811.name: Bear Beware

446820.description: In the lab of the eccentric Dr. Barabara, numbers are never what they seem. Each card can be broken down into parts, a 6 might become two 3s, three 2s, or even 1+2+3. In this chaotic experiment of numerical dissection, players scramble to shed their hands using clever recombinations and surprise prime number plays to dominate the discard pile and rise to genius status. Dr. Barabara's Bunkai Daifugō is a climbing game where every card represents a number that can be "decomposed" into smaller numeric sets. For example, a 6 card may be played as three 2s, two 3s, or a 1-2-3 sequence, giving…
446820.name: バラバラ博士の分解大富豪 (Dr. Barabara's Bunkai Daifugō)

447093.description: Chutney is a climbing-shedding card game for three players using a standard deck of cards. In each Deal, one player bids to be the Dipper and plays alone against the Moochers, the other two players in a temporary partnership. The Dipper’s aim is to be the first player to have no cards left. The Moocher’s aim is to stop the Dipper from playing all of their cards first.
447093.name: Chutney

447094.description: Pikel is a domino climbing-shedding game for 2 players. Players may not rearrange their hand nor rotate dominoes. Unlike other climbers where you can not sort your hands, you can play combinations using any dominoes except the ones that are directly adjacent. Pikel uses a single set of double 6 dominoes, where players can freely play different combination types on each other, with each combination type having an effect on play. Dominoes played from your hidden hand get sent to your open hand, where they must be played again (or removed through combination effects). Pickling can be a long…
447094.name: Pikel

447115.description: PocketParks is a set collecting card game featuring all 63 US national parks with gameplay inspired by Chinese Mahjong. From Acadia to Zion, it has it all! Each cards features original photography of the park shot by the designer. Cards also include GPS coordinates of the location where each photo was taken to help inspire others to go explore the US national parks. The goal of the game is to get the most points over 3 rounds and points are earned based on how many and how big your sets are. Sets are created based on 16 different distinguishing theme icons that help define features of the…
447115.name: PocketParks

447183.name: Lying Judge (うそつきジャッジ)

447253.description: Warlords of the Steppes is a competitive, easy to learn and roll to slay game. You play as a legendary warlord with unique powers who wishes to be the next Great Khan. You draw recruits from the deck, train your warriors as dice and slay monsters with rolls. The game is set in a steppe landscape, enriched with mythological elements. Players aim to increase their fame and glory, and secure the people's support to etch their names in history in golden letters. The steppe is a perilous land, constantly under siege by mythological foes. Warlords send warriors recruited from the youth to face…
447253.name: Warlords of the Steppes

447258.name: 帰ってきたウルトリテン (Return of Ultriten)

447378.description: Welcome to the playground! In Tricky Kids, you and your classmates are trading toys and snacks in a chaotic kid-economy where value is totally made up. It’s a trick-taking game with a twist: you write the numbers on your cards. At the start of each round, you assign values that total 21 across your hand then use those cards to try to win tricks and collect points. Each round consists of 7 tricks, but the goal is to win tricks strategically, not just frequently. Each trick earns you a point token, and the leftmost available token is always the one you claim (so timing matters!). The tokens…
447378.name: Tricky Kids

447491.description: This is a 1-4 player Dungeon Crawl using press your luck, card management and deck building to resolve quests for 4 characters in a solo or Co-op vintage-style card game. You win the game by completing 6 mini-quests for each character. You must do this as a team in multiplayer or control all 4 characters in solo mode. You will draw a dungeon card from a deck of 150 cards and try to resolve it. The card will have a puzzle or encounter, or, maybe a nice bed to rest in… There are many things to do in the deck. Movement and combat are controlled using an action deck of 100 cards. You will be…

The direction card starts as "Up". The lead player plays either a single card or a set of sequential cards, and other players must play a matching but higher set of the same size. Each time a player any number of cards showing "UpDown" are played, the direction card is flipped, and the "better" hand will now be the opposite direction. If a player can't or doesn't want to play, they pass and draw a card from the deck,…
447646.name: Up Down 30

447683.description: Once, happy critters thrived in peace until one day a fire dragon claimed their treasures and homes. Now, hope rises! Assemble your band of fearless critters, sneak into the dragon’s fiery domain, and snatch back the riches of your ancestors! In Crispy Critter, players send their critters deep into the dragon’s cave, stacking any duplicate cards to grab the most treasure. The more critters in your stack, the bigger the haul. But beware! The longer you stay in the cave the greater the risk of waking a hungry dragon, eager to turn your brave adventurers into a crispy snack! Play your cards…
447683.name: Crispy Critters

447703.description: The coolest skaters have confidence and swagger, pushing their skills to the limit to land the newest, raddest trick. Sick Tricks is a must-follow trick-taking game with four suits (numbered 1-12), with one being the trump suit. Instead of bidding on how many tricks you'll win, you bid on how many different "tricks" you'll land, tricks with conditions like "Win with an even number", "Lose with an 8 or higher", or "Win 4 tricks in a row". When a round starts, players place cubes to predict the number of trick cards they think they'll complete. Skaters will score big for completing tricks, but…
447703.name: Sick Tricks

447720.description: Harvest season has begun! The garden is in chaos and the forest animals have come to help you… although they might just make things worse! In this fun set collection game, each player tries to collect their favorite vegetable—but must do so in secret. Your goal is to make your favorite vegetable the most common one in the groups being formed… without letting anyone else figure out which one it is! Can you confuse your rivals, make the best combinations, and win the harvest? Grab your basket, plan your strategy, and get ready to laugh with the garden animals! Game Objective The player who…
447720.name: Locos por los vegetales

447930.description: You just have to get rid of all your cards. Easy, right? Not quite. You also have to declare how many turns it’ll take. Every action costs a precious token, and every token misused (or unused) costs you points. Precision is everything. Miscalculate, and you might pass too early... or too late. Switch To is a fast-paced shedding game for 2–4 players with a unique declaration mechanic. Players “bid” how many turns they think it will take to shed their hand. Each turn you play cards, you spend a token. Each pass lets you flip a token into a wild card (switch it!), reducing your declared count.…
447930.name: Switch To

448096.description: In Suspeição, we find a crime scene with 4 pieces of evidence, and all players are suspects. Each round, a new crime scene is prepared using randomly numbered cards, and a small board leaves only 4 of these numbers exposed, which will be the incriminating evidence for that round. Each player receives 4 cards and, on your turn, you must use the actions of your cards well to try to find this evidence in the hands of the other players, while trying to keep some of this evidence hidden in your hand, if you have any, guaranteeing positive points for doing so. At the end of each round, the…
448096.name: Suspeição

448154.description: Meow10 is a quick, light-strategy card game for 2 to 5 players featuring colorful and quirky cat cards. The goal is to get rid of all your cards by matching either the number or the color of the card on the discard pile—or by using the powerful rainbow cat! On your turn, you may play as many cards as the number shown on the discard pile’s top card, provided they match the color or number. If you cannot play, you must draw penalty cards. Special rainbow cards can match anything and offer tactical flexibility. The game ends when a player empties their hand, the draw pile runs out, or a player…
448154.name: Meow 10

448179.description: Pipoca is a two-player game that doesn’t require a table or much space — you can play it standing up, leaning against a wall, or even while waiting in line at the movies. It’s perfect for passing the time while waiting with someone. It’s 18-card game micro climbing game where the goal is to get rid of all your cards. You can play melds and upgrade your cards whenever your opponent beats them. Previously discarded cards return to your hand when you pass. The first player to go out wins the round, and the overall winner is the first to win two out of three rounds! —description from the designer
448179.name: Pipoca

448204.name: ホワイトランナー (White Runner)

448271.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers – Trick-Taking Game

448324.description: The best liars know when to lie and, more importantly, when not to. In the game of Pinocchio, you must assess whether the sum of all cards drawn has exceeded 21. Everyone announces their numbers, but can you discern truth from deception? Lying may not always win, but honesty can be a dangerous game too. In Pinocchio, you take turns drawing a card and announcing what number it is (you may lie). If you think the sum of everyone’s cards is more than 21, instead of drawing a card you may declare a challenge. If you are right, the player before you is cursed. Otherwise, you are cursed. The game is…
448324.name: Pinocchio

448326.description: Get ready to rev your engines in this thrilling card game where you and your friends race against the traffic light, betting on whether to speed through or slam on the brakes, while cunningly shifting the light’s color with "Accelerate," "Brake," or "Brake Check" cards to unleash the epic Ibaraki Dash—a daring solo "Go" on yellow that scores +2 points—bluffing and strategizing your way to be the first to hit 5 points and claim victory! —description from the designer
448326.name: Ibaraki Dash

448344.name: トリックオブザキラートマト (Trick of the Killer Tomatoes)

448387.description: Via Gladiola is a fast-paced ladder-climbing card game inspired by the legendary Nijmegen Four Days Marches. Over four rounds—one for each day—players try to finish the march with as few blisters as possible. Each day starts at kilometer 0 and ends at 50. On your turn, you either "walk" by playing a higher card to the pile, or “stand still” and draw a penalty card. You can safely advance up to 5 km. Go 6–10 km ahead and you must draw 1 card; 11–15 km costs you 2. Anything more isn’t allowed—you’re pushing too hard. On day 4 only, the 'gladiola' cards can make your life a little easier, as you…
448387.name: Via Gladiola

448388.description: Thunder is about to strike! The bamboo shoots in the precious bamboo forest will be devastated. As the chiefs of various panda villages, players compete with each other for bamboo shoots and fight against thunder to protect them and prevent evil spirits from infiltrating. Luck or clever construction? There are so many combinations waiting for you to discover! Who is the final king of bamboo shoots? What are you doing in the game? Players dispatch various pandas to the bamboo forest area to collect bamboo shoots. When they move back to the village area, they immediately harvest a random bamboo…
448388.name: 夺笋呀! (Panda Battle: Grab bamboo shoots)

448425.description: November 1983 — After practicing all year, it's time for the big roller disco competition. The best jam skaters from around the world have gathered with their finest skate gear under the glare of the mirrorball. Synth-pop booms from the speakers. Who will hit the right rolls and land the right moves to be crowned the champion of the roller disco? Roller Disco is a fast-paced card game in which you play sequences of skate cards around a mirrorball with the objective of shedding your cards first. Combining ladder-climbing mechanisms with unique route-building, you must choose if you are "Movin'…
448425.name: Roller Disco

448428.description: A trick-taking game where teams change every round and new rules are added as you go! Moustache blends strategy, surprises, and twists in a joyfully competitive atmosphere. Moustache is a twist-filled trick-taking game for 3 to 6 players. In each round, teams are randomly reshuffled, and a new rule shakes things up: reversed color hierarchies, wild jokers, card effects… nothing stays the same for long! Thanks to an evolving rules system and Team cards, every game is unique and demands constant adaptation. It brings the immediate fun of trick-taking, spiced up with a touch of controlled chaos.…
448428.name: Moustache

448496.description: In Fearless, you walk through a gloomy forest and try to stay on the safe path. If you still wander astray, you try to turn back again as close as possible. The closer you are to the safe path, the less fear you will suffer. Not walking at all is no alternative as you'll remain behind on your own in the scary ruin. If you are the most fearless after several rounds, you will win the game! Fearless is a simple trick-taking game with four suits and without trump. The card with the highest value in the led suit always wins the trick. The unusual part of the game is the card values as they are not…
448496.name: Fearless

448739.description: The quickest bird rules the roost in this fast-flying card game! Race to get rid of all your numbered bird food cards before the other players. Fend off sneaky squirrels, chase down wiggly worms, and build cozy birdhouses—while keeping up with the frantic, free-for-all fun! It’s energetic, it’s wild, and it’s every bird for themselves. Play is simultaneous. Players aim to get rid of their cards by playing a card that is one number higher than the one on the discard pile... or by playing an identical number and shouting 'down' to change to descending numbers. But when a player plays a special…
448739.name: Early Bird

449089.name: A Strong War: The Conflict for North America

449100.description: In Obriady Kola Roku ("Rituals of the Wheel of the Year"), you become a Keeper of Traditions, guiding the rhythm of time through ancient Ukrainian celebrations. From singing spring Vesnianky to lighting Kupalo fires in summer, from preparing harvest feasts to invoking protective forces in winter — each ritual card shifts the energy of the season and reshapes your path to victory. Your goal is to complete a harmonious cycle of rituals before the year turns. On your turn, choose from four actions: draw from the ritual deck, play a card to strengthen your cycle, disrupt others with events, or…
449100.name: Обряди Кола Року (Obriady Kola Roku)

449297.description: The monsters are terrorizing the fairground. You dive into a crazy bumper-car ride and try not to lose your nerve. Who will be the first to get scared? In this trick-taking game, you don’t want to win too many tricks, because each trick carries the risk that your character gets scared. The braver you play, the more points you can earn. —description from the publisher
449297.name: Ghostbumpers

449349.description: After centuries of slumber, dragons have awakened and returned to the realm. Rival guilds now seek to reassemble the ancient dragon scrolls, legendary texts said to contain the long-lost secrets of taming these powerful beasts. With only partial sets in their possession and no way to succeed alone, guilds must exchange fragments to complete their scrolls and claim mastery. Choose carefully. The right piece could bring you closer to control. The wrong one might lead your opponent astray… exactly as you intended. In Dragon Scrolls, players compete over three rounds to build the most powerful…
449349.name: Dragon Scrolls

449441.description: Game set-up: Shuffle all the cards and form a draw pile in the centre of the table. The first player is chosen at random. How to play: Each player, in turn, completes the following steps: They MUST draw a card from the pile and place it, face up, in the centre of the table. If a card of the same sport has already been drawn, the new card is placed on top. When a flag card is drawn, it is placed on the table, face up. Then, they MAY, if they wish, take all the cards of the same sport (the entire column) from the centre of the table. The sport chosen may be different from the card they have…
449441.name: Aquarush

449450.description: Work on a day like today? No way. Time to call in sick. Hopefully no one else had the same idea. It's a hilarious climbing shedding game fun for the whole family! Use Up All Your Sick Days is simple. There is no turn order and you need to play a card with the next day or same worker currently on top of the discard pile. But if go to play at the same time as someone else, you both leave the card and draw a 2 cards as a punishment. (You also can't play after yourself, and you could play a card face down as a doctor's note, making it wild.) Play all your cards to lose a tired worker token and…
449450.name: Use Up All Your Sick Days

449773.name: The Adventurers: The Temple of Chac

449922.description: A dice and auction game for 3-4 players in which the players have to make the most of their dice luck to win as many towers as possible. Players may use all or some dice again to push their luck - or fail. —description from the publisher
449922.name: Tower Me

450053.description: In Tricky Twist, losing tricks can often be more important than winning them. If you manage to retrieve the card you played, it comes back to you face up as a “false trick.” To multiply your victory points (★), you must not only balance the number of tricks and false tricks you have but also optimize the cards you’ve transformed into false tricks. For example, you might try to align all your false tricks into a perfect sequence of values. Simply devilish… —description from the publisher
450053.name: Tricky Twist

450111.description: The eternal cycle, from Sun to plant, from plant to prey, from prey to predator, and so on, as the cycle continues eternally. The goal of the game is to create large sets of cards to score points and win the game when the deck runs dry, however you may also gamble to win the game regardless of score, or lose if you can't get what you need to win the gamble. Each turn you may take one of three actions, draw and discard, take and give, or gamble. At anytime during your turn you may make exactly one set of cards from those in your hand, that either being a straight of cards in numerical order or…
450111.name: Eternal

450252.description: Players create and manage their own corner stores in the big city, competing to attract quirky customers. Every potential shopper is unique. Learn their behaviors and try to cater to the finicky populace! The goal is to earn enough $$$ to win the week! (there are 3 weeks played in the standard game). Bonus points are awarded for having a packed store and special card plays. Action Cards inject some wild extra surprises into the chaotic flow. Players can also earn Promotional Signs that help attract specific customers, and obstacles that hinder the foot traffic. Shop 'Til Ya' Drop is a…
450252.name: Shop 'Til Ya' Drop

450318.description: Get ready for bluffing and partnership with a card game that will test your wits. In Blefadores S/A, each round is an opportunity to deceive or be honest. Each player receives 2 cards and the sum of their values determines their starting score. The catch? You can tell the truth about your cards or bluff, because you want to partner up with other players, since your final score for the round is your starting score plus the score of the player you partnered up with in the round.
450318.name: Blefadores S/A

450321.description: A shedding game in which you play cards from your hand according to specific rules and aim to win by playing all your cards as quickly as possible. Use the power chips you can earn by passing and manipulate your rank to overcome unfavorable situations.
450321.name: Exceed and Exchange

450337.description: Howdy, partners! In the sun-baked dust of Dusty Gulch, where shadows stretch long and strange, disagreements find resolution not with a six-shooter, but in the Rowdy Ring. Here, common sense yields to the thrill of a wrestling match, proving that in this corner of the Wild West, might makes right — one suplex at a time. Rowdy Partners is a team trick-taking game played over a series of rounds, with each round being composed of eight tricks. Work with your partner to beat the other players by draining their health through calculated strikes and sneaky counters. Swap wrestlers mid-match,…
450337.name: Rowdy Partners

450526.description: The Radiation Game is a simple game of trying to stay alive. You take turns picking up cards, occasionally taking radiation points, and using action cards for some exciting twists. Once you’ve built up 10 radiation points, you have taken too much radiation damage and can no longer win, but any future radiation cards you pick up, gets passed onto the person with the least radiation! The last person to not reach the deadly 10 radiation points, wins!
450526.name: The Radiation Game

450553.description: Steaming broccoli isn't as easy as it looks! Time it just right and cook up a perfect place of green goodness. Just be careful that you don't botch the broccoli and have to start all over! In Don't Botch the Broccoli, players have an identical hand of broccoli cards numbered -1 to 4 and simultaneously play one card each turn. Any players who played the same number on their broccoli card move their card to their steamer. Then whichever player played the lowest remaining card gets to cook their broccoli (move the card to their score pile), along with any cards in their steamer from previous…
450553.name: Don't Botch the Broccoli

450569.name: The Adventurers: The Pyramid of Horus

450679.description: Wizard Arena is a fast-paced card battle game for two players. Draw cards to build up a Power Level that is higher than your opponent, but not too high or you take damage. Cast Spells to outplay your opponent and find strategic ways to use powerful combinations of spells. Each player gets their own Magic Faction with unique spells. With more Factions coming in future expansions. Learning time: 5 minutes. Play time: 15+ minutes. In the box: 58 Power cards, 48 Spell cards, 2 Reference cards and 1 rule sheet This is a standalone game for 2 players with the two Magic Factions- Fire and Ice. You…
450679.name: Wizard Arena: Fire and Ice Edition

450829.name: The Adventurers: The Tomb of the Pirate Queen

450879.description: Grain Bingo is a two-player card game that highlights the push-your-luck mechanism. Players connect cards featuring various quantities of grain in horizontal, vertical, or diagonal lines. You win when you successfully line up the nine designated grains in a row.
450879.name: Grain Bingo

451065.description: In That's Mine (or Minero) players take turns flipping cards from the draw pile and placing them on the table. Be ready to think quick and slap fast if you want to claim the gems, gold nuggets, and diamond cards for yourself! But don't wait too long... if four sticks of dynamite are flipped, the mine will blow and wipe all the remaining treasure off the table! Once you've reached the end of the deck, the mine is empty and whoever claimed the most valuable objects wins!
451065.name: That's Mine!

451096.name: Blood of Lions: The Somme – 4th British Amy Sector: July 1916

451194.description: Market Fortune is a financial strategy card game about decisions under pressure. There is no board. On your turn you take one action: Build (draw a Stock or a Return, then discard one), Risk (pair a Stock and a Return from the same industry and roll the Fortune Die to form an investment) or Dominate (take a Strategy card: weapons, shields and master strokes). The first player to form four investments worth a combined 25 million wins. Money exists only on the cards: no real money and no betting. In the box: 180 cards in three decks of 60 (Stocks across 12 industries, Returns, and Strategies in…
451194.name: Market Fortune

451199.name: FreeLancers: Wanderers of the Lordless Land

451358.description: The hotel you chose in Tokyo had pretty good reviews, but something seems off. The attendant at the front desk seemed nice enough, if maybe a little anxious. You've checked in and are heading up to your room. The elevator doors open on the second floor (nikai)...wait, did you see that? The doors close and open again on the third floor (sankai). I swear I saw something down the hallway - you really didn't see it? The doors close and open again on the fourth floor (yonkai) - hold on...did you just hear "Yokai?" What is happening here?? Yonkai no Yokai is is a climbing/shedding game for 3-4…
451358.name: Yonkai no Yokai

451636.name: The Crimson Queen: The Battle for Wonderland (Combo Edition)

451667.description: A light strategic card game matching cats to the spots in the house they love to sleep in. Players match cat cards with colored spot cards (like a bed or sofa), aiming to create a sequence of descending scores (4, 3, 2, 1) of the same color on a cat card to score points at the end of the game. The "best spot" isn't a single location but is the goal of creating these sequential runs of spot cards to earn points for your cats, which is a central mechanic of the game. Two versions are playable - a junior version for younger ages and all the family, and a more strategic version where you have to…
451667.name: Best Spot in the House

451772.description: In Shards of Creation, harness the primal forces of Brandon Sanderson's Cosmere! This innovative trick-taking game is designed for players of all skill levels. Every Shard is an aspect of divinity: Autonomy, Cultivation, Devotion, Dominion, Honor, Odium, Preservation, and Ruin. Each is an entirely unique suit, with different values and abilities. Will you win by focusing on one Shard’s influence, or by forging a coalition of Shards? Shuffle up a different combination each time you play, making every game a new experience!
451772.name: Shards of Creation

451923.description: In Shadow Cards, players secretly predict how many points they want to score in that round. Before each trick-taking round, two cards from their hand are chosen, whose value also determines the points to be scored. The question always arises: Do I set aside the high numbers to score a lot of points at the end, or do I keep them to make it easier to win tricks during the game? Those who combine instinct and strategy can prevail and win after three rounds. —description from the publisher
451923.name: Shadow Cards

451930.description: In this clever card game of bluff and timing, players must collect exactly five Spheres of the same color to score a point. But beware — if you go over five, you bust and lose all cards of that color! On your turn, choose one of two cards: the face-up card (where both color and number of Spheres are visible), or the face-down card (which reveals only partial information: either the color or the number of Spheres). Then decide: will you keep the card for yourself or give it to another player? You must choose before revealing the card! Players arrange cards in their play area by color. If you…
451930.name: Camelio

451972.description: Gold! Gold fever has possessed us and together with other miners we enter a gold mine through 3 galleries, ready to get more gold than anyone else. But beware, there seems to be a waterway that could flood the mine at any moment… In 3 rounds, players will take turns to obtain gold cards, tools... use or sell the tools found, go to the “bank” to secure the gold obtained, try to get to the end of the galleries first (this is where the most gold is found)... all with the aim of winning the game by being the one who manages to accumulate the most gold. ( Miner, gold and other icons created by…
451972.name: La Mina: The Flooded Mine

452321.description: Tomatoss is a fast-paced card and token game set in a lively tomato festival, where players grab, toss, and splatter their way to victory. Play tomato cards to meet target conditions, score points, and push your luck with daring “quick tosses” for bigger rewards. On your turn, place tomato tokens to pick up new cards or toss them at targets. Complete target card conditions to claim points. Take a chance on a quick toss by playing some (or no) cards and then revealing the top of the deck, hoping for the perfect match. Manage your hand, earn basket bonuses, and adapt to changing targets. When…
452321.name: TomaToss

452538.description: Be the first person to obtain a sequence of cards numbered 1 to 8 or to reveal all 4 honey cards, and only these 4 cards, during your turn. Turn over a card of your choice from the playing area. You can turn over a new one or end your turn voluntarily. Your turn ends immediately if you reveal a card with the same value as another card already visible in the center of the table or already in your sequence. Then turn over any untaken cards face down without moving them.
452538.name: Sweeet

452652.description: Last Night Out is a fast-paced, adult social card game for 2-10 players, designed to transform any gathering into a legendary experience. The game is the perfect antidote to boring nights, replacing awkward silences with hilarious, memorable, and timed challenges. Players start with a hand of 5 cards from a 58-card deck, each presenting a fresh, spontaneous challenge. On their turn, a player may attempt any of the challenges in their hand, earning points if successful. Challenges range from witty and humorous social interactions to creative and slightly daring tasks. The game can be played in…
452652.name: Last Night Out

452719.description: A fast 1-5 player card card where struggling bands of hapless humans try to survive a series of hilarious (but deadly) world-ending catastrophes. Players can reveal specialists or items to help them make it through the inevitable chaos, and move their population across different zones of the doomed world to mitigate disaster. The standard game consist of three rounds (three apocalypses in a row) and the one with most saved population wins! A light-hearted approach to the end of the world! —description from the designer
452719.name: Choose Your Own Apocalypse

452807.description: Baltic Year is a strategic card collection game where players journey through eight ancient Baltic celebrations. Collect card sequences and combinations while traveling the moonlight path, aiming to gather Baltic symbol tokens while keeping your hand value low. Players form sets (same numbers, different signs) or sequences (consecutive numbers, same sign) to claim corresponding Baltic symbol tokens. The game features 52 cards with eight distinct Baltic signs representing sacred celebrations like Užgavėnės, Rasa, and Vėlinės, plus 4 "Magic" cards that can become any number or sign. Win by…
452807.name: Baltic Year

452808.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers – Trick-Taking Game: Horses and Haradrim

453024.description: Welcome to Phố Phở, the most chaotic street stall in town! You are competing to inherit the Chef's legendary Phở street stall. To prove your worth, you must balance broths, herbs, and meats to serve a line of picky eaters. Phố Phở is a fast-paced, card shedding game of hand management and strategic sabotage. Players take on the roles of rival cooks trying to maintain a perfect reputation while slinging bowls of piping hot noodle soup. Work to earn the loyalty of the most famous customers to win, but watch your back—if you serve an ingredient someone hates, you can always point the finger and…
453024.name: Phố Phở

453051.description: Within the secret underworld of espionage, every agent lives on the knife’s edge. Will today be the day when your identity is exposed by the spotlight, or can you remain safely hidden in the shadows? Chasing Shadows is a trick avoidance game where players draft which suit they must follow with from a dwindling pool of cards. Be sure to limit the next player's options, and you might force them to win the trick. Taking cards and scoring points is bad, but players can cleverly plan to take specific cards that will make their previous points disappear. The player with the lowest score after three…
453051.name: Chasing Shadows

453093.description: Conversations fill the streets in Batish Columbia, as the famous film festival Batiff just finished; everyone wants to discuss their thoughts on the movies they just saw. You and your fellow fruit bat friends make to the local fruit shop to dish over a dish of delish drupes. Remember best bat manners: when someone bows out of a topic, they get to start the next one. That said, these chatty battys are known to ramble, so make sure to say your piece before your fruit goes stale! Bested Another Time is a climbing, shedding game where passing gets you perks, but beware: those who haven't passed…
453093.name: Bested Another Time

453142.description: The Burgle Bros are back—this time, the heist is at the Blackjack table! In this cooperative twist on the classic casino game, you and your crew work together to crack safes while dodging guards. Trade cards, build your decks, and plan your moves carefully—every swap brings you closer to success… or disaster. Use unique character abilities and clever tools to stay one step ahead. Can your team pull off the ultimate score before time runs out? —description from the publisher
453142.name: Burgle Bros Blackjack

453436.description: The Trilogy of 2K48 is a fast-paced, strategic card game that fuses the excitement of classic shedding games, such as Crazy Eights, with the numerical strategy of the 2048 puzzle. In Trilogy, you'll strategically combine or subtract NUMBER cards and wield powerful ACTION cards to clear your hand and outmaneuver your opponents. Objective of the game: be the first to discard all your cards. On your turn, you play cards from your hand by linking them through mathematical relationships — primarily combining and subtracting values to match or build upon the cards already on the table. For example,…
453436.name: Trilogy of 2K48

453535.description: Go Big is a fast, funny, and deceptively tactical card game where bluffing, timing, and bold plays are key to victory. Each turn, you’ll play a set of 1–3 matching cards face-up to your display, hoping they survive until your next turn, because only then can you bank them for points! But nothing is safe in Go Big. Sets can be wiped out by matching sets of lower value cards, so your high-scoring pair of 7s might be crushed by someone’s sneaky pair of 6s or maybe even a pair of 1s. The twist? You only beat the nearest higher set of the same size, creating nail-biting escapes and gleeful…
453535.name: Go Big

453728.description: Beat the Music is a fast-paced and accessible party game where players compete to collect a complete set of music cards by identifying songs and artists. Using QR codes, you scan and play music clips, then try to guess the correct artist and song title — no speed required, just a good ear (or a lucky guess!). The game includes fun twists thanks to action icons on the cards, allowing you to steal from other players, draw from the discard pile, make bonus guesses, and more. With the right mix of luck and bold moves, anyone can win — not just the music experts! With 440 songs across 12 music…
453728.name: Beat the Music

453780.description: BRIDIX is a card game in which players compete to build the most valuable bridge using numbered cards from 1 to 9. Each bridge element consists of one face-up card and one face-down card. Bridge Building: Face-up cards must be arranged symmetrically: first ascending, then descending, forming an arch (e.g., 1–5–7–5–1). The face-down card determines whether the element is safe or can be stolen. If it matches the face-up card, the pair is protected. Bluffing: Players may bluff by placing mismatched card pairs. A successful bluff speeds up bridge construction and grants bonus points. If the bluff…
453780.name: BRIDIX

453781.description: "Plot with the Square Queen, the King Let, the enchanter Roger Rob-It and the dragons Bert, Nerd and Bianca, to succeed and have control over the kingdom!" Chouineurs is a trick-taking game played in 4 rounds of 7 tricks in which there are colors, trump cards and supertrump cards! But more important, cards are two-sided, with one color and value on the upper side and others on the bottom side of the cards, and they may rotate! At the start of each round, you must choose the orientation of your hand of cards and bet on the number of tricks you think you can win during the round. If you win…
453781.name: Cry Baby

453862.description: Bazzot is a Push-your-Luck card game played with a standard deck of cards. Determine your Risk Suit, then wager how many cards you want to draw each round. If you do not draw your Risk Suit, collect the drawn cards to score. Otherwise go bust! The first to score 10 cards this way wins.
453862.name: Bazzot

453864.description: Mad Queens is a strategy Push-your-Luck card game played with standard card decks. You need one standard card deck plus jockers for each player plus one additional, the banned deck. Bank cards to collect point, the player with the most points wins. Cards are worth 1 point, Heart cards are worth 2 points. Draw cards from the banned deck to determine the banned cards. Then players draw cards from their decks simultaneously until they either bank their cards or draw a banned card. Queens don't like to play this game: if you reveal one of them, you gotta pay some points back to calm their anger..…
453864.name: Mad Queens

453903.name: Double Lucky 7: The Lucky Wheel Edition

454031.description: Rufstock is a climbing-style card game of rock ‘n’ roll dogs racing to board two buses on their way to the festival. Players receive a fixed hand of cards that cannot be rearranged, forcing them to work with sequences exactly as dealt. On their turn, they may play a combination of up to 4 cards into one of the two buses: either a Set (matching numbers) or a Sequence (consecutive numbers). Each bus has its own rule: the Kombi favors lower values, while the Bus favors higher values. However, any larger combination of cards always beats a smaller one. The previous combination is cleared and…
454031.name: Rufstock

454061.description: In Crescendo card game, you will try to be the first to organize your cards in perfect order, from the lowest to the highest number. More than just having a good memory, you will have to use logic and interact with the other players in order to be the first to claim Crescendo. Draw a card or use the special power that is available. Take a chance, react quickly, and start your engines! Memorize, Sort, Gamble (Risk), React Quickly and Interact! —description from the publisher
454061.name: Crescendo

454080.description: In the game you play as one of the teams in a football (soccer) match. The goal of the game is to score more goals than your opponent. The game is played via card selection causing the movement of the ball token across the board (football field). There are three modes of play depending on the desired complexity.
454080.name: Soccer Fantastico!

454177.description: Build your best poker hand by strategically recruiting the perfect crew for your Mission to Mars. Simply draw Cards from any of the six decks! The twist: Some of the players' cards are visible, others are hidden. Can you really be sure the others will end up with a better crew than you?! Once everyone has five cards, it’s time to shine. The strongest hand … uh, crew wins the ticket to Mars. Draw cards from any of the six decks and aim for the strongest poker hand. Bet on the best hand before drawing your last cards. Once everyone has five cards, it’s time to shine. The strongest hand wins.…
454177.name: Cosmo

454593.description: NOVE is an addictive card game that blends the excitement of Blackjack with the fun of Poker. The objective is to accumulate points by hitting cards, aiming to get as close to 31 as possible without busting. This gameplay will feel familiar to blackjack enthusiasts! You can also win points by forming powerful card combinations, such as pairs or three of a kind, adding a fun, strategic layer. But watch out! Special cards known as BABATOS and JOKERS can alter the game's dynamics at any moment, making each game unpredictable and filled with suspense until the very end. The first player to reach…
454593.name: NOVE

454597.description: Tomolapia is a competitive 2-player climbing and shedding game where players race to be the first to empty their hand each round. At the start of every round, players exchange a card. This exchange determines both the starting player and the special “level card” rank for that round. The non-dealer then chooses how many cards to discard (0, 1, or 2) which establishes a multiplier for the round’s scoring. Players then alternate turns, playing various combinations such as: singles, pairs, triples, full house, runs, or bombs (a triple plus the ♥ “level card”) and rockets (both Jokers). A player…
454597.name: Tomolapia

454608.description: In Cherry on Top, you try to place your cards as cleverly as possible in the common display to form larger groups than the players before you. Whoever does this best and discards their own cards first wins! Gameplay: On your turn you can (a) place cards or (b) pass. (a): Place any number of cards from your hand face up in the center of the table. This creates the common display. Follow these rules: All cards played during your turn must show the same color or the same fruit. You must place all cards played during your turn horizontally or vertically next to cards already in the common…
454608.name: Cherry on Top

454620.description: Players take on the role of busy bees, set out to gather as much pollen as they can before the rainy weather comes in. Score points by taking valuable pollen from the five different flowers back to your hive. Be careful, timing your return against your opponents and the weather is crucial. Push your luck to contribute and collect as much pollen as possible, and always keep an eye on the skies to head back to the hive before the rain ends the round. Each turn, all players will simultaneously play a card facedown from their hand. When revealed, players will either add pollen to the growing…
454620.name: Before The Rain

454622.description: SnapMato is a 2 or 3 player fishing card game that uses a standard card deck. Players take turns capturing matching-ranked cards from a central field, aiming to collect high-value cards and specific combinations to win rounds and score points. Players alternate turns, playing cards from their hand and the draw deck to capture matches from the central field. Certain combinations can trigger "Go" (doubling the round’s value) or "Stop" (instantly ending the round), while rare Instant Win combos triple the round’s value. Players can also raise the round’s point value using 10 cards. At the end of…
454622.name: SnapMato

454724.description: Step into the Age of Creation with Mystic Lands — the exciting new chapter in the world of Mystic Vale where every picture tells a story! Many millennia ago, before the Blight’s corruption, powerful entities known as Druids helped shape the lands. To them, many years were but as a single day or night, and they invested this vast time into creating a world of unparalleled beauty. They drew mana from the land, the beasts, and the waters to weave magic and bring new life to the world. They balanced the sun and the rain to create harmony. And they journeyed on pilgrimages to each other’s sacred…
454724.name: Mystic Lands

454829.description: Potemkin Villages is a fully cooperative trick-taking game set during Catherine the Great’s journey to Crimea. Each player takes on a different character, winning tricks to unleash unique abilities. Together, you’ll dismantle, move, and rebuild villages along the Dnepr River, creating an illusion of prosperity. Cooperation is key: the Governor can amplify the Builder’s strength, while the Painter shifts trumps to aid allies. If Catherine still beholds beauty, after there are no more cards in play, you succeed; if she sees through the ruse, you all lose. 2025 54-Card Game Design Contest: 2nd…
454829.name: Potemkin Villages

454919.description: A card game in which players take on the role of anglers and compete to catch the longest fish. Shuffle all the cards and place six of them on a common table. On your turn, you roll the dice and flip up to the number of cards you roll. There's a push your luck element and an angler may bust the catch. Each player continues to fish, and the game ends when someone gets eight cards. The winner is not determined by the number of cards played, but by the length of the fish caught.
454919.name: サカナガサ (Sakanagasa)

454961.description: Enter the epic universe of Gradalis, a strategy and atmosphere game to share with the family. Set out in search of the coveted Grail while avoiding the deadly traps and ancient curses that mark your path. With its simple yet profound mechanics, Gradalis promises hours of entertainment for young and old. Will you be able to outwit the traps and reach the treasure before the other adventurers? A must-have game for all families looking for thrills and adventure!
454961.name: Gradalis

454967.name: Wilderness: A Game of Survival (Second Edition)

455046.name: Rixes sur une mer de légendes

455077.description: In The Neckerchief Path, your mission is clear: spread the Advent Message to all the world in your generation. But be careful! Along the way, you’ll face temptations that may cause you to lose your precious neckerchief. Avoid the Sin cards and protect your neckerchief with the Jesus card. The great winner will be the one who, being pure, kind, and true, keeps their neckerchief until the end and reveals the last card of the Three Angels’ Messages. Ready for the challenge? —description from the designer
455077.name: The Neckerchief Path

455086.description: Rescue the lost sheep, build the biggest flock, and protect your little ones. Beee! The little lost sheep invites you to build a beautiful flock by flipping cards to find and rescue sheep. But watch out for the wolf—he’s out to steal your sheep! Don’t worry; the shepherds are there to help you fight him off.
455086.name: Beee! The Little Lost Sheep

455218.description: Welcome to the jungle, adventurers. Deep within lie rare and shiny treasures, just waiting to be claimed by those brave enough to reach for them. But beware! There are deadly dangers lurking in the shadows, ready to bite, poison and strangle you. Giving your competitors a chance to run off with your well deserved loot. So watch you step. But remember, no one ever got rich by playing it safe... - Dare to draw Players take quick turns drawing random threats from the draw pile. Their largest threat always enters the Danger Zone, a space shared with all the other players. - Will you chicken out?…
455218.name: Riskit

455261.name: Push Your Tennis: Edición Héroes de Atenas

455359.name: Sweets Trick Fair
publishers: iop games (イオピーゲームズ)

455436.description: Syzygy is a 2 player domino shedding game, using a single double 6 set. It features a version of must-not-follow where spots on the board get blocked through play. These spots remain blocked between rounds, and only clear out when a line of spaces is filled (which also lets everyone rotate a domino). Carefully block off spaces to cut off your opponent and shed out first. —description from the designer
455436.name: Syzygy

455444.description: Everyone is trying to get six bones. Each round a bone with a value will appear. Everyone will try to get it Blackjack/21 style. Each round players will start with 2 cards in hand. they can: take another card from central pile. replace a card in hand using the central pile or discard pile. Cards have both negative and positive numbers. There are more tweaking cards for advance players. Each player may call "to the bone!" if he thinks he is the closets to the bone score of the round. If he is wrong, he misses a bone. First player to have six bones win the game!
455444.name: עד העצם (To the Bone)

455448.description: Too many people in your shared apartment but only one fridge? Of course someone’s going to drink your milkshake! But don’t worry - you’ve got the perfect revenge: slip a little surprise in there with some laxatives. Just make sure you don’t end up drinking it yourself. And remember, think twice before “borrowing” someone else’s milk… they might have had the same idea!
455448.name: Milch mit Abführmittel

455462.description: Bored by loneliness, the cats decided to play a video game. They chose a cooperative game, where heroes (animals from Brazilian wildlife) must stop evil robots that are destroying the forest. In the end, they will still have to face their leader, a Red Dragon! This is a cooperative game, meaning either everyone wins together, or everyone loses together. The players’ goal is to defeat the dragon and all its robots, and finish the game with at least one hero still alive.
455462.name: Games & Cats

455492.description: In Ferret Frenzy, you and up to 5 friends (8 with expansion) take on the role of mischievous ferrets ransacking a house for wondrous things in order to claim... the Ultimate Stash. The game is played by discarding cards from the top of the deck on your turn. At any point you may stop and add all the cards discarded to your stash. Unless you discard a FRENZY! Then all players slap the table as fast as they can, and in reaction-order claim cards from your stash instead. The game ends when the deck is empty. The player who has the most cards in their stash wins! —description from the designer
455492.name: Ferret Frenzy

455822.description: Balacious is a two-player climbing and shedding card game in which players race to be the first to play all their cards. Played with a 41-card deck (a standard 54-card deck with the diamond suit removed), each round begins with players customizing the rules through a unique drafting system. Players use cubes to select and announce numbered options (1-12), which define allowable play types (ex. runs, flushes, bombs), alter ranking rules, or grant extra cards from the leftover pool. These selections dynamically shape each round's strategy and available moves. The main strategic twist in…
455822.name: Balacious

455906.description: Fairy Tales come to life in this deluxe version of the beloved trick-taking game. Use special abilities to change the trump suit, lead even after losing a trick, and more. Aim for the majority of tricks each hand, but don’t get greedy! If you win too many, you will fall like the villain in so many fairy tales. This deluxe edition includes three all-new modules: special cards, goal cards, and poison cards! Features new illustrations, foil stamping, and acrylic tokens. —description from the publisher
455906.name: The Fox in the Forest Deluxe

456002.description: Luck, Risk, and Revenge! Gamble on a flip to trigger attacks and knock out your rivals. But matching a pair forces you to collect them, edging closer to defeat. Avoid that fatal 7th card. Only the luckiest survivor claims victory!
456002.name: Knock Knock Out

456003.description: A game about saving room for dessert! It's dinner time, and veggies are being served two by two. In order to avoid eating the veggies, players take turns saying "no!", giving up valuable favor that is used for getting the best desserts. Eventually, one of the players gives in and eats the veggies, but earns all the favor lost by the other players. When it's time for dessert, players choose their desserts in order of most to least favor. Don't want to eat the veggie? Just feed it to the dog. What could go wrong... —description from the publisher
456003.name: Eat Your Veggies!

456021.description: Dead Man's Draw is a simple and strategic card game of risk and reward for 2 to 4 players. Players take turns drawing cards and combining their special abilities to plunder the most loot without busting their entire hands. Two copies of the game allow playing the game with up to 8 players. The core of your turn in Dead Man’s Draw is all in the flip: pulling the top card off the deck and using its special ability. Your turn isn’t over until you say it is, though. You can keep pulling cards as long as you like – until you play a card of a suit already seen, at which point you lose everything.…
456021.name: Dead Man's Draw: 10-Year Anniversary Edition

456106.description: Čecháček (Čecháčci = plural) - (IRONICALLY) A crafty Czech, a Czech trickster; a stingy, petty, ridiculous, or otherwise undignified member of the Czech and Moravian nation. Have some fried cheese, collect socks in sandals, grab a few beers, and become one of the stereotypical Czech characters. But be careful, your friends are also collecting and don't want to show their true colors. Bluff, trade, steal, simpply be the first to fulfill all your character's desires and become the ultimate Čecháček. Čecháčci is a fast-paced card game that makes fun of czech steroetypes. Its gameplay revolves…
456106.name: Čecháčci

456128.description: "The bluffing game of Wall Street Traders!" Bluffin’ is a gambling game that combines probability, strategy, and psychology with bluffing. The innovative 54 custom cards brings Liar’s Poker to your tabletop. Devised by game designer Steve Baldwin, creator of award-winning strategy game, Megiddo. The challenge is to guess the quantity of hidden number in everyone’s cards, and push your luck with a bluff that could bring you the winning bid. Includes a deck of 60 “Bluffin Bucks” plus money cards used to track your winning streak. Fun, fast-paced, and challenging for 2 to 12 players age 10+.…
456128.name: Bluffin'

456160.description: In Going Nuts, the squirrels have gone wild! This is a fast-paced card game centered around colors, numbers, and… peanuts. Players are seated at a picnic when suddenly peanuts begin to fall, then a squirrel leaps into the scene, wildly tossing cards. Each player must attempt to reorganize their hand following the squirrel’s attack and race to be the first to order their cards properly at the round’s end. Throughout the game, timing, awareness, and hand‐management are key. Players may interfere with each other indirectly by triggering the squirrel or shifting cards. The game offers chaotic,…
456160.name: Going Nuts

456161.name: Pitypang és Lili: Segíts a kutyusoknak!

456267.description: Run Run Reindeer is a press-your-luck racing game. Each turn, draw a spirit card, and then decide whether to stop or push. If the next card is higher, you're safe, but if it's lower, you bust! Higher cards move you further, but is it worth the risk? Special cards keep you on your toes, er, hooves. The first to reach the Sleigh will guide Santa this Christmas. —description from the publisher
456267.name: Run Run Reindeer

456343.description: Bonbon is a short and light push-your-luck card game for 2-6 players about eating as many chocolates as you can. Players take turns to draw a card (chocolate) from a common deck and add it to their set either face up or face down. Cards have a printed value on them representing the points earned by the player. Face-up cards will count towards the personal and collective limit players must respect. If you pass your personal limit you immediately lose that round, and if the collective limit is passed during your turn, the round ends immediately and you also lose that round. There are some trick…
456343.name: Bonbon

456361.description: A shedding game fusing Draft & Climb! Draft to build your hand, then strike in climbing duels. Play smart with same-number sets and suited runs to outplay opponents and shed out first. Master both phases to dominate: draft to build, climb to win.
456361.name: Chant

456442.description: Inspired by classic two-player card games like Gin Rummy and Koi-Koi, in Heavenly Bodies players meld three or more cards in sets and runs, aiming to pass thresholds for each suit in order to score points. Each turn, players may either draw two cards from a shared deck, then discard a card to either of two discard piles OR draw all the cards of either discard pile, melding any that they can into sets, then taking the remaining as penalty cards. Once players have melded cards, with the number of cards depending on the suit, they score points. Each suit in the game — planet, moon, comet, and…
456442.name: Nebular Colors

456447.description: KNOCK is a fast-paced, mind-bending card game of memory, risk, and deception. Beneath its simple setup lies a battle of wits where players must bluff, guess, and outsmart their opponents without ever truly knowing what’s in their own hand. Every move is a gamble — trust your instincts, read your rivals, and time your final “Knock” just right. Gameplay: Each player begins with four facedown cards they can’t see. On every turn, players draw and discard cards to lower the total value of their hand which could go as low as minus 6 — but the twist is that most actions rely on limited information…
456447.name: KNOCK

456458.description: Fiesta is a competitive memory game for 2 to 4 players, ages 5 and up, with quick rounds of about 10 minutes. Inspired by the Andean celebration of Pachamama —the “Mother Earth”—, the game blends the ritual spirit of music and dance with the fun of uncovering matching pairs and trios of cards. Each player seeks to connect with nature through play, evoking traditional instruments like the zampoña, charango, or rain stick, in an atmosphere that celebrates harmony and balance with the Earth. The goal is to reach 10 points by finding matching cards on a 3x6 grid. On their turn, a player flips a…
456458.name: Fiesta

456486.description: You can't imagine how important socks can be to the magical creatures that live in our homes, called the Copins. Now you'll know! These little ones are racing each other to see who can collect the most. Play with 2 to 6 players. Create card combos to score movement points to advance along the board track, but hold on! In each turn, players may attempt to block, prevent others from moving forward, force them to travel backward, and steal their cards, among other actions. All of these, while they try to escape from an adorable cute kitty! Ompaleleh! Let´s play! Gameplay time estimation might…
456486.name: The Copins

456557.description: Battle of the Knollen is a tactical trick-taking card game set in the chaotic fantasy world of Tuberia, where six potato factions battle monstrous vegetables for supremacy. Winning tricks gives you cards—but they aren't victory points. They're your army, resources, and ammunition, used to fight monsters, buy magical items, and activate your hero's abilities. Each faction has a unique passive ability that can trigger from cards played by any player, creating constant opportunities—and painful dilemmas. Losing a trick can be just as valuable as winning one. The last-place player gets the first…
456557.name: Battle of the Knollen

456587.name: Texas: Card Games Inspired by the Lone Star State

456625.description: Also known as Kvitlakh, Kwittlech, Quittlach, Quitklock and Quitli, Kvitlach is a variant of vingt-et-un associated with the European Ashkenazi Jewish Orthodox community, but also known to the Jewish community more widely but less so following the Holocaust. It has its own distinctive deck of 24 cards, comprising two runs of 1-12 with the number 2s and 11s marked by frames. Frequently two decks are combined, allowing for a common configuration of 5-6 players. The most long-running of these printed decks was Piatnik's Quitli Karten 17, but the deck has been published as recently as 2025 by…
456625.name: Kvitlach

456709.description: Flamenco is a passionate dance performed in theaters in the Seville region of Spain. This game is a “climbing game” in which players must play higher cards while maintaining the state set by the previous player. As in traditional climbing games, a player must play the same number of cards with a higher value in order to beat the previous play. However, a stylish step allows a single card to be split into two. An even-numbered card can be beaten by two cards whose combined value equals half of that card. If two even-numbered cards are played, they may be beaten with four cards; if three…
456709.name: Flamenco

456729.name: Wonderland's War: Caterpillar & White Queen Expansion

456797.description: Phibo is a dynamic two-player climbing and shedding card game where players aim to be the first to empty their hand each round. The game is played with a 39-card deck (a standard 54-card deck with the diamond suit removed) and has a unique "Rank Tracker" system which dynamically shifts the ranking of four cards: Jacks, Queens, Kings, and Aces. Players take turns playing combinations of cards, attempting to overplay their opponent with higher-ranking or matching numerical combinations, while strategically manipulating the rank tracker and managing the draw deck. Each turn, players can play a…
456797.name: Phibo

456798.description: Fool's errand is a 3-player climbing-shedding card game where one player, the Soloist, bids to complete contracts while the other two form a temporary team to stop them. Each deal begins with an auction in which players bid for the solo role and choose from a variety of contracts like shedding out first, or capturing all Kings. Key twist: As soon as a player bids, they pick up the 3‑card talon (public draw pile) and discard any three cards to create a new talon. Certain contracts enforce "must-play" or "must-bomb" rules. Silent bonuses give scoring opportunities for all players. The deal ends…
456798.name: Fool's Errand

456818.description: In a Pirate Theme, you will set sail to discover mythical locations and precious memories. Players will try to block your progress and put creatures on your path like Sirens and the legendary Kraken. An easy and quick competitive card game, with humor, colorful illustrations, Pirates and Sirens. A typical game unfolds in rounds where each players plays his turn one after the other. Each player starts with a location card and 2 memory cards in hand. In a turn the player : 1- Explore : Draw a Memory card or discard a Memory card to draw a Location card 2- Encounter at sea : Choose between a)…
456818.name: Vague Attaque

456946.description: In Nightmare Tales, each player is a kid who has just gone to bed. The lights go out, and the darkness comes, with its terrors and unsettling sounds. Tucked in, lights off. A creak under your bed, a crackle near the wardrobe. Nightmares are coming and the night has just begun. In this dynamic card game, memory and strategy come together in fast games full of twists. At first, players have only fears: four random face-down cards: mostly monsters and nightmares. Everyone looks at one of their cards and then put it back. The deck is put in the middle. Then the game starts. Once the game begins,…
456946.name: Nightmare Tales

456963.description: Treble 1 is a strategic dart card game that transforms traditional darts into an engaging competitive experience for 2-4 players. Players draw target cards representing specific dartboard sections (singles, doubles, trebles, and bulls), then attempt to hit those targets with their darts to claim the cards and score points. The game combines the physical skill of darts with strategic hand management, as players must decide whether to attempt targets from their personal hand or compete for the two face-up "active targets" available to all players. Each turn consists of selecting a target card,…
456963.name: Treble 1: A Dart Card Game

456965.description: They thought we were crazy, but they’re the fools, I tell you. With the temporal transistors finally operational, we have the power to travel time - to past, present, future, and beyond. Oh, but the fuel must be managed carefully! One too many time jumps and we’ll be unable to make that fateful, final leap home. Who will master the timeline, and who may be lost in time forever? Trick to the Future is a trick-taking game in which you use cards from your hand to time travel. You begin each round with a number of fuel rods on your player board, which may be used to change the values of your…
456965.name: Trick to the Future

457006.description: Disaster has struck the UNB Archives and Special Collections! A terrible fire has destroyed all of the incredible photographs, papers, and artifacts that document UNB’s history! But, all is not lost. One hope remains. A secret project (codenamed AUDE - short for Augmented Universal Dimension Engine) the work of a small group of eccentric professors, has unraveled the mystery of time travel! In this easy-to-learn but strategic card game, you and up to four friends compete against each other as the professors. Stepping forward with a plan to save the university’s history, you send your student…
457006.name: Project AUDE: The UNB History Card Game

457020.description: You’re a music fan and a true lover of pets. Lucky for you, these animals don’t just sit and stay – they play music!
