Today is your day to adopt the finest pet musicians around and form exceptional musical ensembles. And certainly you will agree, there is nothing more exquisite than a perfect pet quartet! Pet Quartet is a set-collection game in which players adopt musical pets, represented by cards. Your goal is to collect cards of the same number, however, you only score points for soloists and quartets! That is, for each type of animal, you only want to have exactly one card from that set,…
457020.name: Pet Quartet

457061.description: It's time to mix your paints! Collect groups of Primary color cards from the central Palette, then use them to score the Secondary hues. Score multiple cards at once to make each worth more when the deck runs out! Palette features competitive gameplay for 2-4 players, and a solo score challenge mode for solitaire play! —description from the designer
457061.name: Palette

457062.description: This game is a combination of Sevens and Daifugo. The player who gets rid of all their cards wins, but to do so they must meet two conditions. ① Their cards must touch an existing ladder card on the table above, below, left, or right. ② Their set of cards must be stronger than the set played by the previous player. The goal is to play all of your cards as quickly as possible while fulfilling these conditions. Demonstrate that you are the best at climbing up and down the ladder. -description from designer
457062.name: Hashi Go Out

457202.name: カミサマの云うとおり (Kamisama no iu toori)

457395.description: AlGame invites players to dive into the wonders of the Mediterranean Sea and build their own marine ecosystem, card by card. Each turn, players expand their section of sea by connecting new environment cards - from rocky shores and seagrass meadows to sandy bottoms and open waters - and populate them with marine species. Some of these species are algae, key organisms for the health of the sea. Placing them strategically allows players to unlock special Algalab bonuses: Cultivation and Restoration, rewarding those who manage to rebuild thriving underwater habitats. But not all is calm beneath…
457395.name: AlGame

457399.description: In Pietenpolonaise — the cheerful Sinterklaas card game from Gam’inBIZ — players race to be the first to form a colorful line of seven Piets, all happily following Sinterklaas. Share cards, match colors, and rely on a bit of luck. That’s all you need for fifteen minutes of laughter and suspense! But watch out for the bananas! Whoever slips loses the last Piet in their line. Luckily, the Rainbow cards can help you get the parade going again. Pietenpolonaise is a compact family game and a perfect small gift for children aged 5 and up. It’s easy to learn, quick to play, and proudly printed in…
457399.name: Pietenpolonaise

457434.description: This game is playable with a standard deck of cards. Less Than Three is a 2 player ladder climbing game. Over 6 rounds, players will try to win by emptying their hand first. If a player doesn't have a winning hand, they can sweep to regain control, or end the round early by knocking. Using three different melds (singles, sets of 2 or more, and suited runs of 2 or more), players will attempt to climb over their opponent's plays. Both players have 2 sweep cards to last them the entire game. These clear the field of all cards played to the current trick, and allow the sweeper to lead the next…
457434.name: Less Than Three

457477.description: A climbing shedding game with a slot machine theme. Cards have no numbers, but different slot machine symbols. A hierarchy of symbols is dealt out at random at the beginning of the game. When all players pass on a meld of symbols, that symbol goes to the bottom of the hierarchy. Players can flip the hierarchy once per game with a lucky coin before they take their turn. —description from the designer
457477.name: Slot Machine Millionaire

457561.description: You have a handful of bombs and they're all ticking down. In Tick Tock Tangle, chaos is mandatory and timing is everything. Finish first? You ran away too soon. Finish last? Boom. But finish second? You’re the hero who defuses the bomb just in time. Tick Tock Tangle is an explosive climbing / shedding card game for 3–5 players where you want to shed out second. Players will be dealt a blind hand to begin with, and through their choices information may be revealed about their hand at the detriment of the speed they defuse bombs. A careful balance of timing, deduction and risk taking is…
457561.name: Tick Tock Tangle

457601.description: Pound of Hounds is a comedic and cunning, canine themed dedicated deck, strategic party game with over 50 unique hand-drawn doggo's to Draw from. Strategise, collect cards and use your abilities to gather your dogs and finally "claim your Pound of Hounds over friend and foes alike". Throughout the game players will discard cards from their hand to use the cards ability (including picking up more cards, stealing cards from other players hand, discarding other players hands, swapping hands, ect..) or trade in 3 cards of the same class (indicated by the cards colour and icon in the top left…
457601.name: Pound of Hounds

457660.description: Smorgasbord is a compendium climbing/shedding game. What is a compendium game? It is a game where there are multiple objectives that each player must complete by the end of the game. These objectives are commonly referred to in traditional games as “contracts”. Each player must complete every contract before the game can end. Most importantly, once a player completes a specific contract they cannot attempt to complete that contract again. Contracts slightly change the rules of play for all players (examples include changing the bomb type, changing the card ranking, choosing when you shed out,…
457660.name: Smorgasbord

457755.description: The card game where only the smartest and boldest contenders in the ring will survive a royal battle to be crowned kings of the deep sea! Each fighter plays their cards from the gallery, activating their effects immediately. However, if you repeat a technique, you’ll trigger a Tentaclash in your sequence and lose everything you revealed that round. At the end of the game, players will total their scores in each strike category to determine the champion — but beware! The judges will take your weakest hit into account when delivering their verdict! Do you have what it takes to master the tides…
457755.name: Octo Rumble

457797.description: Welcome to the final showdown! Take on the role of one of the characters who have committed misdeeds in their lives and are facing their end at a gambling table. The rules are simple: only one can leave the table alive. Each turn, you must pull the trigger, but be careful—there are bullets you'll want to receive in order to earn rewards. During the game, you can use a series of item cards to “cheat” and get away unscathed. In short, it's a game of statistics, luck, betting, and a lot of bluffing. Are you ready? —description from the publisher
457797.name: Last Bullet

457957.description: New Record! Continue? is a kind of go-out game, where players aim to be the first to get rid of all their cards. Players may play any number of cards of the same rank at once. After that, each subsequent player must either play the same number of cards with a higher rank, or play one more card of any rank. However, the game isn’t just about competing with other players. Each player also keeps a personal record of how many cards they’ve played together as a set. Each of these recorded cards counts as points. But — a new card can only be recorded if it’s played with a higher number than the one…
457957.name: New Record! ⇨Continue?

457992.description: In the heart of rural Brazil, nobody escapes a mamona fight! Guerrinha de Mamona is a duel game full of cunning and intuition, inspired by the classic Brazilian child game of throwing thorny seeds of castor bean (or 'mamona, in Portuguese). Predicting your opponent's moves is essential to avoid getting hit in the face with a seed – and still manage to attack by surprise! Each person has their own set of action cards that can better prepare you for the fight or hinder your opponent. But if you get hit by a mamona, all is not lost: you activate your unique ability to come out on top in the next…
457992.name: Guerrinha de Mamona

458122.description: When the lights go out, the real game begins! Load Shedding is a chaotic set-collection and sabotage card game about collecting alternate power sources and keeping your home running during a blackout, all while sabotaging your neighbours’ chances. Players race to assemble working Power Sets from generators, solar panels, and battery backups while dealing with sneaky sabotage, sudden outages, and a constant ticking clock. Every turn counts. Will you stock up on backup power, pull a clever trick, or drain someone else’s supply? Easy to learn but full of sneaky moves and hilarious twists, Load…
458122.name: Load Shedding

458200.description: Dogs, cats, and kids. They all love going for walks. Take them out for walks morning, noon, and night to collect hearts of gratitude. If you collect the most hearts, you'll see a shooting star. Let's become a Walking Master. In Best Family Forever from Today, players race to empty their hands in this light shedding game. On your turn, you play cards that show dogs, cats, or kids. You may play a new color or more cards of the same color, depending on what has already been played. When the first and second players who emptied their hands receive Heart tokens. The first player to reach the…
458200.name: Best Family Forever from Today
publishers: Mysboard Games (ミスボドゲームズ)

458206.description: Bulldog is a press-your-luck gambling game for 3-8 players, using the Blossom Deck. The game gets its name from “bulldogging,” which is paying money to stay in when your hand is not worth saving. The game was created for a short story set in the Dearworth Valley. In some respects, Bulldog plays the role of Poker in the Dew Point universe. OBJECTIVE: Your goal is to winnow your hand down to the fewest points, while guessing if your opponents can do the same. Or get out early, if you think your cards can’t win! GAMEPLAY: Players will play six rounds, collecting faceup cards in their boards.…
458206.name: Bulldog

458391.description: Honeypot is a quick and simple I Stack, You Choose game for 1-6 players with delightful artwork by Kwanchai Moriya! In Honeypot, players take on the role of secret agent bears trying to gather the best intel and spy supplies without getting stung! Players arrange secret caches for their opponents and carefully sift through the secret caches passed to them. The question is: how far to dig for valuable intel and spy supplies? Have your opponents passed you the sweetest honey, or a swarm of bees? In this thrilling game of setting traps and trying to avoid them, only the agent with the best…
458391.name: Honeypot

458536.description: Bespoke is a compendium style climbing-shedding card game for 2 players using a standard deck of cards. In compendium games, players compete to accomplish a series of different objectives. These objectives are known as contracts. Each player must fulfill every contract before the game concludes. Once a player has completed a particular contract, they are not allowed to attempt it again. In Bespoke, the objective for every contract remains the same: to play all of your cards as quickly as possible. However, each contract is uniquely tailored, offering its own distinct twists on the rules of…
458536.name: Bespoke

458620.description: Gatushi is a card game full of colorful cats that will make you smile... or bring a cloud of bad luck! Behind this name lies a competition to collect the luckiest cats and avoid having three of the same color line up. Because, as they say... when cats get too close, things can get ugly! Gatushi is a card game for 2 to 6 players, ages 8 and up, with games lasting about 20 minutes. It's designed for the whole family, with simple rules but enough strategy to keep both young and old hooked. A game of pushing your luck, taking risks, and making bets where you'll have to know when to play... and…
458620.name: Gatushi

458635.description: Each player builds a personal line of number cards to activate Goals and multiply a jackpot. There is a webapp where you can play against AI players in easy/hard mode. Try it now https://tabletoplab25-hash.github.io/ROWLETTE/ Building Your Line: Each turn, players take 1 card from a 3-card market and add it to their personal line. The line grows throughout the round and can contain: Number cards (1-40): Red cards trigger Goal selection; Black cards boost your Jackpot Zero cards: Add risk by accumulating zero-points (6+ causes an explosion, halving your score) Special cards: Remove zeros,…
458635.name: Rowlette

458732.description: Unleash the power of the Natural, Unnatural, and Supernatural as you join Iyanu on her journey to mastery! Flip cards to uncover powerful abilities and claim victory points, building your tableau with every bold move. But push your luck too far, and the energy may slip from your grasp. leaving you with nothing. Will you seize control or risk it all? On your turn player draw cards from the draw deck until you decide to stop or have revealed too many divine power symbols, in which case all cards are discarded and your turn is over. If you stopped before you revealed too many divine power…
458732.name: Iyanu Mark of the Chosen

458738.description: Spire’s End: Volume 2 – Episode 1 is an adult, narrative-driven card game for 1 to 3 players. It is a choose your path adventure that runs alongside the events of Volume 1. You follow a solitary beekeeper and a band of strangers through a blood-soaked western filled with dust, grit, and treachery. No prior knowledge is required. Episode 1 is a complete story that also connects to the larger saga through character crossovers and hidden ties. Volume 2 will unfold over three episodes, planned for release about once a year. Each builds on the last as the stakes rise and the long journey toward…
458738.name: Spire's End: Volume 2 – Episode 1

458770.description: Minikin City is a strategic game where every card you play has a double meaning. Colors and values give you rewards each round, while icons and effects give you points at the end, but only if you fill the card with Minikins! Reward cards at the center determine the best color for each round. The cards played in that round determine the players' ranking. Choose to play a card with a high value in the best color to get the most powerful reward, or play a card with an effect you like... or both! Many effects on the cards and rewards at the center give you Minikins that you can place on your…
458770.name: Minikin City

458822.description: Sharks Have No Necks is a push-your-luck card game for 1-10 players. Players turn over cards on their turn, and gain any points or stops. Play continues until all players have been stopped or choose to stop. The player with the most points at the end of three rounds is the winner. —description from designer
458822.name: Sharks Have No Necks

458835.description: In Deep End, you and your team of marine biologists encounter a ravenous alien squid with the power to twist your psyche and pit you against one another as reality distorts. To escape, you must outwit the rest of the crew and rise to the surface before madness consumes you. Deep End is a thrilling, fast-paced shedding card game for 2 to 6 players, ages 8 and up. Dive into a battle of wits where tactics and chaos collide. Your goal is simple: be the first to shed your cards and warn the world of the horror below or will you let madness consume you and be lost forever in the Deep End?…
458835.name: Deep End

458847.name: Scraby: The Pachanga of Hexa-Words Vip

458852.name: マッチングポンプ (Matching Pump)

458854.name: サイケデリックティキング (Psychedelic Trick-Taking)

458855.name: 実録！ほんとにあった呪いのトリックテイキング (Jitsuroku! Honto ni Atta Noroi no Trick-Taking)

458857.name: 代われそのジョブ (Take Over That Job)

458859.description: In a world where the eternal serpent consumes itself in an endless cycle, players embody fragments of that fate: striving to outlast one another in a loop of creation and destruction. Each card played represents a step closer to renewal or demise, as the ouroboros winds tighter with every trick. The only way to endure is to master the rhythm of the cycle before it devours you entirely. Ouroboros Trick is a trick-taking game for 3–5 players in which survival, not points, determines the winner. Each round, players play one card in turn; the highest card of the lead suit or trump wins the trick.…
458859.name: ウロボロストリック (Ouroboros Trick)
publishers: 篠原遊戯重工 (Shinohara Yugi Juko)

458861.name: 戦士の遺言 (Warrior's Testament)
publishers: 卸売センターサンエイ (Oroshiuri Sentaa San'ei)

458863.description: In a lively contest of wits and timing, players compete to shed their cards by cleverly connecting numbers and forming powerful combinations. The game’s tension builds as every move can change the flow of play, with players watching each other’s hands and waiting for the perfect chance to link, outplay, and climb to victory in this playful battle of numbers. Dodicitre is a climbing and shedding game where players aim to play out their cards by either beating the previous set or attaching a card to the one on the table to form a stronger combination. The twist lies in the flexibility of the…
458863.name: Dodicitre

458864.name: The Tricktaker's Guide To The Galaxy

458865.name: Karaoke Trick
publishers: ぷあぷあイデオロギー (Poor Poor Ideology)

458886.description: Muto is a 2-player climbing and shedding game. Each round, players receive 14 cards from a 39-card deck. The dealer starts by playing any legal combination: singles, suited runs, pairs, or triplets. On each turn, the opponent must either overplay the combination or pass. Overplays can follow normal climbing rules (same type and length, higher rank), but single-suited combinations have an additional “suit-based overplay” rule: spades can be beaten by any 1-card combo, hearts by any 2-card combo, and clubs by any 3-card combo, even with lower ranks. The round ends when someone empties their…
458886.name: Muto

458911.description: In a world ruled by colorful bear gangs, each group vies for dominance by outsmarting and outmaneuvering their rivals. The bears compete fiercely to establish control, playing their cards with cunning timing and strategic wit. Only the sharpest and most adaptable gang of bears can outlast the chaos and emerge as the top crew in this fast-paced turf battle. CGOB (Color Gang Out Bear) is a climbing-style card game where players aim to be the first to play all of their cards. Players must strategically manage their hands, playing combinations based on color and numerical order while navigating…
458911.name: CGOB

459020.name: Xurpy: The Pachanga of the Chinese Sticks VIP

459022.description: Herond Quest is an extremely fast-paced card game for 2 to 6 players. The setting is Netvaria, a captivating world where ancient magic and forgotten technology fuse together. You step into the role of a powerful competitor known as a Browser. Choose from 6 different Browsers, each with their own unique abilities, and compete in the renowned Herond Quest Tournament, striving to be the ultimate survivor. Every turn is a pivotal sequence of decisions: Draw Cards: Gain resources for the fight ahead. Take a Main Action: Choose your strategy. You can cast powerful spells, gather more mana, or take…
459022.name: Herond Quest

459108.name: Swaysy: The Pachanga of Balance VIP

459186.description: Pasar Tobelo is a competitive card game for 2–4 players (ages 7+) focused on teaching numeracy, basic operations (addition/subtraction), and real-world application through the theme of fulfilling banana orders in a market. Players take turns engaging in a push-your-luck mechanic, revealing Banana Cards (values 1–5) from a grid one by one while managing the risk of revealing Monkey Cards ($-1$ or $-2$) which reduce the total. The objective is to match a running banana total to one of the available Order Cards (6-15) and Claim! it, or risk a "Lanjut!" (Continue!) to aim for a higher order,…
459186.name: Pasar Tobelo

459195.description: Deep within the whispering woods, a bustling community is coming to life. In Fox Grove, you are trying to build the most prosperous little animal village in the forest. Over the course of 4 rounds, you must skillfully manage your hand of cards and your resources to outshine your rivals. At its heart, Fox Grove is a unique blend of mechanics. Each round begins with a trick-taking phase where playing the right cards is key to gather essential resources. However, veteran card players should stay on their toes: there is a twist in the trick-taking rules that will force you to rethink your…
459195.name: Fox Grove

459201.description: Payload 🚀 is a tactical strategy card game where you run your own space company. Compete for valuable Payload contracts, build ambitious rockets, hire skilled Engineers, and launch at the perfect moment. Every decision matters. Build too slowly and your rivals may end the game first. Launch too early, and your rocket may not be ready. You don't need to know rocket science to play. The game is easy to learn, while drawing inspiration from real rocket engineering to create a fun and competitive experience. The game in brief: Payload is for 1-5 players, ages 14 and up, and plays in about 45-60…
459201.name: Payload

459246.name: Snaky: The Pachanga of Snakes & Ladders VIP

459332.description: In War of the words, the players stand at the head of their own newspaper with their own political leaning (Royalist, Catholic, Centrist, Liberal or Republican). Each round, they can place their cards (informants and agents) in one of five different areas of Paris each round. They can attempt to gather the latest NEWS (three areas), seek support at a SOIREE (one area), or obtain a commission (one area) that allows them to 'make' or 'break' a THEATER piece. The more profit they accumulate during the game, the more cards they will be able to spend to influence these areas. To obtain the latest…
459332.name: War of the Words

459404.description: Extreme Race: Card Game is a fast-paced set collection game for 2-6 players where you're competing to assemble race car parts and speed ahead on the track. Inspired by the challenges of desert rally racing, players must strategically collect matching sets of car components while sabotaging opponents with mismatched parts. On your turn, you'll take all cards of one type from either a checkpoint (containing 3 face-up cards) or from the Bivouac - a central area where unwanted cards accumulate. When you take cards from a checkpoint, remaining cards move to the Bivouac. If you're brave enough to…
459404.name: Extreme Race: Card Game

459508.name: Unicorn Glitterluck: Magical Fun with Dice

459516.description: Dinner is served – straight from the dumpster! In this quirky card-and-dice game, players collect animal orders and try to fulfill them by rolling the right food symbols. Each turn, you decide how many cards to reveal before rolling your dice. Complete orders to score points, but beware: every unfulfilled order and every boot card costs you dearly! Use reroll cards and golden stars wisely to maximize your score. The first player to reach 40 points wins this flavorful mix of luck and strategy. —description from the publisher
459516.name: Tasty Wasty

460065.description: Thicker Than Blood is a strategic, competitive Kenyan card game about sibling rivalry for inheritance, focusing on secrets, blackmail, and manipulation. It's designed for 3-6 players (ages 14+). On a player's turn they will perform one action as their chosen sibling and one action as their Goon. Actions can involve gaining Secrets, Coins, shielding your own Secrets or Goon specific threats. Once you gain another player's Secrets you can expose them to cause the opponent to lose Face or Blackmail them to gain their Hooks that you can redeem to control their Actions or protect your own Face.…
460065.name: Thicker Than Blood

460094.name: Operation CanCon: Canadian Music Shopping Holiday Special

460238.description: Corporate Creatures is a fast, cut‑throat corporate survival card game where meetings are battlegrounds, colleagues are predators, and only one executive crawls out with their job intact. Players weaponise BRAG/BURDEN challenges, hijack meetings, sabotage rivals, and manipulate the FLIP‑STAT system to eliminate opponents one by one. Every round is a miniature power struggle: bluffing, timing, opportunism, and ruthless corporate politics wrapped in a satirical, punchy ruleset. At its core, Corporate Creatures is about reading the room — choosing when to strike, when to defend, and when to…
460238.name: Corporate Creatures

460432.name: Balance the Ark
publishers: 卸売センターサンエイ (Oroshiuri Sentaa San'ei)

460433.description: Be the master of your own luck! Draw cards from the pile and predict: will the next card be a panda or a clover? Will the value be higher or lower than the last one? Easy… but do you know when to stop and to score points? Predict the top card before revealing it and placing it on any discard pile. Got it right? Keep playing or score points. Got it wrong? Next! The player who collects the most cards wins! —description from the publisher
460433.name: Panda Flip

460439.name: 宇宙亀の方程式 (Uchū Kame no Hōteishiki)

460441.name: 白と黒でトリテ 明朝＆ゴシック (Trick-taking in Black and White: Serif & Sans-serif)

460455.description: Players gather around to manipulate numbers with cards and dice, aiming to build combinations that outmatch their rivals. Each round becomes a tension-filled contest of intuition, risk-taking, and clever arithmetic where a single die roll can flip the balance of power. Piplus is a climbing and dice-manipulation game for 2–6 players, where participants play numbered cards and augment their values with dice. Each card from 1 to 10 can be played singly or in sets of matching numbers, climbing over previous plays with equal-length sets of higher values. Dice can be rolled to either enhance card…
460455.name: Piplus

460576.description: Grapplin is a two-player climbing and shedding game where players compete to empty their 18-card hands first. Players take turns playing combinations (singles, pairs, triples, runs) or bombs (quads or suited runs of 4 singles) to beat each other's attacks. When you match a rank in your opponent's combination, you can take cards from a communal row, add a card to transform their combination, or remove a card to weaken it. But you can only use these special actions if you can still beat their attack afterwards. Each player has a joker that can be flipped once per round to reverse the rank…
460576.name: Grapplin

460671.description: Don Quixote sets out in pursuit of noble ideals, charging ahead with passion and conviction. Yet not every victory brings glory, and blind ambition can easily lead to folly. In this game, winning a trick is often a risk rather than a reward. Try to avoid taking tricks whenever you can. If you cannot, take exactly what is required — no more, no less. And it is wiser to claim a trick that holds points. Careful judgment, not reckless triumph, is the key to success. —description from the publisher
460671.name: Don Quixote

460675.description: In this deck-building card game, you must recruit 3 Linkship Pilots and escape from Tag World. Each turn, you'll use Birdians to recruit new crew members who will add more credibility points that you need to recruit Linkship Pilots. Each character has their own Group who they're close to and abilities that they'll use when they're deployed. Build the best crew who will help you escape Tag World before you alert the Bird-in-Trainings who are holding you captive! Story: Tag World is a World run by birds known as Bird-in-Trainings (and Higher-Up Birds who rule this World). Bird-in-Trainings…
460675.name: Escape From Tag World

460735.name: Return to Dark Tower: Creeping Darkness Corruption Deck

460819.name: 四色絵画の収集家たち (Yon Shoku Kaiga No Shūshūkatachi)
publishers: あーきっと.ゲームズ (Archit Games)

461021.description: A sip of courage can bring victory, but a sip of carelessness can bring about flames! Story of Dangerous Sweets Sweet tooth challengers from all over the world gather for the annual sweets festival! Cream puffs, macarons, taiyaki, sakura mochi... they all look like the most exquisite sweets. But among them is a dangerous item containing a chili pepper bomb...?! Will you enjoy the delicious sweets and safely leave, or will you continue eating knowing the danger? One bite of courage will bring victory, and one bite of carelessness will bring flames. The hilarious Sweet Russian Roulette is about…
461021.name: Dangerous Sweets
publishers: ぶれけけゲームズ (Brekeke Games)

461270.description: Pressure is a family friendly, push your luck game with bidding, bluffing, and betting. The game features simultaneous play and packs big experiences into a small box. Pressure is fun, wild, and filled with suspense - it'll take your breath away! In Pressure, you’ll strategically add cards to a shared pool with some public and some hidden information. Use that information to bid for the honor of becoming the Dive Master. Before the dive, everyone, including the Dive Master, bets on whether the Dive Master will succeed in their reckless dive. Then Dive Master flips over cards one at a time,…
461270.name: Pressure

461292.description: Fafaru! The Ma’a Tahiti game with a Polynesian twist! In this « poisson cru » (raw fish with coconut-milk), everyone’s smiling… except the fermented ingredients hiding in the ma’a… Keep your role secret, play cards face down, read the reactions, accuse without mercy, or dare to eat the ma’a to win the game! Good luck, and… « Tama’a maitai »! —description from the designer
461292.name: Fafaru !

461362.description: A super simple push your luck card game. Shuffle the deck and deal each player three cards. Randomly determine a starting player. On your turn you may FLIP or PASS. Flip one of your face down cards face up. If a "Boom" card is revealed your points explode and your score for the round is zero. If all three of your cards are face up you may decide to push your luck. Set your face up cards aside and deal three additional face down cards. You may pass only if all three cards in front of you are face up OR at least one of your face up cards is a "Safe" card. Once each player has passed begin a new…
461362.name: Flip Tick Boom

461405.description: Drink or Die is a set-collection card game for 2–5 players where rival alchemists brew potions. Try it now: https://tabletoplab25-hash.github.io/DRINK-OR-DIE/ On your turn you simply take everything of one element (all the Fire) or everything of one value (all the 2s) into your collection, then the market refills. That's the whole turn. The heart of the game — the balance scoring — is unchanged and still excellent: opposing elements cancel out, leftover imbalance costs 3 points each, and Nature is your tool to fix it. But everything is now face-up, so it's pure tactics with no hidden…
461405.name: Drink or Die

461550.description: CliQ is a fast-paced, push-your-luck card game where every turn you’ll add colourful cards to your board and chase the highest score you can. But beware - draw a card you can’t place and you’ll bust, dropping to zero for the round. Still, a bad round isn’t always the end: clever strategy, special cards, and a dash of luck (or sheer recklessness…) might just swing the game back in your favour.
461550.name: CliQ

461564.description: Daytime Minutes is a might-follow trick-taking game. Up to two different suits can be played into a trick, and the winner of each suit collects all cards of that suit. Players want to collect minutes on cards to try to get as close as possible to the plan limit without going over. If someone goes over, they incur overage charges and lose a point! But the player who captured the fewest minutes also loses a point. Each third trick is an evening call, and all cards played into the trick are discarded.
461564.name: Daytime Minutes

461577.description: Four dynamite cards are dealt to each player, who take turns playing one card to a central stack, if the card is of equal or higher value than the last card played. If a player is unable to do so, they take the stack and play a new card from their hand. Play continues with four new cards dealt to each player every round until the detonate card is played, at which point everyone counts the number of dynamite sticks they have. After someone reaches 50 points, the person with the lowest score is the winner.
461577.name: Unstable Explosives

461638.description: Many adventurers have braved the jungle to photograph the world’s largest crocodile. Anything goes to be the first. It’s a game of luck and strategy: good photos earn points, but blurred shots could bring it all crashing down. Players start with a “croc tail” card, which marks the beginning of their photo. On each turn, players draw a card showing a danger level from 1 to 3. Without revealing it, they must choose to add it to their own photo or give it to another player, who must add it to theirs. The higher the danger, the greater the risk of ruining your photo and being eliminated from the…
461638.name: Safari Croco

461768.description: Join NitNit, Sew-y, and their knitting obsessed pals in a cooperative climbing game filled with charm and challenge. Inspired by campaign style of The Crew and the Fellowship of the Ring the Trick-Taking Game and the climbing classic Tichu, this compendium of climbs invites your team to knit plans together and execute flawless tricks. Each new chapter is a puzzle of timing, teamwork and clever plays as your hand-drawn heroes lend their talents (and restrictions) to achieve your chapter goals. Conquer the challenges together and discover the joy of stitched-together strategy. —description from…
461768.name: The Adventures of NitNit: The Cooperative Climbing Compendium

461833.description: The Ship’s Computer wakes you from Cryo-Sleep. There’s something Big & Nasty on board! But you’re on this ship for a reason… You’re trapped on a drifting death trap with one shot at survival. Race through bug-infested corridors, outwit rivals and hunt down the elusive McGuffin that will unlock your Agenda — and the access codes you need to escape before everything goes dark. Every second counts, every choice is vital. Will you get out alive? Panic Stations! is the fast-paced card game version of the fanboy love letter to sci-fi monster movies Pandora Celeste. It’s quicker. It’s dirtier. And…
461833.name: Panic Stations! The Pandora Celeste Card Game

461852.description: One Too Many is a push-your-luck game playable with a standard deck of cards about greed, timing, and reading the other players. Players collectively draw cards, trying to build up valuable piles of cards, while keeping a wary eye on the growing danger in the center of the table. Each turn, all players simultaneously choose how many cards to take. Non-Diamond cards add to a player’s growing pile, but Diamonds are placed in the center, where they threaten everyone. If the Diamonds ever form a straight longer than the the number of players, the group busts, and the greediest player(s) that turn…
461852.name: One Too Many

461966.description: Manticore is a 3-player climbing-shedding game where every hand, each player is restricted to playing only one type of meld: Sets, Runs, or Flushes. To facilitate this, it uses a unique deck of 47 cards with 10 ranks, 10 suits, and 3 colours. Each hand, players will receive a hand of 15 cards and will bid for the right to be declarer, who plays alone against the other two players. The declarer receives an extra 2 cards into their hand, and gets their pick of the three types of melds. The other two players will choose their melds in turn. The play of the game is similar to other…
461966.name: Manticore

461999.name: Jingle Bell Roll: Fruitcake Promo Card

462043.description: Naja naja is a tense two-player, duel-style climbing card game inspired by the classic Japanese "Daifugo" (President) mechanic—ideal for people who want a strategic head-to-head experience. Each player aims to be the first to play all of their cards by matching numbers or playing runs of the same suit. Passing during a round allows your hand to be enhanced, setting you up for more powerful plays in future rounds—so losing a battle can set up a comeback! Unique to Naja naja, card strengths shift dynamically round-to-round according to the "trend" set by unplayed cards, keeping each duel fresh…

publishers: 九张牌玩具公司(9 Cards Toy Company)

462163.name: Fleece & Fortune: The Cotswold Woollen Industry in 18th-century Gloucestershire

462192.name: The Crew: Journey to the Ends of the Earth

462264.description: DuvidaÊ! (Doubt It!) is a bluffing climbing game where the goal is to get rid of all the cards in your hand. Each player must play a stronger combination than the previous one – cards with higher value, or more cards. From 2 cards onwards, however, only one is played face up – all the others are played face down. This gives the next player the option to doubt. By doubting, they can trigger traps that affect the player who is wrong – the one who doubted, if the hand is as declared, or the one who bluffed, if it is not. Play your cards on the table, look closely at the next player, declare your…
462264.name: DuvidaÊ!

462276.description: This is eckso, a fast, two-player strategy game where magnets and gravity determine whether you win or topple. Every move brings you closer to capturing a symbol for the win, OR toppling the board! To play, you build the board outwards from the pedestal. Overlap or underlap one of the existing cards on each turn. Your goal is to capture at least one of your opponent’s symbols by boxing it in. As you expand the board, though, it becomes more and more unstable. Make it too delicate, and your winning move could topple the whole thing. Placing a card changes the board significantly, because each…
462276.name: eckso

462293.description: Autocards is an accessible and tactical card game where players compete to be the first to get rid of all their cards. It can be played with 2 to 7 players. Each round, the starting player chooses how many cards to play, and the others follow by playing higher sets of the same number. Can't play? Pass. Play smart and dump your cards as fast as possible! With fewer than 5 players, when you pass, you can draw extra cards or snag one from the table, adding extra tension. Autocards is easy to learn and delivers tons of fun with family and friends. Ideal for both small or large groups, whether…
462293.name: Autocards

462308.description: P.E.N is a shedding game, where the players aim to play all of the cards from their hand first. The lead player chooses one of the available combinations of cards to play (e.g. single card in blue or a pair of numbers), flips over the corresponding card, and then play proceeds. As combinations are flipped over, there are more points available to a player who plays all of their cards, and the combinations are not available again until, basically, all of them have been used once. The person with the most points, once someone has 10 points at the end of a round, wins.
462308.name: P.E.N
publishers: Southern Cross Games (サザンクロスゲームズ)

462309.description: Buildin' Tycoon is a shedding game, where in addition to playing cards, players play buildings. At the start of the game, players can only play a single card on their turn. As the game continues, players can use cards from their hand as buildings that allow them to play additional cards, alter the value of their cards, etc. Generally, constructing these buildings require a player to add additional cards to their hand - making it harder to go out. The first person to play all of their cards wins.
462309.name: Buildin' Tycoon
publishers: Southern Cross Games (サザンクロスゲームズ)

462319.name: The Zach Attack! Scratch 'n Solve Puzzle Pack

462568.description: In Greedy Goose, you want to snatch as many snacks as possible, but if you get too grabby, you'll lose some of what you already hold. The deck consists of cards numbered 1-4, with 3s being present in both green and yellow; twelve action cards are present as well. Spread all of these cards face down on the table. Each player takes three cards in hand. On a turn, you must turn a face-down card face up. If two identical cards are now face up, you must end your turn and add all face-up cards to your hand. If not, you can either reveal another card (and again check for matching cards), stop and…
462568.name: Greedy Goose

462610.description: A snappy and sweet push-your-luck card game about avoiding bad apples, collecting furry fruit critters ...and selling them for maximum profit! Each round the market will change with new cards displaying the demands for the round. The players will then decide to draw cards, or stop and sell according to demand. The deck does not only contain charming furruits however, there are quite a lot of bad apples in there, as well as effects that will change the market and your furruits... The most successful furruit merchant after 3 rounds wins the game! —description from the designer
462610.name: Furruits

462652.description: Get rid of all your Chameleon Cards as quickly as possible! Use Fruit Cards cleverly to change the colors of Chameleons and reach your goal faster! Each round, you have two action options: play connected chameleon cards, or add fruit cards to change the colors of adjacent chameleons! You may play chameleon cards that match the current “party” color to join them, or play additional cards to change the party’s color. If the cards you play make the party reach exactly 8 cards, you can clear the party and immediately take another turn!
462652.name: COLOR8

462657.description: MEGAPEDE catapults the player (alone or with friends) into the final days before universal collapse. Over the course of aeons, the stars have more than once come close to being extinguished by artificial means, yet providence has always lent a hand to its ungrateful children. This time is different. Somewhere deep within the cosmic drape, a colossal threat unclassifiable by science has emerged. To millenarian sects, it is a god in disguise, whose purpose is to punish and reset a reality that's failed utterly. Aiding these alien world-eaters and twisted zealots are cadres of corrupt…
462657.name: MEGAPEDE

462660.description: Every year, the boldest surfers face off at Tiburón Beach. Compete to ride the most waves and claim glory. You decide whether to go all in or back off in time. Here, pushing your luck is part of the game. If you want to conquer Tiburón Beach,surf the waves wisely—but beware of the surfer shark. Will you be the one to master the waves and grab the best boards? Every turn, push your luck to try and surf 5 waves to win the winning board. If a shark shows up, you've lost your turn! If you decide not to play more cards, you can preserve your waves and do all the special action. The first to have 3…
462660.name: Tiburón Beach

462724.name: "D" Is for D Day A Front Line Game

462910.description: Cooked Pirates invites you to become captain of a ridiculously incompetent pirate crew in a manga-inspired card battler. Fight with bizarre characters, like a vetetable wielding swordsman, each desperate to prove their worth in a world where gold is scarce and loyalty is bought. The gameplay revolves around high-interaction elements. Each turn has a mandatory auction with a veto twist, where players bid gold to recruit new pirates. You must carefully manage your treasury, as strong pirate come with a gold cost. In combat, you fight with your active crew-pirate, and an optional face-down…
462910.name: Cooked Pirates

462935.name: デブリウム -オタカラ- (Debrium: Treasure)

462938.description: Backyard Blackjack is a cooperative, take on the classic casino staple blackjack. 2–5 players work together to try have more chips than the casino by the end of 10 hands. During those 10 hands, the team must navigate unique casinos and unpredictable dealer events. You win by taking the casino's chip reserve or finishing the final round with the larger stack. But be warned: the house always wins a tie. Core Gameplay: While the goal remains the classic "get to 21," the way you get there is entirely cooperative: Shared Resource Management: Your chips are a shared pool. You can spend them to…
462938.name: Backyard Blackjack

462987.description: Rat Schemes is a tactical survival card game for 4–10 players set in medieval times. Players take on the roles of selfish rats competing to be the last one standing while avoiding capture by the Hunter. The game emphasizes direct player interaction through betrayal, deception, and strategic backstabbing. The game consists of two distinct phases. In Phase 1 (Schemes and Intrigues), players draw and play cards to attack opponents, steal resources, and accumulate Cheese — the game’s survival currency. Attack cards include Bite (forcing players to lose Cheese or skip turns), Rat Trap (stunning…
462987.name: Rat Schemes: A Survival Card Game

463199.description: Loot the World is a tile ownership, connect-the-board, & push-your-luck strategy game for 3 to 4 players. Take control of Victorian era trading companies in a rabbid race to convert land into cold hard cash over a series of rounds where each player takes their turn using a Progressive Turn Order mechanism. There are two ways to win the game: either be the first player to connect opposite cardinal ends (i.e. North to South or East to West) with a continuous chain of owned tiles, or be the first to amass 40 or more gold bars in wealth. To achieve victory, players will purchase tiles, upgrade…
463199.name: Loot the World

463215.description: Once upon a time, there was a veeery tired wizard... In Adventurers Required, players can land their dream job: Who hasn't always wanted to be HR manager of a guild? Assemble a team of sneaky adventurers, tiptoe into the wizard's tower, and snatch his treasures. But beware! Alongside their skills, the team’s noise rating is cruicial. If things get too loud, they’ll wake the wizard. And that would be very bad... At the start of each round, players have to hire one new team member. And yes, it will be tricky to choose from the recruits: A card from your hand, one from the market or will a lucky…
463215.name: Adventurers Required

463489.description: All You Can Chili A fast, spicy push-your-luck card game for 2–6 players. Serve dishes to push your rivals past their hidden spice tolerance—while keeping your own character under the limit. Bank your points before you bust. 20 minutes, ages 8+. In All You Can Chili, each player is secretly assigned a character and a hidden Tolerance Threshold: the spice level they can endure before losing control. Players serve Dish Cards to the characters in play, trying to push their opponents past their limit while staying under their own. On your turn you either serve a dish (play a Dish Card under a…
463489.name: All You Can Chili

463521.description: Who will crown themselves as the master thief of Artifox? Step into the bustling city of Artifox Famous for it's beautifull Artifacts. As a fox living on the street, life is tough, but your cunning and courage can take you far! You dream of more, and you know that by perfecting the art of stealing, you can amass great wealth. Do you dare to take on the challenge? Artifox is a strategic and interactive card game for 2 players that takes you on a whirlwind adventure full of cunning and deception. Start with a base deck and traverse the city to steal from various shops. Each card stolen will be…
463521.name: Artifox

463652.description: Bloops is a clever and chaotic card game where memory and attention make all the difference. Each player starts with a grid of face-down cards, memorizing only three of them to start. From there, the tension builds as cards are drawn, discarded, swapped, and secretly added. Every turn offers a choice: discard the card you just drew, or keep it and discard one of your own without looking at it. Special cards trigger immediate effects, allowing you to peek, force cards onto opponents, or even swap cards blindly. And at any moment, any player can jump in with a counter-discard… as long as…
463652.name: Bloops

463720.description: Are you ready for the most chaotic race of your life? Trouble Racer is the high-octane board game where speed is nothing without strategy, and the lead is never safe! This game brings the raw adrenaline of the racing track directly to your game night table. Step into the world of professional racing! Take full control and fine-tune your racing car setup to get the maximum out for this race weekend. On your personal Setup Board, you hold the power: Will you push for legendary Top Speed to blast down the straights, or master the corners with superior Downforce? We’ve designed the experience to…
463720.name: Trouble Racer

463776.description: Each player is given one half of the deck, from which they initially draw five cards for a starter hand, and take turns playing cards to a center stack, by either matching the bird, or the colored border of the card. The person who runs out of cards first wins.
463776.name: Tweethearts

463807.description: The city never sleeps, and neither do the crews looking to take it for everything it's worth. You and your rivals all have eyes on the same prize—vaults full of cash, high-end loot, and a chance to cement your crew’s reputation as the best in the business. But there’s a problem: the more jobs each crew pulls, the more attention they attract. Sooner or later, the cops will be breathing down someone’s neck. Play it smart or play it fast—every job adds Heat, and when things get too hot, the whole operation could go up in smoke. The crew that scores big without getting busted takes the glory. The…
463807.name: Duelyn: Vault Breakers

463827.description: First or Last is a 2p only climbing/shedding game. At the start of each hand, after cards are dealt, one player must decide if they will shed out first or shed out last. The rules of card play change based on which one they choose. A deal consists of players having cards in their hand (hidden from the other player) as well as a strawman pile (a face up pile of cards on the table in a 2-3-2 formation). Cards in the strawman pile are part of your hand for scoring, but not part of your hand for shedding out. However, if you pass you must draw one card from your strawman pile, adding it to your…
463827.name: First or Last

463848.description: Song of the Wildkin is a cooperative adventure for 1 to 4 players. Find your missing mentor, Hammer Wildmane, and safeguard your community from the mysterious forces turning peaceful woodbeasts into frenzied threats. The campaign unfolds across a series of Chapters, each carrying your party to a distinct region of the world. Your journey begins in the Giggling Glade, a sanctuary of art and song tended by fairies, and will lead you to places few Wildkin ever dream of. Within a chapter, you will brave the wilds through a variety of Scenarios, featuring unique objectives, challenges, and…
463848.name: Song of the Wildkin

463911.description: Do you dare venture into the Tricky Forest? In the shade of the trees, the gangs of field mice, tree frogs, lizards, and finches are planning their next raids. New alliances are formed in each trick-taking round, and every decision can change the course of the game. Four cleverly illustrated animal teams with numerical values ​​from one to ten and special abilities ensure surprising twists and turns. Joining the winning team at the right moment earns you silver coins. Fast-paced rounds keep the excitement high and make the game an entertaining experience for trick-taking game fans, families,…
463911.name: Tricky Teams

463946.description: Dog Pile is a fast, press-your-luck party card game where players build a shared pile of dogs and try to claim it at just the right moment. Play dog cards, jump in out of turn with matching dogs, and decide when to stop pushing your luck and claim the pile using one of your small dogs. On your turn, add a Large or Medium dog card to the growing central pile. When the timing feels just right, finish the pile with a Small dog to claim it and score. Each player only gets 4 Small dogs, so pick your moments wisely! If you have the exact same dog as the top card on the pile, you can interrupt with…
463946.name: Dog Pile: The Card Game

463961.description: Every round, the crazy pitching octopuses will swing multiple dice! Let's gather the players and hit them back! The eyes of the dice are written on the card, and the same eyes appear, and it is wonderfully hit! Earn money, tacoyaki, and honor! Use the money you earn and takoyaki to scout new players! If you put out too much batter, the defense will be sweeter, and maybe it will be a dead ball ...?! The player who receives the 20th pitch (dice) of the 8th round and the most honorable player wins! ••• 毎ラウンド、クレイジーピッチングオクトパスはダイスを複数振ってくるぞ！ 各プレイヤーは選手を集めて打ち返そう！…
463961.name: VSクレイジーピッチングオクトパス (VS Crazy Pitching Octopus)

463962.description: DeFuZion! Wild Dice is a push your luck dice game for 2 to 6 players, played in about 15 minutes. Roll dice and match them to cards to slow down a FuZe that is constantly burning. Every player starts with 100 FuZe. On your turn you roll five dice plus the custom Wild Die, use up to two rerolls, and then assign every die to a card in a row of five cards. Dice assigned to the same card add together. Your damage on a number card is the distance between the card and the total of the dice on it. Match it exactly and you take no damage. Leave a card empty and it counts as 0, so an empty 8 deals you…
463962.name: DeFuZion: Wild Dice

464014.description: Dead Hand is a solitaire roguelike adventure played entirely with three standard poker decks. Each turn you draw a handful of dungeon, treasure, and monster cards, then decide the order to resolve them in a tense sequencing puzzle where every choice matters. There are no phases and no downtime — just a constant push‑your‑luck flow of tactical decisions, resource management, and escalating danger. You begin with a small set of stats (Attack, Defense, Skill, HP, and DrawMod), and the dungeon grows more dangerous as your DrawMod increases. Monsters scale by tier, treasures provide temporary or…
464014.name: Dead Hand

464055.description: The Twelve Zodiacs is a standalone card game set in the world of Steam Up. The twelve Zodiacs are on a tasty mission to enjoy a delicious dim sum feast. Knowing the meal isn’t complete without Egg Tarts at the end, they must give it their all to collect the most egg tarts in this ladder-climbing card game. The game is played in rounds. Each player begins with 8 cards in hand, including 7 Zodiac cards and 1 Wild card.On each turn, a player takes one of two actions: • Play: A player must play a valid card set. The set played must rank higher than the previously played set. After playing, if a…
464055.name: Steam Up: Twelve Zodiacs Card Game

464115.description: Date Drop is a fast paced card game about harvesting dates. Your goal is to be the first to pack all your date boxes. To harvest dates, you need to flip cards one-by-one. After each flip, you may top to ollect them, UNLESS you just flipped one of the following: If you flipped a DUPLICATE, you keep nothing! If you flipped a DATE DROP, everyone gets a chance to grab a flipped card! There are also a few simple but powerful abilities to help you harvest quickly. The first person to pack all their date boxes win! —description from the publisher
464115.name: Date Drop

464145.description: The strategic showdown that cranks the tension up a notch. After the huge success of Roll’n Bump, it’s time for Roll’n Bump Duel — a version designed specifically for head-to-head battles. Roll the dice, claim the best cards, and place them cleverly in your 4×4 grid. Every decision matters: each completed row scores points… but only if you skillfully diversify the three available card colors. But beware — nothing is ever guaranteed. Bonus cards can turn the tables at any moment. Play them at the perfect time to trigger a game-changing special action, or save them to score surprise points at…
464145.name: Roll'n Bump Duel

464200.description: "Round up broken heroes, pavement prophets, and alleyway weirdos to climb the rusty rungs of street power in LONERS! Recruit street toughs to build your hand, slam down powerful sets and runs to show your muscle, and call security if things get too hot. Wow never pegged you for a snitch?? Be the first to shed all your cards and win!" LONERS is a thematic climbing game of high times and low-lifes. Play ever-escalating combos from your hand to take down the active crew on the block. You can’t rearrange your hand, so you’ll need to recruit public Loner cards to juice your combos—but that’s…
464200.name: Loners

464201.description: A community of very charismatic little animals has arrived in an unexplored forest to build the home they've always dreamed of. They are now known as the "Forest Fellowship". The game is divided into short turns where each player can activate only one of their main character cards. Each player starts the game with three cards (their crew): two main characters (a Lumberjack and a Picker) plus a Carpenter. On each turn, the player activates one of their main characters, performing these 3 phases: Move > Action (Take, Talk or Explore) > Relocation The winner is the player who manages to be the…
464201.name: Forest Fellowship: First Settlement

464206.description: Sly3 card game is a fast-paced card game for 2–6 players where you race to empty three card zones before anyone else. Games take about 15 minutes. Ages 7+. Players compete to clear their Hand, Open Cards (face-up), and Sly Cards (face-down, played blind). On your turn, play a card equal to or higher than the top of the pile. Can't play? Pick up the whole pile. The Chaos Rule is the heart of the game: any player holding a matching card can play it out of turn — interrupting anyone, at any time. This is the base game, not a variant. Special cards shake things up: 7 forces low play, 9 skips the…
464206.name: Sly3 Card Game

464272.description: Creatoons: Caricatures of Great Creators is a card game for 2 to 4 players, played over three rounds, in which players compete to become the most inspired and brilliant creator. Each player represents a single artistic discipline —Writers, Composers, Painters, or Filmmakers— and scores points primarily through the characters of their own discipline. Character cards feature three values (Genius, Originality, and Fecundity), with Genius being the core value used for scoring, while the others come into play through specific card effects. Players always hold five cards in hand. On their turn,…
464272.name: Creatoons: Caricatures of Great Creators

464353.description: You love books, but your shelf is stuffed? With the card game No Shelf Control, you can tame the chaos in a playful way! Stack your bookshelf cards by matching colors and collect decorative items for bonus points. But be careful: you can’t place a book on top of a decoration item, and if you end up with an unread stack, you lose points. Each round, you draw a card — if you're lucky, it fits your stack, your shelf grows taller, and you earn more points. But if it doesn’t fit, your shelf collapses. Fortunately, you have a token that lets you repel a card or draw an extra one. Do you want to…
464353.name: No Shelf Control

464412.description: Meat on Swords is a push your luck card game from Friedey's Restaurant, home of the Cheapass classic, Lord of the Fries. Most Lord of the Fries games use a menu-based system to combine ingredients into recipes and combo meals, but here at Carnespadas Brazilian Steakhouse, there's no such thing as a menu. We just bring you meat on swords until you give up or explode. In Meat on Swords, players declare before each round whether they are in or out for the round. Then the dealer asks each "in" player whether they want the next card on the deck. If they refuse the first card, they must take the…
464412.name: Meat on Swords

464436.name: Kryptothera: The Cryptid Pursuit – Solo & Co-op Mode

464584.description: On the board, the players will stand. Each one in a corner with a different color from the others, and each player must place their heart at the farthest point from the BIIIR. which is located at the center of the board. First step: the player must determine the direction of the light, meaning they throw the dice, which is the light cube. After that, they randomly draw a dark monster from the bag and place it next to the BIIIR in the direction of the light. Immediately after, they must draw a card which has an effect depending on the type of card drawn. Among these effects is placing barriers…
464584.name: Biiirgame

464612.description: Herbcraft is a fast-paced card game with an addictive mix of push-your-luck, deck-building and pick-and-pass that plays in just 25 minutes. Set in the same fantastical setting as Mercurial: Alchemia, players are floramancers, cultivating magical herbs while trying to avoid growing Blightweeds. Each round, players simultaneously reveal Herb cards from their decks and stack them left-to-right, increasing the rewards they’ll gain from harvesting later. Card positioning matters, as do collecting sets of materials — but many Herbs grant powers that let players reorder cards or control what they…
464612.name: Herbcraft

464676.name: Please Don't Burn My Village!: Trash To Treasure Promo Card

464827.description: Dinosaurs have taken over the pool and every turn you try to grow the best collections. Play all cards of one dinosaur type from your hand, take any matching cards from the center into your display, and resolve the played card’s action, which can draw cards, steal dinos, or force opponents to discard. Reach six of a kind to claim a Dinoparty and make everyone else remove that type from their displays. Pool star cards mix things up by acting like dinos and triggering actions. Celebrate three Dinoparties to win the game and earn the title Supersaurus! Quick turns and lots of player interaction…
464827.name: Dino Party

464946.description: Do you believe in Meritocracy? How sweet. In Mentirocracia, you will discover what really happens behind the scenes of the corporate world. Start from the bottom, dream big, and pull as many rugs as necessary to achieve the much-desired promotion. But beware: your coworkers will do the same to you! To "help" you on this journey, you will receive valuable advice from the famous Lino Silveira: open relationship manager, celebrity baker, DJ, model, and COACH! Mentirocracia is a satirical game about the professional advancement process. A biting and humorous critique of the idealized concept of…
464946.name: Mentirocracia

465013.description: Forge qui peut! is an offbeat exploration game packed with references, in which players venture into the heart of a mine fiercely guarded by a dragon. With the wedding of the dwarf king and queen fast approaching, only the most magnificent Gifts will do — and the precious gems hidden in the mine are the key to forging them. Each turn, players reveal Mine cards to uncover what lies within: gems essential for crafting Gifts and earning victory points… or encounters in the dark Tunnels that trigger various events. The game is built around a push‑your‑luck mechanic: every card flipped generates…
465013.name: Forge qui peut !

465072.description: Desire FOR Chances is a high-stakes survival card game that blends the tension of 'Russian Roulette' with magical chaos and strategic bluffing. THE GOAL Survive the deadly elixir tasting. The last player standing wins the game! GAMEPLAY OVERWIEV Each round begins with a roll of the dice to determine the ratio of "X Potions" and "Empty Bottles" hidden face-down on the table. Players draw "Spell Cards" to manipulate the odds, peek at hidden dangers, or sabotage their rivals. When it's your turn, you must trust your instincts and memory, and then make a critical choice; Risk it on Yourself: If…
465072.name: Desire FOR Chances

465091.description: The Bats of Purple Valley live quietly in their cave. They generally dislike spending much energy. They prefer small negatives over large ones. They seem to live at a leisurly, unhurried pace. But on nights when the full moon rises, it's different... The great party begins and now, more and more companions gather... and the more, the merrier! For the Moon is a ladder climbing game. The cards usually are negative, going weakest to strongest from -9 to -1. They must play a number of cards of the same value on the table, and the players must follow with the same number of cards with a higher…
465091.name: For the Moon

465144.description: In High Pressure, players compete to dive deeper than their rivals over four rounds. Each round begins with players secretly selecting two Safe cards and one Hazard card from their hand. One card is placed face down into each depth row, building a shared grid of possible dive locations. Players always know where they placed their own cards, but must guess where others have placed hazards. After the grid is built, all players simultaneously choose a column to dive in by secretly setting their die. The choices are revealed at the same time, and the selected cards at that depth are flipped. If a…
465144.name: High Pressure

465231.description: Play With Fire is a competitive elimination card game for 2 to 6 players (15-30 min) where the goal is to be the last survivor with at least one active Heart Card. The core gameplay centers on a dynamic, push-your-luck mana system used to fuel tactical spells and effects against opponents, featuring 110 hand-illustrated cards. Each player chooses a Hero from those available by consulting the Matchmaking Table based on the number of participants. Each profile indicates how many and which Heart Cards (lives) are at the player's disposal at the start, which are placed face-up next to the hero.…
465231.name: Play With Fire: The Card Game

46530.description: From the publisher: The Red Dragon Inn: Gambling I'm In! is a game about the games that the heroes play when they gamble at the Red Dragon Inn. Now, players of The Red Dragon Inn, The Red Dragon Inn 2, The Red Dragon Inn 3, and The Red Dragon Inn 4 can play out an actual round of gambling when they play the "Gambling? I'm In!" card! Even better, the gambling games also can be played on their own as standalone games, or as part of your RPG, or LARP. The game will come with a 93 card Rogues and Warriors Deck, a bunch of 6 sided dice, coin tokens, debt and loan tokens and rules for at least 7…
46530.name: The Red Dragon Inn: Gambling? I'm In!

465348.description: In PAC-MAN: Craze Maze, each player builds their own maze over the course of the game, gradually shaping a network of paths filled with dots, power pellets, fruit, and ghosts. On your turn, draw a tile and either replace one in your grid or reveal a hidden tile. As the maze evolves, you must plan carefully: at the end of the game, only one continuous path from PAC-MAN to a single exit will score. Items along that path grant points, while ghosts create a risk–reward challenge. Place ghosts after a Power Pellet to score increasing bonuses — but any ghost without protection will cost you points.…
465348.name: PAC-MAN Craze Maze

465435.description: Board game Рієлтор ("Realtor") — become a master of deals and the king of real estate! Imagine: you have clients with completely different desires and requests. Someone is looking for a house by the lake, someone needs an apartment with a terrace, and someone dreams of a cozy family cottage. Your task is to find the perfect home for each of them, make the most profitable deals, and prove to everyone that you are the best realtor in town. Realtor is a fast-paced, witty, and very lively card game about bargaining, intuition, and the ability to play on your opponents' predictions. Every move…
465435.name: Рієлтор (Realtor)

465457.description: In Hot Heads, you play as a reckless pilot in a hot-air balloon race. Try to reach incredible heights, but be careful not to fly too high. After all, high flyers catch a lot of wind and get lost in the storms raging high in the sky. Low flyers, however, score few points and won’t lead you to victory. If you can find the perfect balance, you might just emerge as the winner of the race. During the game, on their turn, players draw one card and play one card. You may place this card either in front of yourself or in front of an opponent. This way you can help your own team rise, or sabotage an…
465457.name: Hot Heads

465597.name: Horse Racing Jam: Memory and Luck Showdown!

465782.description: Immerse yourself in the vibrant energy and centuries-old rivalry of the Amazon's largest folklore festival! In Contrário, players take on the enormous responsibility of commanding the performances at the Bumbódromo, defending their colors with strategy, cunning, and passion. Choose your side in this epic contest: the strength of Boi Caprichoso, black and sporting its imposing blue star on its forehead, or the tenacity of Boi Garantido, entirely white and guided by its vibrant red heart on its forehead. The goal of the game is to orchestrate a flawless spectacle, managing to accumulate exactly…
465782.name: Contrário: O jogo de Cartas dos Bois de Parintins

465896.name: Kingdom of Cutetopia: By Order of the King

465992.description: Lucky Saloon is a Wild-West card game where the goal is to be the last player alive. Setup: Each player starts with life tokens and a few item cards. Shuffle the item deck and bullet deck. On your turn: Draw cards. Play item cards (heal, steal, protect, etc.). Choose a player and shoot by drawing a bullet card. If the bullet is real, the target loses life. If not, nothing happens. When a player’s life reaches 0, they’re out. Last player alive wins. —description from the publisher
465992.name: Lucky Saloon

466004.description: Answer the call. Push Deeper, pay the price, outplay your Rivals, & claim the Crown, before the Island claims you. Beyond the edge of every honest map lies Treasure Island. An island of jungle and ruin. Of forgotten temples and buried gold. Of pirates who vanish, or return as legends. You are rival Captains chasing that dream. Each Voyage you sail closer. Each step inland tempts fate. Turn back early, sail away and keep your coins. Push deeper, and grow rich. But beware. The seas grow harsher. Supplies grow costly. The Rising Tides spare no one. The Island remembers. It remembers greed,…
466004.name: Treasure Island: Pirate Showdown

466022.description: In Sky 5, players push their luck as they build a tableau of colorful sky cards, trying to assemble one of each of the five colors to complete a Sky 5. Each turn presents a simple but tense decision: draw a card to grow your tableau, or roll the die to try to bank the cards you already have. Drawing cards helps you work toward the perfect five-color collection, but it comes with risk. If you reveal a color you already have, the card may end up helping your opponents instead. Rolling the die offers a chance to secure your points, but only if the result does not match any value in your tableau.…
466022.name: Sky 5

466025.description: Alea Iacta Est “The dice have been thrown." Three dice, 216 possible outcomes… will you achieve your goal? 216 recaptures the essence of classic dice games and combines it with a modern twist. You must meet the challenges presented by the Objective Cards, while managing strategic decisions that makes each game unique, dynamic, and exciting. —description from the designer Alea Iacta Est “los dados han sido lanzados” Tres dados, 216 resultados posibles… ¿lograrás alcanzar tu objetivo? 216 recupera la esencia de los juegos clásicos de dados y la combina con un giro moderno. Deberás cumplir los…

466154.description: A push your luck game where you collect and eat biscuits. There’s a pile of tasty looking cards on the table. But hidden among the biscuits are some miscellaneous objects which have fallen into the tin… Turn over cards to reveal either a biscuit or a non-biscuit. Biscuits might be chocolate, round, rectangular, or sandwich — or many of these together. Push your luck to gather more biscuits, but if you reveal a Lego or a leaf, your turn is over. Each turn you’ll also turn over an EAT card, which tells you which type of biscuits you can eat. So will you try to collect chocolate biscuits or…
466154.name: Risk It For A Biscuit

466326.description: Just Tillin is a 3-8 player card game about cereal grain farming in Texas. Players compete to work their fields by playing crop cards in ascending or descending order from the central “7” cards. Farmers must be in the field they are working, requiring clever use of tractors and strategic timing. Rocks can slow opponents, storms act as jokers, and players must carefully manage their hands across three rounds to finish with the lowest score. —description from the publisher
466326.name: Just Tillin'

466363.description: The Forest is the next evolution of the classic push-your-luck card game: blending creepy atmosphere, humor, and lots, LOTS OF STRATEGY. The players become fearless adventurers who venture into a dark and mysterious forest, inhabited by creatures and beings forgotten by time and civilization. Draw a role card and define your starting survival kit. Then, advance deeper into the forest by drawing cards from the deck. Sometimes luck will be on your side, and you’ll find useful items or friendly creatures—use them wisely! But if that’s not the case… well, let’s just hope you don’t encounter THE…
466363.name: The Forest

466438.description: Jelly is a fast, colourful push-your-luck card game filled with charming jelly characters and shifting team dynamics. Each round, players roll dice simultaneously to try to collect Jelly cards worth points. They can keep rolling to improve their outcome — but if they roll doubles, they Burst and collect nothing for that round. Every turn is a balance between securing points or risking it all for something better. As the game unfolds, players gain and shift between teams using Team Bean cards, creating an ongoing tension between personal scoring and collective success. Only players on the team…
466438.name: JELLY

466444.description: The Monster realm is at war. The different regions are vying for control of the Totems of The Super Weird World of Monsters. In Monsters at War players will take on the role of one of the great Leaders of the Super Weird World of Monsters and vie for control of the Totems of Power. The first player to gain 4 totems (Four player) wins the game. Monsters at War is a card game for 2-4 players, aged 13 up. A game of Monsters at War will last anywhere from 45 minutes to 1 hour. —description from the designer
466444.name: Monsters At War

466455.description: Spell words with cards to empty your hand: cook up stronger combinations to claim VPs, make longer ones to stir things up, or strategically pass to get a bonus. So, can you scoop a word before it sinks? The game is played in 3 rounds. Players take turns playing and claiming letter combinations. Each combination must be a word of 3+ letters and stronger than the previous one played. The earlier you run out of cards in your hand each round, the more Victory Points (VP) you score for your claimed words. The player with the most VP after three rounds wins. —description from the publisher
466455.name: Written in Soup

466483.description: You have been studying the dark arts of poison for many years under the tutelage of the masters of the Poisoners Guild. Now it is time for your final exam. You and your fellow initiates are led into the inner sanctum of the Guild and a cup is placed in front of each of you. In order for you to pass the exam and be admitted to the Guild . . . one of your fellow initiates can't survive! The Poisoners Guild is a 2-4 player card game where your goal is to outsmart and outlast your fellow players in a high-stakes test of wits and nerve. There are four deadly poisons at the table ... and you are…
466483.name: The Poisoners Guild

466766.description: Pirates Dragons Treasure (PDT) Second Edition is a competitive tabletop card game for 2-6 players where you play as a pirate captain. PDT is set in a vibrant age of piracy where dragons roam, and fortunes are won and lost at sea. Each player starts with their Captain and an empty ship, then recruits a crew, upgrades their vessel, and collects powerful armaments to improve their odds in battle against the dragon. Every turn you work to strengthen your ship, refine your strategy, and inch closer to facing off against the beast. You are racing against the other players, competing for limited…
466766.name: Pirates Dragons Treasure: 2nd Edition

466787.description: Welcome to the Fur-nancial District, where fortunes are made and lost in a whisker. Are you on the hunt for the next Big Fish? Ready to ride a Whale? Pump your friends into Crypto Fish? Dodge the crash? Buy the dip? Or take home those sweet, sweet, dividends? If so, suit up and sharpen your claws. The Market opens in 60 seconds. Fat Cats is a stock market card game for 2-6 players where you buy, trade and crash your way through 72 million possible markets. A card game for people who love cats and making money. —description from the publisher
466787.name: Fat Cats

466896.name: Hovercraft in a Minefield: Alligator Rescue

466939.description: SIXSEVEN is a fast and addictive dice game where every decision matters. Each round, players roll two dice and choose what to do with the result: keep a die, reroll, or push their luck to improve their combination. The goal is to score as high as possible… or achieve the coveted SIX SEVEN. But be careful—taking risks can cost you a strong roll. Ability cards add unexpected twists, keeping tension high in every turn. Win by scoring the most points… or instantly by rolling a double SIX SEVEN. Quick, simple, and full of tense decisions, SIXSEVEN always leaves you wanting one more round.…
466939.name: 67 Six Seven

466997.description: You have been studying the dark arts of poison for many years under the tutelage of the masters of the Poisoners Guild. Now it is time for your final exam. You and your fellow initiates are led into the inner sanctum of the Guild and a cup is placed in front of each of you. In order for you to pass the exam and be admitted to the Guild . . . one of your fellow initiates can't survive! The Poisoners Guild is a 2-4 player card game where your goal is to outsmart and outlast your fellow players in a high-stakes test of wits and nerve. There are four deadly poisons at the table ... and you are…
466997.name: The Poisoners Guild

467105.name: Festival of a Thousand Cats (Second Edition)

467274.description: One Fowl Poop is a funny, fast-paced family card game full of risky decisions, silly strategy, and constant interaction. Players compete to build the best nest by collecting egg cards, while doing their best to avoid picking up poop tokens. Every turn is a push-your-luck challenge as you balance reward against risk.
