Easy to learn and quick to play, One Fowl Poop is ideal for family game nights, parties, and casual get-togethers. Action cards, moving poop, and shifting nest conditions ensure no two games feel the same. With plenty of laughs, groans, and friendly rivalry, it’s a brilliant…
467274.name: One Fowl Poop

467330.name: No risc, no fun: win, lose or pass

467390.description: Players take on the role of casino builders, competing to create the most impressive and valuable casino floor. Using a shared set of cards, each turn moves quickly—draw, play, and expand. Cards are placed to form connected areas, and the way those spaces link together can make or break a strategy. Because all players draw from the same pool, no two games play out the same. Plans can come together quickly or be disrupted just as fast, keeping everyone involved and adjusting on the fly. By the end of the game, the player who has built the strongest casino—through smart placement, clever…
467390.name: Blueprint Casino

467391.description: Hero of Rome: Usurper is a free Low-Ink PnP, lore-heavy, high-agency political simulator, grand strategy, and historical roguelite set in the treacherous aftermath of the Great Fire of Rome. It blends tight resource management, push-your-luck dice resolution, and tableau-building into a ruthless race against time. You play as a wealthy Equestrian from the frontiers, one of the feared and powerful Rhenani. Your goal? Use every means possible to secure the access, power and influence that will let you replace Nero with your Iberian Candidate... before his patience runs out. You will actively…
467391.name: Hero of Rome: Usurper

467472.description: Please knock twice before entering. Pass by the table where a card game is in full swing under gentle lighting, and grab yourself a warm cup of coffee. Then come meet me on the balcony where palm trees sway. If you haven’t lingered too long on the lower floor, would you join me upstairs? Follow the spiral staircase all the way to the rooftop. This is a house of cards. It’s time to build it—one story at a time, each floor filled with stories of its own, stacked by your own hands. Many Stories Mansion is a game that blends ladder climbing with polyomino-style puzzles. Each player receives 15…
467472.name: Many Stories Mansion

467563.name: Atomic Twisted Tabletop: Mars Attacks Board Game

467894.description: The Abyss is a push-your-luck card game for 2 to 4 players set in the depths of the ocean, where every draw is a gamble. On your turn, take the top card of the discard pile, or draw two from the deck and keep one. Only the cards still in your hand score at the end of a round, so every combo you play is a sacrifice of points. Play two cards of the same type for a combo: Eye: look at the top 4 cards of the deck, then put them back on the top or the bottom Hook: force any player (even yourself) to draw 2 and discard 1 Sword: steal a random card from an opponent, or give them one of your Panic…
467894.name: The Abyss

467955.description: All Mine is a mining claim (trick-taking) game in which players predict their hauls of each of the four treasures (gold, gems, mushrooms, and dragon eggs). However, instead of predicting the number of hauls they'll take, they must state the treasures they think they'll receive the most and least of. Since all cards display their treasure type on the back, players have more information than usual. During each claim (hand), you must play the same treasure type if possible, even with the special trump cards. This requirement makes it difficult to predict which hauls you will bring in. In the…
467955.name: All Mine!

467997.description: Can’t Win is a trick-taking game where you must guess exactly how many times you’ll win, embellished with a twist at the start of each round: You also have to choose a constraint for yourself that limits which cards you are able to win tricks with. The constraint you choose can work for you—or against you—in matching the number of tricks you actually win to the number you bid you would win. At the end of every round, you’ll record the points you earn for your wins and matching bids. Your final score is calculated at the end of the game by multiplying your total wins with the points you score…
467997.name: Can't Win

468205.description: Big Stretch is a quick, easy 2 player push your luck game where you flip over cards to try to get a later time on the clock without going back in time. Features whimsical art and fits in your pocket with only 18 cards
468205.name: Big Stretch

468272.description: A Walmart exclusive edition of Sea Salt & Paper which includes the first two expansions: Extra Salt and Extra Pepper. During your turn, you assemble your hand, maybe place cards for their effect, and decide if you want to end the round. But do you think you are the one with the most points in hand? You will have to choose: stop the round immediately or give the others an extra turn to try to extend the gap? Is it worth taking the risk? The game ends when you reach 30/35/40 points (4/3/2 players). The excitement of ending the round to catch your opponents off guard The pleasure of playing your…
468272.name: Sea Salt & Paper: Includes Expansions Extra Salt & Extra Pepper

468290.name: Game of Thrones: Masters of Intrigue

468334.description: Heavy Hitter, Sorority Gal, and Babooshka are just some of the characters of Last Call. They each have an objective number that represents how much alcohol they can drink in a night out without having a hangover the next day. Think of blackjack, but instead of trying to hit "21", each player has their own unique number they are trying to hit. Go over your "limit" and you are out. Whoever gets closest without going over has maximized their night out and wins! But, unlike blackjack, you can also impact the hands of other players. On your turn, you will draw a Draw Card which have point values…
468334.name: Last Call: An Imaginary Drinking Game

468437.name: Masquerade Trick Party
publishers: Mysboard Games (ミスボドゲームズ)

468513.description: Crown Shuffle is a fast-paced card game about climbing the social ladder, stepping on egos, and doing whatever feels morally acceptable for roughly twenty minutes. Each round, players compete to get rid of all the cards in their hand as quickly as possible. The first players to empty their hands becomes the King and the Prince, while the last players become the Peasant and the Servant. At the start of each round, cards are shuffled and dealt to all players. Before play begins, players exchange cards according to their rank - the Peasants must give their strongest cards to the Kings, while the…
468513.name: Crown Shuffle

468622.description: Celebrating the anniversary of the foundation of Toubama, the two kamis that make the nigh sky try to bring joy with their stars. Discard a card in of the three play spaces, always discarding the immediate next valued card, to make the brightest night sky. Players score based on how many cards their rival still have in hand when they can't play a hand, but in they're too aggressive, the other kamis will think you're too harsh and give a point to the losing player. First player to reach 6 points, wins the game.
468622.name: Toubama no Hoshi

468750.description: ROLL THE DIE, PLACE THE DIE, ONE MUST DIE!
468750.name: The Four Deuces

468799.description: “This is like Fishing, but completely different.” - Ordinary seaman Ronald after the first game As in Fishing, your caught cards score points, then you use them to try to catch even more — but blowfish, two trump colors, and new buoys create a fresh game experience. In Fishing 2, you try to catch as many tricks as possible in 8 rounds because each card you catch is worth 1 point. You use your caught cards as bait for the next round — but if you did not catch enough tricks to do so, you first fill your hand with fresh cards from the ocean stack. You win Fishing 2 by scoring the most points.…
468799.name: Fishing 2

468836.description: In a hellish contest of risk and restraint, players try to survive thirteen tense tricks where ambition can turn into disaster. Winning is not always a blessing: a clever victory may bring rewards, but an ill-timed one can become a painful penalty. Each round asks players how far they dare to push their luck before greed ruins everything. Oshaka Trick is a trick-taking game in which players face a difficult choice over how greedy they should be in each trick. Winning tricks is not automatically beneficial, and poor judgment can lead to significant negative points. Across 13 tricks, players…
468836.name: Oshaka Trick

468867.name: Dog Star Shippers: Orders from Old Earth

468868.description: Become a haenyeo, the free-diving women of Jeju Island, and explore the depths of the sea to gather valuable marine life while helping protect the ocean. In Haenyeo: Sea Divers of Jeju, players secretly choose Dive Cards to determine how deep their divers will descend each round. Careful planning is essential, as actions can only be performed when divers remain connected to the surface through a chain of placements. Dive deeper to collect rarer resources and pearls, but risk losing your connection if gaps appear. Over 8 rounds, players compete to collect marine life, manage their resources,…
468868.name: 해녀: Sea Divers of Jeju

469080.description: Grand Dawn is a strategic 2v2 partnership climbing card game where players embody new deities ascending the ranks of Olympus to overthrow the fading old gods. Its strategic depth is derived from classic Chinese card games. Grand Dawn is far more than a card game—it is a test of wisdom, adaptability, and partnership. Its core lies in the dynamic balance between cooperation and competition. Players must master not only card combinations (singles, pairs, straights, bombs) but also the art of reading opponents, protecting partners, and seizing fleeting opportunities. Unlike purely chance-based…
469080.name: Grand Dawn

469083.description: By Order of the King is a fast-paced, test-your-luck social deduction game of devious lies and hidden roles set in the gory gallows of a medieval kingdom. Take turns as the Executioner, deciding which of your friends will suffer brutal, historical executions while players lie, bluff, and bargain with you to save their lives or fulfill hidden agendas. Each execution brings greater reward but choose the wrong player, and it may be your own head on the chopping block. In each game, one player becomes the Executioner, earning "crowns" for each head (dead player) brought back to the king. At the…
469083.name: By Order of the King

469124.description: В поисках ар-р-ртефактов ("Hounds and Treasures") is a family card game of memory with an element of risk, where you become treasure hunters and hunt for precious gems. Find pairs, collect profitable combinations, and become the best treasure seeker! At the start of the game, a 6×6 grid of gem cards is laid out face down in the center of the table. A market of equipment and book cards is formed. Players are dealt starting cards. Players take turns clockwise. A player's turn consists of three sequential phases: Card Play Phase – Shuffle and play cards from your deck. The player reveals them…
469124.name: В поисках ар-р-ртефактов (Hounds and Treasures)

469132.description: Some tennis athletes are stronger defending and attacking on certain sides of the court, while others are weaker. Your goal is to identify your opponent’s strengths and weaknesses during the game and use that information to defeat them, before they can do the same to you! Before the game starts, each player receives a random deck of cards. Each card shows a shape that represents the areas of the court (grid) the player can defend and return the ball from. Players can increase the game’s pace by smashing, using super shots, or aiming for unguarded areas of the opponent’s grid. On their turn,…
469132.name: Super Shot: Tennis SX

469219.name: 7th Sea: City of Five Sails – Blood and Salt

469330.name: ヒットアンドウィン (Hit and Win)

469334.name: ビットフリップ (BIT FLIP)
publishers: むこちゃん開発局 (Muko-chan Game Studios)

469373.description: Scout is a tactical card game where players build their own football squad by managing transfers and completing hidden formations. Each player receives a secret formation card with two possible squad structures. Throughout the game, players reveal footballer cards and place them into the transfer market, or strategically acquire entire rows to strengthen their team. Timing and decision-making are key: Will you wait for better players to appear, or secure a row before your opponents take it? The first player to complete one of their hidden formations — with the exact number of goalkeeper,…
469373.name: Scout

469486.description: Basant is a medium-weight strategy game for 2 to 4 players set in Lahore during the 2026 revival of the city's historic spring kite-flying festival. After 25 years of a province-wide ban, the skies of Lahore are open again. The old kite-making khandans (families) of the Walled City have to rebuild their workshops, revive their supply chains, and stake a claim to the festival's returning cultural legacy. But the same dangers that killed Basant the first time are back too: contraband metal-wire strings, unregistered kite factories, and a police force with drones on every rooftop. Each player…
469486.name: Basant: Festival of Kites

469489.description: GRIZZO is the most feared and most successful grizzly on this side of the Yukon River. Legend has it that not a single salmon slips through his paws when he’s fishing. Challenge accepted! Bold and fearless, you compete to see who can snatch the most and the best salmon. So sharpen your claws and get started, but steer clear of the stinky carcasses! Whoever ends up with the juiciest haul wins. —description from the publisher
469489.name: Grizzo

469534.description: Play as a nature spirit trying to save the sacred tree from the flames of Onibi... But you are not alone in your mission. Animal guardians and the Kodama come together to lend a hand. The Living Forest 2nd Edition combines the core game and Kodama expansion from the 1st Edition, now with a complete illustration overhaul. In Living Forest, you play as a nature spirit who will try to save the forest and its sacred tree from the flames of Onibi. But you are not alone in your mission as the animal guardians have come together to lend a hand around the Circle of Spirits where you progress. Each…
469534.name: Living Forest (Second Edition)

469560.description: Placing Orders is a climbing-shedding game for exactly three players, where each player can "place an order" for more cards at the start of the hand, but be careful, because they may be a liability instead of a benefit... Placing Orders is played with a deck of 52 playing cards. Each hand, the three players are dealt 12 cards. Players look at their hands and then, on the count of three, all simultaneously reveal from 0 to 5 fingers on their hand. Players take as many extra cards into their hand as fingers shown. Whichever player took the fewest cards starts the first climb. They can play an…
469560.name: Placing Orders

469652.description: This is a fast-paced, push-your-luck party game where the goal is to survive against ferocious sharks. The deck contains many shark cards, and you take damage each time you take a shark card. If your damage reaches a certain threshold, you are eliminated from the game. On your turn, you have two options: either reveal one card from your deck into the play area, or take one of the face-up cards on the table. One of the most important elements of this game is risk management. If the revealed card is the same as a card already in the play area, you must take both cards. As more cards accumulate…
469652.name: サメラニアン (SAMERANIAN)

469674.description: You and your team of artists are painting cobalt onto a cursed piece of pottery. If you don't paint the entire piece at once, the paint vanishes and you'll have to start again. Play patterns from your own deck to earn cobalt, but avoid the cursed bulls or you'll lose it all. At the end of each round, buy new cards to swap into your deck to make it even more powerful. Patterns you play can not only help you, they can help the person next to you, or your entire team. Every player has an important role, so create your decks strategically, discuss your teams plan, and know when to stop! If you're…
469674.name: Cobalt

469675.name: キメラトリックス (Chimera Tricks)

469718.name: The Break System: solo roguelite heist game

469750.description: You have wandered into a world of dreams, and now you must escape from the Dream Phantoms! Night Parade is a thrilling card game where you must trust your luck and probability as you flip cards. On your turn, you choose whether to add cards or take a chance and flip cards. If you reveal a Golden Lantern Card, it's a huge success! You can pass the Phantoms to another player. But if you fail, the Phantoms stay with you... Avoid collecting too many Phantoms and being eliminated, and try to survive until the very end by passing them on to others! —description from the publisher
469750.name: Night Parade

469766.description: Suddenly, everything around Arnie & Barney is bone dry. Where on earth did all the water go?! Now it’s time to collect water drops. But be careful: each container can hold a maximum of 11 drops. Any more and it overflows, but fewer usually won’t be enough to win! So think carefully whether to keep collecting or stop in time before the water spills over and you lose everything. The first player to secure the most drops three times becomes the “Water Champion” and wins the game! easy rules so you can start playing right away a fun twist on the classic Blackjack —description from the publisher
469766.name: Arnie & Barney Drop or Stop?!

469869.description: Find and collect sets of matching petroglyphs in a four by four tableau of face down cards. The four different colours make up a set in different ways. Red and yellow sets are two cards. A blue set is three cards. A green set is anywhere between one and six cards. If you turn over cards of different colours, you may shuffle a row or column before the turn moves to the next player. 17 cards. Each game one card is put aside without players knowing which card it is. —description from the designer
469869.name: Petroglyph

469932.name: Clank!: A Deck-Building Adventure – Master Thief Edition

470092.description: In Fauch & Fertig, young dragons must take responsibility and carefully manage their eggs. You collect cards, combine values and colors, and fulfill conditions to place your eggs. The better your cards work together, the faster you progress—but shared goals and clever decisions add an extra layer of strategy. The first player to place all their eggs wins this accessible yet tactical dragon showdown. —description from the publisher
470092.name: Fauch & Fertig

470109.description: G’Day and Welcome to Spiders! Everyone is dealt 3 cards, anyone can start and you can go around in whatever direction you like. When it comes to your turn, the basic rules are Draw 1 card from the Draw pile, then if you would like to / can, you can do one of the following three things: Play 1 card from your hand (this is optional) Battle a Dropbear (You can attack as many as you like during your turn depending on how many attack cards you have in your hand) Have A Crack (a mini Game in the game, but a Rule card allowing it must be on the table in order to play it) The object of the game is to…
470109.name: Spiders The Game

470113.description: Arrrgh! Or not? is a competitive pirate card game set on the High Sea of Taradiddle. Players captain their ships through unpredictable voyages, gaining and losing Reputation as they encounter treasure, trouble, curses, monsters, ghosts, magic, and other hazards of the High Sea. On each turn, players make choices that affect their voyage, their ship, and their standing among the other captains. Voyage cards create changing situations, while upgrades and other card effects alter how each ship handles the dangers ahead. Reputation rises and falls as players take risks, recover, improve their…
470113.name: Arrrgh! Or not?

470294.description: Setup is simple; just shuffle all the cards to create one deck. On your turn, you can either "draw one card from the deck" or "take one of the drawn cards." The deck is riddled with sharks, and each time you take a shark card, you take damage. If you accumulate a certain amount of damage, you're eliminated. Therefore, initially, you'll mostly be drawing one card from the deck. However, if there's a card identical to the one you drew already on the table, you must take both cards. One card inflicts little damage, but two inflicts a lot! The game ends when the deck runs out, with either all…
470294.name: Sameranian

470444.description: Lilo and Stitch have been tasked with locating the other 625 experiments of Dr. Jumba scattered throughout the Hawaiian Islands. Your mission will be to help them in this search and find the ideal place for each one. It won't be an easy task, as the former Captain Gantu and his lazy partner, Experiment 625, are also working to locate and capture experiments for the terrible Dr. Hamsterviel. In this push your luck game, heavily inspired by Quartz: O Jogo de Cartas (also designed from Sérgio Halaban), in each new turn you reveal cards showing experiments from Dr. Jumba, until you decide to stop…
470444.name: Stitch 626

470482.description: “And when he had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth beast say, Come and see. And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.” (Apocalypse 6:7-8) Apocalypse is a trick-taking game where the goal is to score the fewest points. Each round, you play cards and influence the Apocalypse tokens at the center of the table. Watch them carefully: if they are all flipped, the…
470482.name: Apocalypse

470551.description: Welcome to the annual Aquarium Festival! At this grand event, aquarium shops from all over showcase their finest collections, each trying to stand out among fierce competitors. Observe how other shops present their displays, adjust the composition of your aquatic collection, and seize the right moment to take advantage of sponsor support to make your exhibit shine. Among representatives from aquariums around the world, only the shop that demonstrates the most impressive collection will earn the prestigious title of “Aquarium Tycoon.” "Aquarium Festival" is a ladder climbing game supported by…
470551.name: Aquarium Festival

470674.description: A long journey to deliver some cheeses, pears, and a couple of elbow pipes. Watch out for those volatile suits! Fashion has never been deadlier. Entrepôt is a may-follow climbing shedding game for 2 players that uses domino tiles. Players will be moving their ship across the map (and perhaps using tiles from their hand to change the map) to play tiles and pick up tiles. Entrepôt uses a single set of double 6 dominoes with some other components for the map. Win by shedding out, but be careful to not play too many bombs! —description from the designer
470674.name: Entrepôt

470743.description: Giants' Causeway: Race to the Sun is a strategic card-and-peg race game inspired by Cribbage, featuring custom scoring systems, variable player powers, and dynamic player paths. Using a unique 36-card deck divided among families and clans with a distinctly Irish feel, players compete to advance their pegs across a winding 153-space track toward the final Sun peg. Players score points both during play and during end-of-round hand evaluation by creating family sets, reaching key totals such as 11 and 19, building flushes, and managing special card abilities. Unlike traditional Cribbage, scoring…
470743.name: Giants' Causeway: Race to the Sun

470760.description: For generations, fighters have wandered through the doors of The Adventure Store searching for equipment to give them an edge in battle, from shimmering potions to “lightly cursed” armour on the sales rack. The shopkeeper has watched countless contestants rise and fall in the battle arena and, being the generous businessman he is, has decided to turn the whole affair into a spectator event. After all, if you’re going to bludgeon each other senseless, someone should profit from ticket sales. Each round, you and your rivals enter the arena to face a Trial, a high-stakes trick-taking battle…
470760.name: The Adventure Store

470775.name: たぬきは もう、おしまいです。トリテ (Tanuki wa mō, oshimai desu. Torite)

470777.name: マストフォローは釜の中 (Must Follow wa Kama no Naka)

470785.name: ゼウスの愛した女たち (Zeusu no Aishita Onna-tachi)
publishers: 卸売センターサンエイ (Oroshiuri Sentaa San'ei)

470815.description: 隅田川レッドタウン (Sumidagawa Red Town) is a go-out style card-shedding game in which you cannot play the same number of cards as the previous player. You lead a gang and aim to send your members into battles over territory. If you do not like your hand, you can call in a hitman. However, if you take a Hitman card, you may also be forced to exchange hands with another player. Each location determines how cards must be played, but you cannot play cards in the same way as someone else. If you cannot play all your cards, you lose one executive. The deck contains 52 cards: three 3s, four 4s, five 5s, and…
470815.name: Sumidagawa Red Town

470819.name: あちらのお客様からです (Achira no Okyakusama kara desu)

470822.name: タンデムトリック (Tandem Trick)
publishers: 篠原遊戯重工 (Shinohara Yugi Juko)

470860.description: Korzaryn is a fast-paced tactical pirate card game where every decision matters. Players collect gold, steal from opponents using unique pirate characters, or assemble a legendary treasure map that can instantly change the course of the game. The game is easy to learn but offers surprising depth. From the first round, players engage in constant interaction, clever timing, and opportunistic steals. Gold is never safe - opponents can strike at any moment, and a perfectly timed action can turn defeat into victory. Designed for portability, Korzaryn fits easily in a pocket or bag, making it ideal…
470860.name: Korzaryn

470898.name: Stegegets Solar System: Lost in Table Space

470911.description: A mandragora that lets out a terrifying scream if pulled up. Let’s head out into the night forest in search of one. The night forest is dark. You play a card and circle around the mandragora. By the time several piles of cards have formed around the mandragora, you should be able to spot it. Now, pull it up. When someone announces they’re pulling it out, the others can either help or cover their ears. The key factor here is how many cards are near you. The dangerous scream reaches the person with the highest total of nearby card values. However, the points you can earn are correspondingly…
470911.name: Mandra-Go-Round

470946.description: In Pumped Up, players compete to be the first to reach a total of 25 points by drawing from a single, shared deck stacked face-down in the center of the play area. Featuring a lighthearted, family-friendly theme, the game relies on a tense push-your-luck mechanism where players must decide how far to inflate their score before their luck pops. On a turn, the active player draws cards one by one from the center deck to accumulate points. After each successful draw, the player faces a choice: continue drawing to gain more points, or voluntarily stop to safely bank their accumulated points for…
470946.name: Pumped Up Card Game

470998.description: In Limelight, you're the producer of a Broadway show. The game is played over the course of three Acts, followed by Opening Night. Each Act consists of an Audition and a Rehearsal. During the Audition, you'll add cards to your show deck by drafting cast and crew in an open draft. You can then hone your show in Rehearsal by playing your show deck card by card. In order to "strike" (remove) a card from your show, you will need to lose one or more cards from the bottom of your hand before you know what they are. The game culminates on Opening Night, when each player plays out their show deck to…
470998.name: Limelight: The Lively Game of Theatrical Blunders

471069.description: 99 Balloons is a push your luck with dice and card shedding for points game. On a players turn you will roll the three modified dice to see if the number matches any cards in your hand. You discard matching number cards for points until someone reaches 99 points or more to end the game. The modified dice have certain numbers blacked out to represent wind. Wind allow other player to discard cards even when it is not their turn. If you are unable to discard any cards or buy cards from the market you will bust and be left with negative points of the cards in your hand plus an extra random card…
471069.name: 99 Balloons

471163.description: In The Chicken Job, every player is a chicken robber, a member of a gang that trusts no one—not even its own accomplices. Jewelry, cash, tools... and cops ready to ruin your fun. Knowing when to settle and when to take a risk is the only skill that matters. —description from the publisher
471163.name: The Chicken Job

471203.name: King of Tokyo: Monster Pack – Blockbuster Bro

471212.description: IL Capo is a fast paced, ruthless party game set in the dark underbelly of a Renaissance city. It is designed to be easy to learn, fast to play, and handle a wide number of players. People play as scoundrels who’ll use any underhanded trick to eliminate the competition and seize control. Players draw cards, play actions, or defend themselves from a shared deck, trying to avoid the dreaded skulls which mean death. The last player left standing becomes il Capo while the rest become ghosts. But for those who die along the way, death is not the end; it’s just a change in job description. The deck…
471212.name: Il Capo

471245.name: Trade Winds: A Trick-Taking Card Game

471309.description: Trails & Tails is a fantasy roll-and-move game with a dash of “take that” mechanics. Each turn, every player rolls their available dice and uses them to move toward the top of the board. Players can choose to add or subtract their dice together, or simply use a single die to move. Along the way, opponents may use item cards to make you fall, push you into dangerous zones, or disrupt your plans. Of course, you can fight back with your own items and character abilities. The game ends when a player reaches the top (the end of the track). The winner is the player who reveals the most Gold…
471309.name: Trails & Tails

471371.description: Mad Cat Sad Cat is a dice and card game. Its 5 dice have 3 mad cat sides, 2 sad cat sides, and 1 wild cat side each. When it is your turn, you roll the dice and create poker combinations. When it is not your turn, you try to mooch off of the dice roller's success by predicting which dice they will set aside. Once the VP supply is empty and the game ends, whoever has the most VPs wins. —description from the publisher
471371.name: Mad Cat Sad Cat

471432.description: In One More Page, players are junior asavans racing to write their manuscripts before Bō—a 1,000lb rescue cow—wakes up. You must balance the silence of the library with the chaos of a needy pet while surviving the mischievous Aanu spirits. ​This interactive push-your-luck game is all about volume. On your turn, you can either say "Stop" to safely lock in your manuscript, or push your luck by drawing a card to add another page to your row. You can draft Extra Parchment cards to bulk up your manuscript's size, or deploy action cards to freeze opponents and force them to draw blindly. ​But be…
471432.name: One More Page

471443.description: You are managers of world-class football clubs! You are competing in the most prestigious tournament on the planet, MONDO GLOBO GUTS & GOALS! Predict how many goals you can score, flipping player cards on the table. Watch out for penalty cards, Don't get Booked or Sent Off.
471443.name: Mondo Globo Guts & Goals

471446.name: 犬のお散歩テイキング (Inu no Osanpo Teikingu)

471449.description: Players compete in a light, abstract party-card contest where a poor starting hand is not the end of the story. By passing at the right moment and flipping cards to reveal new strengths, players can reshape their options and try to escape before being left behind. Pasukuru (Pass & Flip) is a climbing and shedding card game in which players try to empty their hands by playing cards higher than the current number on the table; the last player with cards loses. Cards have numbers on both ends, but normally only the top number is used, and cards usually cannot be rotated freely. However, two…
471449.name: パスクル (Pasukuru)

471452.name: 祓魂  (Haratama)
publishers: 卸売センターサンエイ (Oroshiuri Sentaa San'ei)

471487.description: In a tense game of nerve and timing, players push their luck by drawing cards while trying to stay as close as possible to the dangerous limit of 67. Every choice asks whether to keep chasing a better total or stop before disaster strikes, because going over the limit means immediate elimination from the round. The mood is abstract and competitive, built around risk, bluffing, and the thrill of surviving one more card. 67 is a push-your-luck card game in which players draw face-up number cards, trying not to exceed a total of 67. Players may stop at any time, but once everyone has stopped or…

471512.description: It's time to hit the road and brave the mean streets of Bawston! At the start of each round each player decides how many cards to draw from either a Kawfie deck or Rage deck until they have 6 cards in hand. Kawfie cards are worth points at the end of the round but Rage cards let you take actions against other players like stealing cards. On a turn a player can either play a card from their hand or park their car in Havahd Yahd. If you choose to park, you get to draw an extra Kawfie card, but are done playing cards for the rest of the round. When half of the players have parked the round…
471512.name: Cahs and Kawfie

471536.description: Seven Summits is an educational strategy card game about high-altitude mountaineering and the challenge of conquering the tallest peaks on each continent. Players assemble teams of climbers, prepare expeditions, and attempt to complete ascents of the world’s famous Seven Summits before their opponents. Each mountain presents unique requirements and environmental conditions, while changing weather creates new obstacles every round. On a turn, a player must gather resources and may attempt an ascent by committing the necessary climbers and equipment. Successful expeditions allow players to…
471536.name: Вершины зовут (Seven Summits)

471665.description: Players use numbered cards to: Start new stacks Build stacks higher Steal stacks by matching the top card Use action cards to advance play A single card can completely change the game. Example: A stack shows 6 Play 5 or 7 to build Play 6 to steal the entire stack As the game grows, stacks become larger, riskier and harder to protect. Includes optional game modes that players can mix and match to increase strategy based play rather then luck. —description from the designer
471665.name: Stack Stealer

471678.name: たぬきはもうおしまいですトリテ (The Tanuki Is Done For)

471745.description: A shady skunk just launched a coin. Everyone knows it's trash. Naturally, the raccoons are all in, because raccoons love trash. Every raccoon says they're the most reckless trader at the table. Time to prove it by losing the most money. ''Trash Traders is a chaotic 2–5 player card game where the goal is to end up with less money than everyone else. Play action cards, buy and sell the coin as the price swings, sabotage your friends, and try not to be caught holding cash. Because at any moment, the Rug Pull card is drawn and the coin crashes to zero; the game ends on the spot. The raccoon…
471745.name: Trash Traders

471747.description: Flysh - The Paradox of the Flying Fish A tense push-your-luck card game for 2 to 3 players that puts you in the fins of a flying fish caught between sea and sky, on a vertical track ranging from -12m to +12m where two pressure markers, A (Air) and E (Water), close in round after round. Each player builds a card river across 7 slots, simultaneously chooses between a Flip draw pile or Flop draw pile, then moves their Exocet before revealing animal threats (birds, fish) and Air/Water phenomena that modify the track and Speed Points. The biomes have distinct behaviors: in Water, Speed Points wrap…
471747.name: Flysh

471753.description: In a world swept up by a monster-pet boom, the horned and big-eyed “Chewy” monsters are especially popular. Players are breeders trying to gather monsters of matching appearances and send them off together, while also watching for suspicious attempts to smuggle mismatched monsters in disguise. Everyone wants to help their monsters depart, but in the end each breeder also wants to escape their own obligations and become free. Mega Out!! is a climbing and shedding game with bluffing, dice-based bonuses, and challenge mechanics. At the start of each round, a six-sided die determines a bonus…
471753.name: Mega Out!!
publishers: ぷあぷあイデオロギー (Poor Poor Ideology)

471768.description: SIX SEVEN wOAOw is a simple yet chaotic card game. Whenever someone plays "SIX","SEVEN",or"SIX SEVEN",it creates a strange reaction that pills everyone in - though no one really knows why. As the game goes on, players fall into a meaningless but hilarious loop. Gameplay Players take turns clockwise until only one has cards remaining. The starting player may play 1 to 3 cards of the same or consecutive points (1–10, max 67). Subsequent players must play the same number of cards with equal or higher value, or pass. When playing a special card, its effect is immediately triggered. If all other…
471768.name: SIX SEVEN wOAOw

471859.description: Varkės is a fast-paced card game inspired by the chaotic street trading culture of Lithuania in the 1990s, based on the novel of "Pietinia Kronikas" by Rimantas Kmita. Players become small-time entrepreneurs trying to make money by trading scarce goods, avoiding criminals, bribing officials, and surviving the unpredictable realities of the post-Soviet marketplace. Each round, players secretly choose goods to bring to market. When all cards are revealed, market demand determines which products can be sold profitably. However, danger is never far away. Some threats can be avoided through…
471859.name: Pietinia kronikas: Varkės

471899.description: Dugout Legends drops you headfirst into the high-stakes, high-energy world of baseball’s golden era. With eye catching 1950s retro aesthetic bursting with vibrant vintage textures and classic halftone artwork, this game turns the tension all the way up. You aren't just a player watching from the sidelines—you are the mastermind pulling the strings from the dugout, calling the shots in a fierce, head-to-head tactical showdown of pitcher vs. batter! Every turn seamlessly blends clever card management with the unpredictable drama of the draw to perfectly simulate the chess match that is…
471899.name: Dugout Legends

471966.name: ゴミムシトリック (Gomimushi Trick)

471972.description: KAAZAP is a quick head-to-head card duel about pressure, timing, and getting dangerously close to 20. Each set starts simple: draw from the shared table deck, build your total, and try to finish higher than your rival without crossing over. A perfect 20 is powerful, but every turn brings risk. Stand too early and your opponent may pass you. Push too far and you may bust unless your side cards can save the board. The twist is the side deck. Each player brings a small set of tactical cards that can add, subtract, flip, double, or break ties. These cards turn Kaazap from a pure luck race into a…
471972.name: KAAZAP

471990.description: Nougat is a domino climbing game for 2 to 4 players that uses a single set of double-nine dominoes (for 2 players, you only need a single set of double-six dominoes). The goal of the game is to shed all of your tiles before the other players by playing melds of singles or suited runs of two or more tiles. When you start a trick, you may only lead a single tile. A single tile can be beaten by a higher single or by a run of 2; a run of 2 can be beaten by a higher run of 2 or by a run of 3; and so on. The first player to shed out wins one point. The first player to score two points wins the…
471990.name: Nougat

472019.description: Dump the problem before the Llama gets you! Play a bigger combo or PASS. Sounds easy... until passing forces you to draw. The stronger the combo you pass on, the more cards you must draw. Somewhere in the deck are deadly Llamas. Draw one, and you're instantly out! Simple rules, zero mercy. Slam huge combos onto your friends and watch the chaos unfold. As players get dragged out one by one, can you be the last one laughing?
472019.name: Not My Probllama

472022.description: Welcome to the Starlight Galactic, the greatest casino in the universe! Thrill seekers from across the cosmos flocks to this glitzy wonderland to try their tentacles at games of skill and chance. You've got yourself a shot at besting the galaxy's greatest gamblers including the slipperiest of them all... The Dealer. The Dealer is a push-your-luck game that mixes bluffing with deduction and cooperation with betrayal. Take cards to earn points and make sure you don't bust. There's just one problem: Everyone can see your cards... except you. In each round of the game, players will be assigned…
472022.name: The Dealer

472056.description: Players take on the role of daring safe thieves attempting to crack difficult vaults by aligning three dial numbers under specific conditions. Opening the safe is only part of the job: the real challenge is grabbing the treasure and escaping before the others. The player who cracks the most safes and repeatedly gets away will be praised as the legendary “safe thief of the century.” Kindoro is a ladder-climbing game in which players play cards from their hands either as a single card or as a three-card play, or pass to draw a card from the field or deck. Three-card plays can be made as…
472056.name: Kindoro

472058.name: インスタントシンジケート (Instant Syndicate)

472086.description: "The arena of Rome has no mercy for the weak, nor memory for the cowards. Here, gold is bought with the souls of your slaves and immortality is written in the blood of your rivals. Raise your hand, Lanista; your school is ready for ruin or divinity." Age: 10+ winters Duration: 60 minutes of steel and betrayal Factions: 2 to 4 competing Lanistas The Ludus Treasury (Components) 4 Lanista Edicts: Your avatars of ambition, politics, and power. 12 Power Tokens: Use these to shift economic influence. 12 Souls of the Arena (Gladiators): Men marked by iron and destiny. 9 War Forges: 3 gleaming…
472086.name: Invictus

472097.description: Pasona is a Kenyan-made memory and luck card game for 1–15 players that supports four distinct modes of play, scaling from simple icon matching for young children to rapid-fire number-series racing for competitive groups. All modes share the same setup: 48 cards are spread face-down on any flat surface, and players take turns flipping cards one at a time without moving them. What constitutes a valid match — and what happens next — depends on which mode is in play. In Icon Match, each card has a unique paired symbol; finding its counterpart earns both cards and another turn. In Number Match,…
472097.name: Pasona

472116.description: "Funny photos, embarrassing secrets, and a fierce battle for the Hidden File..." You and your friends have taken funny, embarrassing photos of each other and made a bet. The person who gets the 'Hidden File' where you put the photos will be able to share whichever photos they want! In this highly interactive and chaotic tabletop card game, your ultimate objective is to be the person holding the 'Hidden File' after the cards in the 'Chaos Deck' run out and the final trump cards are played, or when you are the last person standing. But beware: when only one person remains alive, if they do not…
472116.name: Desire FOR Chaos

472142.description: Koinonia means communion; Clash means confrontation. In this game, both come together in a dynamic challenge where players try to build card collections; but if they repeat too much, they lose everything! Card swaps, sudden twists, and special effects make every round unpredictable. If you get 3 cards with the same number, you earn even more points. And Jesus —always Him— brings powerful help to anyone who finds Him during the game. —description from the publisher
472142.name: Koinonia Clash

472146.description: Septeto CLAN is a light family card game in which each player starts with 7 cards and tries to be the first to get rid of all the cards in their hand. On a turn, a player may discard one or more cards that match the current number on the table, or one or more cards with the next number in ascending order. For example, if the card on the table is a 2, the player may play one or more 2s, or one or more 3s. If a player cannot play, they draw one card. If that card can be played, it must be played immediately. Some cards have special effects. The Cebra card triggers a quick reflex challenge, the…
472146.name: Septeto CLAN

472147.description: "The aim of the Pathfinders is “the Advent Message to all the world in my generation.” In this semi-cooperative game —that is, everyone plays together against the deck— your mission is to spread the gospel to the four corners of the Earth. However, you will face various temptations that may make you give up on this mission and even lose something very valuable: your neckerchief. Sin cards are mixed into the deck and if you draw one and do not have the Jesus card to protect you, you will lose your neckerchief and be eliminated from the game. The winners are the players who remain in the game…
472147.name: Explora: Multilingual edition

472184.description: Brilliant Misfits is a push-your-luck game with a instant win condition. You are a band of eccentric inventors joining forces in a series of wildly ambitious startup ventures. Every player has a stake in each venture. Cash out before a venture collapses and you'll walk away with a tidy profit — a wise choice, prudent inventor, but risk it all to change the world, and you might be remembered as the Brilliant Misfit you were born to be! Gameplay Overview Brilliant Misfits is played over multiple rounds. Each round represents a new venture the players have started together. Innovation cards will…
472184.name: Brilliant Misfits

472257.name: Freshwater: The Trick and Write Game

472306.description: Sinigang (adapted from Button Shy Games' Stew) is a fast, fun game of suspicion and timing. As you all work together to cook the perfect pot, there’s a mix of tension and laughter, because you never really know if you’ve scored enough points or if the sinigang is about to get too sour. On your turn: draw a card, peek at it, then choose one: A) put it into the pot, B) give it to a family member, or C) call “Kakain Na!” Any family members who weren’t fed will eat an ingredient before scoring. If the total reaches 12 or more, the caller wins 2 VP. If not, they lose, and everyone else gets 1 VP…
472306.name: Sinigang

472310.description: Beyond the 32 doors lurk evil spirits that have possessed various objects. Suppress them with even stronger evil spirits... Otherwise, they may possess you. When all the doors have been opened, will you still be sane? 32LDK is a fast-paced horror-themed card game for 3–6 players that combines simple rules with tense push-your-luck decisions. This is a horror-themed game of chicken. The goal is to have the fewest cards in hand at the end of the game. On your turn, take a card from either the table, your hand, or an opponent’s hand, and play it onto the table. If the card you play has a higher…
472310.name: 32LDK

472319.description: A group of Extraterrestrials, over the weekend, places abducted humans into a series of simulations to distract themselves from boredom while watching, fascinated, the intense emotions of human beings. Each simulation lasts an entire adult lifetime for the humans, but only a few minutes for the Extraterrestrials. The humans may choose which of the two possible companies they want to work for, but suffering is guaranteed. The team whose members succumb (go out) the fastest, displaying their negative emotions throughout the exhausting routine of their inhumane jobs, is rewarded with VP (Void…
472319.name: Eternamente Temporário

472329.description: The lemmings are on the loose! On their way to the cliff, they push and shove because everyone wants to be at the front. In this funny trick-taking game, every card played is crucial. Whoever wins tricks moves toward the cliff. However, if you run too fast, you risk falling down and experiencing a real trick-taking tragedy. Over the course of four rounds, the rules governing the lemmings' movements change several times. Sometimes the aim is to win tricks, other times to avoid them. Depending on the cards played, several lemmings may follow suit. This makes the game particularly varied and…
472329.name: Last Lemming

472417.description: Vinyl Hunter is a family strategy board game for vinyl record collectors and music lovers. Players secretly draw two music genres and race to complete their collection by buying records in all three rings — reissue, colored vinyl and first press. On each turn roll the D14 dice and choose your direction — clockwise or counter-clockwise. Land on music sectors to buy records, attack opponents, or visit special sectors like Casino Vinyl where you risk your record’s condition, or Vinyl Tax where you earn money for your collection. Every purchase ends with a roll of the condition dice D6 — six…
472417.name: Vinyl Hunter

472452.description: FIXR is a fast-playing card game set in the world of Sand Slicers. On the Scorchbelt, Sand Slicers tear up the great tracks in chaotic, high-speed races where survival is just as difficult as victory. But when the crowds go home and the dust settles, the FIXRs emerge to claim what they left behind. In this standalone card game, lead a crew of clever FIXR bots competing to recover the most valuable scrap left behind by the racers. Salvage parts, complete builds, and sabotage rival crews as you turn wreckage into profit. —description from the designer
472452.name: FIXR

472696.name: Медвежатники: Банк Мёда (Safecrackers: The Honey Bank)

473031.description: The new dice game by Reiner Knizia: Who will win the most gold? Draw a dragon card and roll all five dice. Can you place at least one die on the card? Lucky you! Then you get to decide whether to keep the gold you rolled or risk it by rolling again. Tame the dragon to win not only the gold but also the card. One thing is certain—in this push-your-luck game, it rarely ends after just one round! Tame the water dragons before they slip away. You can’t use wild cards on the fire dragons, and for the luck dragons, you must meet certain requirements—otherwise, they’ll fly away! Who will be the new…
473031.name: Dragon Dice: Drachen zähmen, Gold gewinnen!

473034.description: Talangkaan is a chaotic crab-racing card game inspired by the Filipino idea of crab mentality—when one crab gets ahead, the others pull it back down. In a crowded barrel, every crab is trying to escape, but nobody climbs alone. Help the right crabs rise while making sure your rivals don't get away too easily. Each turn, players play cards to move crabs up the barrel, create stacks, trigger collapses, and manipulate the race. Crabs can climb onto other crabs, but overcrowded stacks collapse, sending crabs tumbling and changing the race in an instant. Every move creates new opportunities—and…
473034.name: Talangkaan

473042.name: See the Sea: Dive into Discovery

473044.description: In ULT: Cold Burning, players compete to discard all of their cards while unlocking powerful abilities that transform a familiar shedding game into a combo-driven battle of timing and tactics. By combining unique skills, players can alter card effects, break normal play restrictions, and create explosive chains of actions. Fast to teach and full of dramatic moments, every game offers new ability combinations and encourages repeated play.
473044.name: ULT: Cold Burning

473094.description: Dragon Bomb immerses players in the heart of Taiwan's Lantern Festival. During the Dragon Dance, participants throw firecrackers, a tradition believed to bring luck and prosperity for the coming year. Secretly choose your explosions, manage your power wisely, and trigger them at the perfect moment to destroy the most valuable parts of the dragon and score the most victory points.
473094.name: Dragon Bomb

473122.description: Are you ready to betray your friends in style? GoKats is the strategic racing game where six cats compete on a modular plastic track, and where every friendship is destined to wobble. Build the track, choose your cat, destroy your opponents. Every game begins by building the track with 24 modular PLA bio-plastic tiles: different shapes, different experiences. Each cat has unique traits: lives, a special bonus, and an arsenal of Supply cards to advance, hinder, and survive. How to play Choose your cat: each one has lives, a special bonus, and a Supply card deck of its own. Draw, move, and…
473122.name: GoKats

473167.description: A competitive deck-building card game for 2–4 players, playable in about 30 minutes, set in a grim world drawn from Slavic and Nordic mythology. In SlavMortis, players build a deck, hire monsters out of the dark, and press their luck against a deck of brutal critical hits to break their rivals before they are broken in turn. The game pairs fast, confrontational play with an atmosphere closer to a grim fairy tale than to high fantasy. —description from the publisher
473167.name: SlavMortis

473228.description: Plunder Blunder is a social push-your-luck pirate game where you steal treasure, bribe the Navy, and betray your friends. Each round, pirates simultaneously reveal treasure cards, deciding whether to keep pushing their luck for greater riches, risking curses that push them closer to the Navy. Then, pirates secretly offer treasure to the Navy to slow its pursuit, while looking for opportunities to sabotage their rivals. Surviving pirates then bury treasure for points before setting sail again. When the final voyage ends, the pirate with the most buried treasure wins. —description from the…
473228.name: Plunder Blunder

473248.description: In Surfin' Cats, you compete to pull off the coolest tricks and ride the waves at the perfect moment—but your rivals are eyeing the same break! Manage your hand tactically and push your luck to secure the most glorious position. Each wave demands a different level of paddling, and earning the most Flow Points is the key to victory. Spend your hard-earned Flow Points to upgrade your deck with new tricks from the market or unlock unique abilities for your character. Stay sharp, though; your opponents are looking for any chance to use their cards to thwart your progress and make you wipe out.…
473248.name: Surfin' Cats

473268.name: Kryptothera: Something Lurks in the Shadows

473270.name: Kryptothera: The Cryptid Pursuit – The Cultural Exchange Expansion

473271.name: Kryptothera: From the Mountains to the Sea Expansion

473272.name: Kryptothera: The Threat was Never Higher Expansion

473274.name: Kryptothera: A Cryptid in Every City Expansion

473331.description: It's a Dog Life is a lighthearted card game in which players take on the roles of dogs competing to live their best canine lives. Throughout the game, players collect treats, toys, activities, and memorable experiences while avoiding various everyday dog-related mishaps. During each round, players choose cards simultaneously, build combinations, and try to create the happiest and most successful life for their dog. Strategic decisions revolve around balancing immediate rewards with long-term scoring opportunities while anticipating opponents' choices. Easy to learn and full of playful humor,…
473331.name: It's a Dog Life

473379.name: Zombie Princess: Dead Reckoning Promo Card

473436.name: Tricky Time Crisis: Call of Heroes

473475.description: Manzanas Manazas is a fast-paced, frantic card party game designed by Sergio Herrera and published by Falomir Juegos. With matches lasting barely 5 minutes, the game stands out for its auditory reflexes and visual bluffing mechanics, all packaged inside an eye-catching, giant apple-shaped box. Objective: Be the first player to collect 3 apple tokens by gathering the best fruits from the orchard and avoiding the rotten ones. How to Play: At the start of each round, 2 cards are dealt face down to each player. One player acts as "El Cesto" (The Basket / the round director) and will start calling…
473475.name: Manzanas Manazas

473652.description: Bank or Bust is a "higher or lower" push your luck card game where players will take turns to draw cards of values 2-99 in an effort to score the most points. During a players turn they will either bank their cards for points, or draw a card. When they draw a card they must place it in one of the ascending (starting at 1) or descending (starting at 100) rows. Players bust if they cannot place it in either row. Players score points: By scoring a point for each card they successfully bank If they manage to push their luck to a set of 3 cards(5 points), 4 cards (15 points) or 5 cards (50 points)…
473652.name: Bank or Bust

473863.description: You're at an all-you-can-eat buffet, and everyone's trying to eat just the right amount. Load up your plate with food cards, use action cards to sabotage your friends' meals, and keep a close eye on everyone else's plates. Go too far and you're out. Play it too safe and someone else sneaks ahead. The twist? Second place wins. So the real game is knowing exactly when to stop. Designed by Alice Hong, Jessica Hong, and Clay Capra, Too Much On Your Plate is a fun card game built for laughs, chaos, and the sweet satisfaction of watching your friend eat one too many desserts. —description from the…
473863.name: Too Much on Your Plate

47389.name: Roll Through the Ages: The Late Bronze Age

473980.description: Don't. Make. A sound. Every step forward has to be perfect, or the wrong board could creak and send those eyes from the shadows flashing towards you. Survivors must play cards that match each Hallway card to move forward without making any noise. Of course, you can't get cards without searching around and making more noise. If there are two rings of noise exactly the same size the monster will freeze, so you could coordinate with someone else down the hall, but if betray you, the maw of the beast is waiting. Search for a hiding spot, make a distraction, or shove someone over, whatever it…
473980.name: CREEEAK

473996.description: The Last Draw is a card game of tension, deception, and survival built around a simple but deadly premise: somewhere in the deck, the Hitman is waiting for you. Set in a dark, stylized world where every draw could be your last, the game captures the nerve-shredding unpredictability of Russian roulette and translates it into a fast, social card experience for 2 to 6 players. Each player begins with one Angel card and six cards dealt from the shuffled deck. On your turn you may play as many cards as you like, setting traps, stealing from opponents, peeking at the deck, redirecting danger, but…
473996.name: The Last Draw

474110.description: Dopplin is a two-player climbing and shedding game played with a shortened double deck. Players lead and beat singles, pairs, sets, runs, and connected sets. There are no bombs. Instead, cards of the weakest rank can shovel an opponent's pair or set into your hand and remain on the pile as the new active play. Before play begins, players bid for contracts that raise the stakes and set the terms of the hand: who leads, how set-aside cards enter play, and what the declarer must achieve. Victory comes from reading your hand, choosing the right contract, and knowing when to shed quickly, hold…
474110.name: Dopplin

474116.description: Kernel Panic: Exfiltrate Edition is a push-your-luck card game for 2–8 players in which everyone is a hacker racing to exfiltrate data from a shared network. On your turn you draw cards from the Network deck. Data cards — Credentials, Personal Data, Financial Records — are worth points, but only if you bank them before your turn ends. Draw an Alarm card (Firewall Triggered, IDS Alert, SOC Alert, and others) before you bank and you bust, losing everything you drew that turn. After every card you face the same decision: bank your haul and end your turn, or push your luck and draw again. Each…
474116.name: Kernel Panic: Exfiltrate Edition

474127.description: In this chaotic twist on the classic card game President, players take on role of Rabbids competing to climb from Majesty to Poop Lord by shedding numbered cards, actioning space-time with powerful Warp Cards, and sabotaging each other's rise to the throne in a frantic battle for the Plunger Crown. While the core gameplay may feel familiar, the experience is refreshingly different thanks to its playful arwork and iconic wearable props that seamlessly bring the Rabbids universe to life around the table. Blending a timeless card-game formula with absurd Rabbids-style chaos, Rabbids Card Royale…
474127.name: Rabbids Cards Royale

474128.name: Stonespine Architects: Invasion – Marauder Pack Mini-Expansion

474134.description: Race to the Bottom is a deck-shedding game for 2-4 players where each player has their own standard set of cards complete with two Jokers. The aim of the game is to be the first player to shed through their entire deck by playing various melds to the table. In Race to the Bottom, players who pass also have the option to "pitch" cards from their hand to the bottom of their own decks enabling a light form of deck building, by sending undesirable cards to the back of the deck to be retrieved later. Furthermore, Aces are both high and low for the purpose of building melds and any meld with an Ace…
474134.name: Race to the Bottom

474228.description: Should you defend a treasure island with all your might—or focus your pirate crew on conquering another island? That’s the question in the captivating family game “Entern & Kentern” for ages 8 and up. As pirates, you set out on an exciting hunt for Captain Silver’s legendary treasure. But which of you will have captured the most treasure chests in the end, and whose treasure will be cursed by the mysterious pirate ghost? It’s not just luck that determines your fate—your tactical skills will also be put to the test! The brand-new and beautifully illustrated card game by award-winning game…
474228.name: Entern & Kentern

474271.description: Players lead a desert gang, choosing different heists to roll and keep varying amounts of loot dice. Gangs can store loot, spend it on Clutter Cards, or use it to power up helpful Gadget Cards. When skulls are rolled, opposing gangs have the opportunity to steal loot and get ahead. Players can choose to push their luck and reroll any non-skull dice, potentially leading to a better outcome...or more skulls. The first gang to purchase all four of their Clutter Cards is crowned rulers of the Grabi Desert. —description from the designer
474271.name: Sands of Crime

474277.description: Bluff, deceive, push your luck or turn everything upside down. Mäxchen Ultra is a fast, thrilling card game where nerve counts for more than luck. With just two cards in hand, the game stays clear at all times — but never predictable. Every round lives on convincing moves, bold declarations and the right poker face. Because here the rule is: nothing has to be true. Every card can be called correctly or cleverly faked. Additional action cards create surprising twists, more strategy and fresh dynamics at the table. They bring speed, chaos and tactical possibilities into play — making every…
474277.name: Mäxchen Ultra

474280.description: Ball Four is a fast-paced, tactical ladder-climbing and card-shedding game for 3–5 players that turns every deal into a high-stakes battle for tempo and board control. While grounded in the classic traditions of ladder-climbing card play, Ball Four disrupts standard shedding mechanics by introducing conditional trick-steals, risk-laden leads, and a scarce resource-management engine. Your goal is simple: empty your hand as fast as possible to catch your opponents holding cards and score runs. But every high-powered combination you play comes with a target on its back. The Core Twist: The…
474280.name: Ball Four

474324.description: Aces is a sharp shedding card game for two players. Stripping a standard deck down to forty cards (Ace through 10), the game condenses the high-tension gameplay of classic climbing games into a heads-up duel of hand management. Aces are multi-functional cards. On their own, they are worthless low cards. When paired with number cards, they act as flexible wilds to help form runs or sets. Throwing down all four Aces unleashes a devastating bomb that can be led or dropped onto any combo to instantly clear the pile. Players race to 7 points across multiple rounds, and how you end the round…
474324.name: Aces

474342.name: Periodic Pipes: The Road to Plutonium

474489.description: In Tottatta, a deck of cards is spread randomly face down in a large pile on a table. Players take turns flipping 1 to 4 cards, choosing whether or not to stop after each card. If all of the players flipped cards match in color, number, or background, then the player claims the cards. Players can also claim cards if the numbers form a run of consecutive numbers. If a player busts and cannot claim their cards, they are returned face down to the pile. Cards contain partial "bonus marks" on their edges and corners. If the cards claimed form a full bonus mark, the player gets a bonus chip for…
474489.name: トッタッタ (Tottatta)

474509.name: Propuh II: The Bevanda of Judgement

474519.description: A quick and easy to learn press-your-luck (duck?) game for 2-4 players. Draw cards, score cards and claim ducks, and have the most bread when the deck runs out! The deck has number cards in Red, Yellow, Green, Blue, Purple (2x each of 1-7), and four ducks of each color (plus Rainbow Ducks!). On your turn you can Draw, Score, or Take a Special Action (Quack/Sneak). If you Draw, you take the top card of the deck face-up in front of you to your tableau. If it's a number, great! If it's a duck, it eats all your number cards that match its color, and swims off to the Duck Pond in the middle of the…
474519.name: Aw, Ducks!

474635.description: FREEP is a push-your-luck card game in which players try to collect as many cards as possible by predicting whether the next card will be higher or lower than the previous one. On your turn, reveal a card and choose “Higher” or “Lower” before revealing the next one. If your prediction is correct, you may stop and keep the cards you have revealed, or continue taking risks. If you make a wrong prediction, you lose all the cards revealed during that turn. When two cards of the same value appear consecutively, you immediately keep that pair and continue playing with the remaining cards. Cards…
474635.name: Freep

474642.description: Magik Realm: Lite is a free-for-all card battle game for 2 to 10 players (4 to 6 players is recommended) in which each player attempts to be the last one standing. Inhabit a world mixing medieval fantasy, sci-fi, childlike whimsy, and the mundanity of real life. At the start of the game, each player selects one of ten asymmetric character classes. Options include a Knight, a Mage, a Rogue, a Baby Buffalo, or even a Crazy Cat Lady. Each class provides a unique passive ability and a unique weakness and resistance pairing. Every turn, you draw one card from the shared deck and play one card…
474642.name: Magik Realm: Lite

474643.description: The Kings Dragon is a fast paced strategy card game for 2 – 5 players where everyone builds armies, sabotages their opponents, and races to defeat a hidden mystery dragon. place knights and other units to strengthen your army, unleash goblins and other chaotic cards on your opponents, attack your rival kings with all sorts of different weapons, and decide when to risk everything by attacking the mysterious dragon. Claim victory by slaying the dragon or by becoming the last king standing. —description from the publisher
474643.name: The Kings Dragon

474679.description: Long ago, the world's ley lines birthed dragons. As the lines faded, dragons scattered into the Dragonwilds. The Empire issued the Dragon Edict, summoning worthy tamers—Dragonmasters—to capture, breed, and elevate dragons along their lineages until one forges the apex: the Zhurion (★5). —description from back of box Build a Dragon Lineage: Draw cards, bid in the market, collect matching dragon species, and move along the lineage path toward higher star levels. Market Bidding Choices: Each market round asks players to bid or pass. The right card can complete a set, but overbidding may limit…
474679.name: Dragonmasters

474696.description: You step into the role of the Matchmakers, spirits of the mountain, where brave and wandering animals are looking for their peers to venture together. Gather the same type of adventurers at your campsite to make a successful team and earn their praise. However, the instant two perfect companions meet, a MATCHMAKING occurs. They immediately leave the camp behind to begin their ascent. The team of Matchmakers which has gathered the strongest party of adventurers will claim victory! Matchmakers is a thrilling team-based, must-follow trick-taking game where players try to collect the best set of…
474696.name: Matchmakers

474829.description: Pirate-Themed Family Card Game – Embark on an adventure filled with treasure and surprises that players of all ages will enjoy. Exciting Push-Your-Luck Gameplay – Receive cards from the dealer and decide whether to keep collecting loot or play it safe before your ship sinks! Unique Special Cards – Powerful action cards and special abilities add twists, comebacks, and exciting decisions to every round. Best of Seven Rounds – Compete across seven fast-paced rounds where every decision matters and the highest total score wins. Easy to Learn, Hard to Put Down – Simple rules make it quick to start…
474829.name: Master of the Seven Seas

474844.description: Every player starts with a 3×4 grid of face-down cards and a shared deck to dig through. On your turn you draw one — from the deck or the top of the discard pile — and decide: swap it into your grid, sending whatever was there to the discard, or throw it away and flip one of your face-down cards to see what you're sitting on. Everything you place stays face-up, so the table can always see what you're working with. The goal is a low total. Negative cards and zeros are gold. Tens, elevens, twelves are dead weight you want out of your grid as fast as poEvery player starts with a 3×4 grid of…
474844.name: Strike Gold

474915.description: Dash for First is a fast, interactive racing card game. Every turn, you roll 5 Engine Dice and aim for the best Sprint Pattern. Play it safe, push your luck for a bigger move, or use well-timed cards to slow rivals and take the lead. Whenever Cars end up in the same space, they immediately duel for track position. The first player to reach or pass the Finish wins the race. —description from back of box FAST TABLETOP RACE Build the track, choose your car, draw Tactics Cards, and race toward the finish in a quick tabletop contest that is easy to start. DICE-DRIVEN SPRINTS Roll 5 Engine Dice,…
474915.name: Dash for First

474917.description: You are adventurers. Explore the dungeon and earn as many coins as you can. Even if you lose your life, don't worry. Your bravery will be honored with a fancy grave. But remember, the finest graves go to those who claim them first... Will you survive and rake in riches, or be the first to fall in glory? Even death is a strategy! Make your mark! In a game of Adventurers Just Want to Rest in Fancy Graves, each round you draw three Dungeon Cards from the top or bottom of the Draw Pile (Dungeon), play one, and return the rest. Dungeon Cards come in three flavors: monsters (deal damage, grant…
474917.name: Adventurers Just Want to Rest in Fancy Graves

475029.description: Players secretly prepare a dish card at their station then play facedown cards for their dish preparation and when one is ready that player starts the auction to become head chef—though some cards can be a bluff to that will make the eventual head chef's dish harder to prepare. The head chef then attempts to reach the target flavour value to score awards or face a kitchen disaster.
475029.name: Dish or Disaster

475104.name: Drive-In Movie Monsters: Unite To Fright!

475133.description: Compete in a clash of the Five Chinese Elements! "Wu" means "five" in Chinese. And in this game, five is everything: five elements, five numbers, five ingots. At the heart of Wu lies the ancient Chinese philosophy of the Five Elements 金木水火土 (pronounced “Jin Mu Shui Huo Tu”). Each Element flows into another in an endless, yet balanced, cycle. Combo your Cards! In this elemental hand management game, play (and conserve!) your cards strategically to win Gold Ingots! All players start with a hand of 8 cards, which they view privately. On your turn, you choose whether to Play or Pass. To Play,…
475133.name: Wu

475144.description: Quench your thirst for an addictive new party game with Flip 7: Liquid Death. With two new actions - Kill a Card and Murder the Modifiers, game night is turning grim in the best way possible. In this press your luck game, be the first player to score 200 points to win. You score points based on the total number value of the cards in front of you. The more valuable a card is, the more copies of that card there are in the deck. However, if you ever draw a second card with the same number as one already in your line, you bust and are out of the round, scoring nothing. You can command death if…
475144.name: Flip 7: Liquid Death

475260.description: Do Dare Decide is a tactical game for the whole family where the goal is to get as close as possible to 36 points using the number cards in your hand. But watch out—it’s not quite as simple as it sounds! Roll the die and see whether you create CHAOS for yourself or for the other players around the table. Who is the family’s greatest tactician? Gather the family and let the game begin. Players start with 30 poker chips, and put one chip in the pot at the beginning of each round. A round consist of several turns. Each turn consists of 3 phases: Phase 1: Draw a number card (unless the player are…
475260.name: Do Dare Decide!

475376.description: You’re at a party full of laughter, friends, and great music; the atmosphere is buzzing with energy and fun. This is the perfect moment to show off your best moves on the dance floor and get everyone moving to your beat. The lights spin to the beat of the latest hits, while every step adds excitement to the night. Let your creativity flow and become the life of the party. Are you ready to show off your best moves, shine under the party lights, and make everyone envy your rhythm? It’s time to dance! In Let’s Dance, you’ll dance with your cards. Play them in front of you to form your dance…
475376.name: Let's Dance

475385.description: LOOP is a card-discarding game in which all hands are served only one time. During your turn, you will play a single card or a combination of cards. After that, each player must play a better card or combo to stay in play. The goal is to get rid of all your cards as fast as you can. The twist is that after each round, the card hands will shift from player to player. Every hand offers a diverse array of possible strategies and playstyles. It’s up to you to find the most suited one to achieve better results than your opponents! At the end of the game, you will have played with every single…
475385.name: LOOP

475389.description: Chickadee is a shedding/climbing card game for 2 players where players seek to be the first to shed their hand of cards. Chickadees do not migrate for the winter, but instead store up seeds, insects, and berries in order to make it through the cold season. In this game, players will be collecting cards into their hands in order to help them shed out, becoming the first one ready for winter. In Chickadee, opponents split a standard 52 card deck, each taking two entire suits. Some of these cards are placed into a pyramid structure in front of each player from which they'll be able to draft new…
475389.name: Chickadee

475432.description: Stack your cards cleverly... but know when to stop, or lose it all! Collect cards in column, aims for the combinations that score the most points. Be the first to score 3 points by completing valid 5-card combinations. Draw cards one at a time, as many as you want, hoping not to reveal two with the same number. If you succeed, you add those cards to your columns; otherwise, the cards are given to another player, who will place them in their columns. 5 different numbers → 1 point 5 identical numbers → 2 points 5 cards of the same colour → 2 points 5 different numbers of the same colour → 3…
475432.name: Stack 5

475465.description: Noboribetsu, a popular onsen town in the south of Hokkaido, has a special relationship with Oni. Often depicted as malevolent demons, the Oni of Noboribetsu are instead protectors of this town built around a hot spring known as Jigokudani, or Hell Valley. They are tasked with warding off evil spirits from the medicinal baths and are even said to keep foolhardy visitors from falling into the naturally occurring boiling hot water that brings prosperity to the town. Welcome Demons is a climbing/shedding game for 3 players with some unusual wrinkles. Rather than playing standard melds (pairs,…
475465.name: Welcome Demons

475493.description: Based on the critically acclaimed indie video game Party House from "UFO 50," this board game adaptation is a push-your-luck race to throw the ultimate party! In each game, you and up to three other players compete to throw the ultimate party (featuring enough VIP stars) by expanding your rolodex of characters (your deck) who are invited to your event. These characters enter your house one at a time, and you must decide when to end the rager before it gets too out of control and the troublemakers attract the police who bust your party. If you don’t bust, you may spend your popularity and…
475493.name: Party House: The Deckbuilding Game

475512.description: Deep Dark Dive is a fast-paced, push-your-luck, and set collection card game for 1 to 5 players where you take on the role of professional divers exploring perilous underwater caves. Throughout the game, players must carefully manage their hands to perform one of five key actions: Ascend, Build, deCompress, Dive, or Explore. As you push further into the depths to score combinations, you must constantly monitor the accumulating nitrogen levels in your body.
