Manage your hand poorly, and you will suffer from "Nitrogen Narcosis," a potentially fatal mistake that forces you to discard precious…
475512.name: Deep Dark Dive

475644.description: Flip, serve, and out-bluff your friends in this fast, deliciously chaotic card game inspired by another iconic Malaysian dish. From the creators of Nasi Lemak: The Game. Roti Canai: The Game is a competitive bluffing and hand-management card game where players fulfill roti canai orders with different Roti Canai cards while outsmarting one another. Each round, dice rolls determine the exact Roti Canai orders that must be served. All players must place matching cards face down simultaneously — but whether those cards truly match the order is unknown. Bluffing is allowed, and deception becomes a…
475644.name: Roti Canai the Game

475682.description: An extraction card game for 2 to 6 stalkers. Beyond the barbed wire, the Zone breathes, shifts and swallows certainty. The artifacts hidden within are worth a fortune, but every step adds a little more radiation to your bag, your skin, your regrets. --- How it's played: On your turn you choose to Explore (draw a card from the Zone Deck into your Loot and resolve its effect) or Return to the Hideout (bank your Gear and Artifacts into your Bag, discard any Hazards, and end your raid safely). Radiation accumulates across your Loot and Bag; hit 5 or more at the end of your turn and you're forced…
475682.name: Perimeter54

475809.description: Stone Soup is a trick-taking game for 2-4 players based on the traditional folk tale of Stone Soup. Every hand, players will be contributing ingredients to a soup (set of special rules) which will determine the flavour of play during the tricks. Players will try to get the most bowls of delicious soup while avoiding taking stones. Stone Soup is played with a 50 card deck that has ten cards in each of five suits: Beets, Onions, Carrots, Potatoes, and Stones. In the basic game, players will collaboratively build a suit hierarchy before playing their hand, and will receive 1 point for every…
475809.name: Stone Soup

475883.description: Draft Cribbage is a new take on the classic game of Cribbage. Instead of being dealt a hand of cards at the start of the game, you draw and discard cards from either the stockpile or the discard pile, slowly building up your hand one card at a time. Be careful however! Someone might end the round before your ideal hand has been created, so you may not even get what you were going for. —description from the designer
475883.name: Draft Cribbage

475913.description: The alarm is ringing and school is about to start, but these sleepy student sloths are too tired to put on clothes. Move quickly to outfit each sloth in a hat, shirt, pants and shoes matching their favorite color to score the most points and win. Players race to search a messy pile of Clothing Cards to dress their sloths. Matching a sloth's favorite color scores the most points. The next sloth in line doesn't "wake up" until the current one is fully dressed. Dirty clothes tossed in the hamper might score a bonus, or make a statement by fully dressing a sloth in dirty duds. Finish quickly,…
475913.name: Get Up

475928.description: Collect cards and deceive the others with cleverly used bonus actions to sum up the highest score and win the round. But if you touch Black Jacky's deadly threshold of 21, all you will get is her knife!
475928.name: Black Jacky

475936.name: The Charge: The Light Brigade at Balaclava

476072.description: Winner of the 2026 Audience Choice Award - Boston Festival of Indie Games! Pax Rising Showcase - Pax Unplugged 2026! Spellchamber is a fast-paced dark fantasy card game in which players take the role of evil Wizards settling their disputes in a lethal game of magical russian roulette. Players shoot from a shared "chamber deck", which they can manipulate using their spell cards. With both damage dealing bullets and good bullets that grant power, players will push their luck when deciding on who to shoot. When a Wizard runs out of life, they become a Ghost and can continue to cast spells as a…
476072.name: Spellchamber: Wizard Russian Roulette

476105.description: Smugglers is a set collection game. In this game you are greedy merchants during the silk road era who want to smuggle illegal goods and other goods that are not allowed through the customs. You can always depend only on legal goods to be safe, but the other merchants will have the chance to smuggle illegal goods which are worth much more!. The game is played in 12 rounds. Each round there will be some items that are prohibited to be played, and each player choose one card from their hands to play, then all players reveal at the same time. To win you need to collect the most points from the…
476105.name: Smugglers

476263.name: The Crew: Journey to the Ends of the Earth – Globetrotter Expansion

476337.description: Pink Lemonade is a climbing/shedding game for 2-3 players played with a triangle deck. Triangle decks are characterised by having one 1, two 2s, three 3s, etc. all the way up to (in this case) ten 10s. In Pink Lemonade, you can't play the same meld as the last two that were played. Additionally, you must play either higher numbers or more cards. Can you shed out your hand before your opponents? —description from the designer
476337.name: Pink Lemonade

476353.description: Dungeon Draw is a fast-paced, endlessly replayable, rogue-lite card crawl designed for solo or co-op play for up to four players. Players explore a dynamic dungeon revealed one card at a time, encountering treasures, traps, merchant trades, and lethal monsters. To play, you will need two dice, a tracking method (paper, life counters, or a Crawlboard™), and your selected Hero. Setup involves shuffling the deck with a Wandering Merchant hidden near the middle and a final Boss waiting face-down at the bottom. Cards are double-sided, increasing the variance infinitely, especially when shuffling…
476353.name: Dungeon Draw

476400.description: Fame & Fable is a fantasy-themed competitive board game for 1-4 players. Use your actions to buy ally and item cards from the market and play these to defeat monsters, complete contracts, or disrupt other players. Gain fame through your exploits to move your player token around the game track, picking up bonus tokens as you travel. The player with the highest fame at the end of the game wins. —description from the designer The Deluxe Edition of the game comes in a larger box with the base game, Fame & Fable: Legend, different artwork and contains 24 upgraded screen-printed wooden token, and 2…
476400.name: Fame & Fable (Deluxe Edition)

476468.name: JOLT: The Magnet Game of Push and Pull

476471.name: Jingle Bell Roll: Mystery Bag Promo Card

476515.description: Woo is a team climbing-shedding game, where you assume the role of birds of paradise to successfully attract a mate. Cards are played by both partners to make a single meld. Play continues around the table, with teams combining cards to form higher-ranked melds until any player passes. Teams earn 1 point by having either player shed all their cards first. The first team to 2 points wins! Originally given away exclusively at Allplay's Trick-Taking Extravaganza at Gen Con 2026
476515.name: Woo

476652.description: Catfetería is a poker-inspired card game of betting, bluffing, and risk management, where players compete to win cats and score the most points. At the beginning of each round, a cat is revealed in the center of the table. Each cat has three different objects it likes, represented by hearts. Players play object cards to try to score the most hearts and win the cats. However, playing an object card requires betting Coffee tokens. The catch is that you never know which cat will appear next. Players must decide how much Coffee to risk based only on the information they currently have, knowing…
476652.name: Catfetería

476691.description: Teh Tarik (the direct translation being "pulled tea") is a Malaysian drink. When making this drink, you pour milk tea from one large metal cup to another at a large height difference, creating froth and cooling the tea in the process. In Teh Tarik Game, you must play a card every turn, either to your team's cup or your opponent team's. Cards must be played in order. If you fail to play a card, you spill your tea, turning all the cards you have played so far into penalty points. You have limited opportunities to score points, and you must use them wisely. Sometimes you voluntarily spill your…
476691.name: Teh Tarik Game

476705.description: Ask the dealer to flip cards for you one by one—but don’t flip the same number twice! In Flip 8, every number card is a chance to score more points, but flipping a number you’ve already collected makes you bust and lose your points for the round. There are cards for each number from 1 through 13, with the number of copies increasing as the numbers get higher. Think you can push your luck? Collect eight unique numbers and you double your total score for the round! But knowing when to stop is just as important as knowing when to keep going. Action cards add a strategic twist. “Hit 1” lets you…
476705.name: Flip 8

476757.description: Step into the shoes of art collectors vying to acquire a prestigious collection! Your goal: score the most points by winning valuable artworks and building the biggest stack of art tokens. The game features 11 numbered artworks, each with a matching set of tokens hidden in a bag. On your turn, push your luck by drawing tokens one by one from the bag: Risk vs. Reward: Keep drawing to collect as many tokens as you dare. But watch out—if you draw a duplicate token during the same turn, you bust! Return all tokens drawn that turn back into the bag. Bank Your Loot: Stop drawing at any time to…
476757.name: A Risk Cat

476866.name: Avalon: The Riven Veil – Mistwalkers Expansion

476905.description: “Taipa” Supremacy Series is a new kind of game brand that lets you enjoy the best parts of classic games, faster and more fun than ever. (“Taipa” comes from “time performance,” a Japanese buzzword meaning high efficiency and maximum fun in minimal time.) Taipa Supremacy: Quick Hanafuda Collect matching flowers,flip cards, and win! This is the fast-paced Hanafuda of the modern era. (This is a Koi-Koi only version) Hanafuda: Hanafuda is a traditional Japanese card game played with beautifully illustrated cards representing flowers and seasons. Players match cards according to various game…
476905.name: タイパ至上主義花札 (Taipa Supremacy: Quick Hanafuda)

476921.description: Flip 7: National Parks is a press-your-luck card game for both outdoor adventurers and game lovers. Featuring custom artwork inspired by America’s most iconic national parks, each card celebrates natural wonders across 12 unique categories—mountains, battlefields, rivers, forests, and more. Build your line of park cards and score big based on the numbers you collect—the higher the number, the greater the reward. But tread carefully! Draw a second card with the same number, and you’ll bust, losing all your points for the round. Not only the new art, but this version includes a special action…
476921.name: Flip 7: National Parks

476985.description: Sakebato is a small card game designed to be played on the table at a bar or at a gathering at home. Every card in the deck shows a drink together with its alcohol content, ranging from water at 0% up to tequila at 40%. In the main game, Sake Chicken Race, players take turns drawing a card and then playing one card from their hand onto a shared pile, announcing the running total of the alcohol content as they do so. The player who pushes that total above 100% loses the round, while landing exactly on 100% is safe. A player who plays a water card instead removes one drink already in the pile,…
476985.name: Sakebato

477060.description: Taylor Reiner's classic almost-shedding, climbing game is back in an all new edition with updated Sai Beppu art, extra abilities, new rules, eye-rolling owl puns, support for up to 5 players, and even more of what made the original Of What's Left a classic in the genre. The idea behind Of What's Left is simple: get rid of your cards, but NOT ALL OF THEM. Because the lowest rank card you hold in your hand when one of your unfortunate opponents has run out of cards gives you points...as long as you have 5 or fewer cards remaining. Otherwise, as Judge Smails would say, "You'll get nothing and…
477060.name: Of What's Left: Deluxe Edition

477193.name: The Gods Laugh At Your Spoils

477211.name: Over and Out: An Out There Waiting Expansion

477327.description: Press Your Duck is a press your luck card game where players try to collect ducks and special duck items like duck umbrellas. Avoid the weasels but maybe catch them for points! Go through the deck twice and whoever has the most points wins the County Fair!
477327.name: Press Your Duck

477372.description: Players roll eight custom dice and use numbered and spin-symbol results to claim Shot Cards from a changing display called The Rally. They combine the cards to construct recognisable table tennis shots, including Push (∂1), Flick (1σ), Smash (111) and Swipe (θ1θ). Players pursue higher-scoring combinations while deciding how far to push their luck. The game draws on notation developed in Spin, Speed and Strategy: A Mathematical Guide to Table Tennis. Backspin (∂), topspin(σ), sidespin (θ) and hitting force (1) become visual elements within the dice-and-card mechanics. No table-tennis…
477372.name: Table Tennis Shot Builder

477531.name: NO KINGS: Power to the People

477708.description: OMYN is a fast-paced card game of memory, strategy, luck, and timing. Your cards stay face down, so you have to remember what you saw and make decisions based on what you know. The game keeps you guessing because you never have complete information about your cards. On your turn, draw a card and choose whether to play it or swap it with one of your face-down cards, then play the card you replaced. Special cards can help you, disrupt other players, or change what happens next. You can also play matching cards together or react quickly when another player plays a card you have. At the start of…
477708.name: OMYN

477785.description: Hats on and get your brushes ready! Lead your team deep into the heart of the newly discovered pyramid. Roll the dice and see... Ohoh! Could it be that you’ve actually found the Pharaoh’s ancient treasure? Set up a pyramid using the cards. Roll 5 dice and match their symbols with the cards in the bottom row to claim them. The game ends when either the pyramid or the deck runs out of cards. Some cards score points at theend of the game, some during the game, cards with symbols may help you claim better cards during the game and score points if you have these the most at the end of the game.…
477785.name: Phara-Oh!

477894.description: Frog Tower is a family game where luck, simple strategy, and courage hold the key to victory. Take turns flipping frogs from the pond of face down cards, trying to collect different colours for your frog towers. Push your luck for more colourful frogs, but avoid flipping matching colours or you will go bust and your flipped cards will hop around the table to rival players. Or maybe that's what you want! Setting yourself up with only 1 spare lily pad allows you the choice of whether to take or deny a frog you do or don't want. More colours in your towers gets you more points. But if you can…
477894.name: Frog Tower

477933.description: Don't break a hundo! Take turns flipping your cards without looking at them in this push-your-luck card game. Don’t push the center pile over 100 total or you bust. Hit 100 exactly to get a HUNDO! Shake things up with UNDO, FORCE, and SHOWDOWN cards. Take risks and get rewarded! Be the first to get rid of all your cards each round to avoid extra points. The lowest total score wins.
477933.name: Hundo

477993.description: SK8 COMBO is a fast-paced card game for 2–4 players (ages 7+) where memory, tactics, and nerves of steel collide. Each round, players draft trick cards to build a face-down line of five cards, secretly assembling escalating runs—from a basic Ollie all the way to the legendary 900—much like building a straight in poker. To win, players must chain high-value trick combinations and maximize sequence multipliers while dodging sabotages. Points are awarded based on combo difficulty and run completion, but failed sequences and unmitigated wipeouts quickly slash point yields. The player with the…
477993.name: Sk8combo: Skateboarding Cardgame

478049.description: Iron Court is a competitive card game built around the structure of a sanctioned strength-sport meet. Each player takes on a lifter working through a full competition — either an Olympic weightlifting meet of snatch and clean & jerk, or a powerlifting meet of squat, bench press, and deadlift. The lifter with the highest successful total at the end of the meet wins. Play is divided into phases, one per contested lift, and each player takes three attempts per phase. To make an attempt, a player commits to a Lift card, which fixes both the weight in kilograms and a Difficulty number. The attempt…
478049.name: Iron Court

478161.description: Cats From Hell is a light, chaotic card game about trying to get through your day while cats—aka the other players—do everything they can to get in your way. Build your day by collecting Task Cards across four parts of everyday life: Personal, Home, Cat, and Work. Collect three cards of the same type to complete a set and score points, with each type worth a different number of points. Build as many sets as you can, whether you focus on one type or juggle them all. But getting things done is only half the challenge. Other players can steal your Task Cards, sabotage your progress, and attack…
478161.name: Cats From Hell Card Game

478235.description: Spandauer is a climbing/shedding game for two players. In Spandauer, you can't rearrange your hand, but you can add to the previous meld or take cards away from it in an effort to modify your hand composition and get ahead of your opponent. The player who can most effectively whittle their 18 card hand down to zero wins one point. If they capture 25 or more cards, they win another point, and if they manage to capture 30 or more cards, they win a third point. First to five points wins. —description from the designer
478235.name: Spandauer

478252.name: This Is Not A Game About A Pipe

478402.description: Bell Peppers is a ladder-climbing card game played with cards in four colors. But be careful—there’s a “restriction” that limits you to playing only use the color of the first card played by the first player! Cards with fewer colors have higher numbers, while cards with more colors are better at handling the “restriction.” Use each card’s unique traits to secure victory!
478402.name: パプリカ (Bell Peppers)
publishers: パニーニゲームズ（Paninee Games）

478405.description: Be a shark in this cutthroat auction game for 3 to 6 players. To win, score the least points by collecting sets of cards or avoiding cards altogether. Each round a card is drawn. On your turn you “chum it” - passing by adding a token to the card, or “bite it” - taking the card and any tokens added to it. In the deck, there are eight 8’s, seven 7’s, six 6’s, all the way down to one 1-card. Each card rank has point values that ramp up and down depending on the size of your set. Other cards are special, lowering scores or altering the cards in an auction. —description from the designer
478405.name: Chummy

478485.description: Tie-Die Dinos is a push-your-luck dice game where players race to build the most colorful collection of prehistoric creatures. Each hand-illustrated dinosaur card bursts with a unique combination of two to five colors, and it's up to you to roll the matching dice to claim it. From the tiny two-color Compsognathus to the dazzling five-color Tyrannosaurus, every card on the table is a puzzle of color and luck waiting to be solved. On your turn, roll all five of your polyhedral dice, one each in red, yellow, blue, green, and purple, then spend re-roll tokens to reshape your results in real time…
478485.name: Tie-Die Dinos

478603.description: Three Twos is a climbing card game for three or four players in the family of Big Two and Gang of Four. Players race to empty their hands by playing singles, pairs, three of a kind, and five-card poker-style combinations, each strictly higher than the one before; cards left in hand when a round ends score penalty points, and the game ends when a player reaches 100, with the lowest total winning. The game uses a purpose-built 52-card deck in three colors (Leaf, Water and Fire): ranks 3 through 10 twice in each color, three Twos, and a single multicolored Wild. The Twos are the highest natural…
478603.name: Three Twos

478606.description: Cats on Top! is a 2–5 player climbing card game in which players compete to be the first to empty their hand and claim the best spots on the cat tower. Cards are played into three fixed positions on the tower. Players may play a higher single card, pairs or triples of the same number, or runs made of two or three cards of the same color. When cards are removed from the tower, the remaining cards stay in their original positions, so the value of the board can change in unexpected ways. Instead of playing, a player may pass when at least two cards remain on the tower, taking one visible card…
478606.name: Cats on Top!

478651.description: In Riviera, there is zero downtime: everyone plays at the same time on the exact same dice roll! Cleverly combine their values to play your cards and collect as many stars as possible. Every turn brings a crucial choice: say "Stop" to secure your points, or "More" to try and win higher rewards. But watch out! If you cannot play, you lose everything! Use special powers wisely to boost your strategy and rattle your opponents. 1.One player rolls the dice, then everyone uses the result to play simultaneously. 2.Play a card from your hand by matching the value and color of a single die, or by…
478651.name: Riviera

478670.description: Everyone wants to be licked by the cute Cerberus! Try to summon it to you across several rounds, by completing sets of matching heads. Each completed set remains on the table, thinning the deck, and the player in last place can earn bonus points during the game and at the end, so do you risk falling behind? Once the rounds are over or the deck is depleted then the player with the most points from their cards is declared the winner.
478670.name: CerPELOs

478698.description: Every cat has its own character and its own story, but they all want the same thing: a warm home and a bowl of food. The deck contains seven breeds of cat. Each breed has cat cards and cat house cards, and a small number of cat food cards sit alongside them. Players start with five cards in hand and one face-up cat food card in front of them, and the goal is to pair cats with houses of the same breed. On your turn you take exactly one of three actions. You can lay down a set by playing a cat and a cat house of the same breed face up in front of you, then drawing back up to five cards. You can…
478698.name: Cats, Cats & Cats

478702.description: Rouletista is a push-your-luck card and dice game played with one or two standard decks (Ace through 6 + Jokers with Aces as 1), built around a Russian Roulette theme — flip cards face-up and roll a die, hoping the number never matches a card you’ve exposed. Keep spinning for a bigger haul or “shoot yourself” and lose it all. On your turn, flip the top card and roll the die. Roll a match to any card flipped this turn, and you’ve shot yourself — those cards are discarded and the die passes left. No match means you survived: either bank your flipped cards, or push your luck by flipping and…
478702.name: Rouletista

478767.description: Sales for our company's F2P games have been sluggish. At this rate, closure is inevitable. "Increase sales by any means necessary!!" The president's cry echoes through the office. Well then... Let's release increasingly extreme character skins! Any director who fails to make their game more suggestive will be demoted as a warning to the others. Those who push boundaries without hesitation will be praised for their courage! There are 6 identical cards per rank, ranging from 1 to 8, for a total of 48 cards. Players can play multiple cards at once as long as they are identical or consecutive.…
478767.name: エチエチスキンデスマーチ (Ecchi-Ecchi Skin Death March)

479096.description: Glub Club is a competitive dexterity and set-collection game about fishing. Players use miniature fishing rods to catch fish as quickly as possible, while also trying to build the strongest combination of cards. At the start of each round, a number of cards equal to the number of players is revealed. Everyone fishes at the same time, and the order in which players catch their fish determines the order in which they choose from the available cards. Finishing earlier gives access to better card choices, but also forces that player to release more line from their reel, making future fishing…
479096.name: Glub Club

479132.description: Sonic Roll Plus is an expand-alone sequel based on the push-your-luck dice game, Sonic Roll! The game is a true love letter to the classic Sonic franchise, made by fans for fans! Designed by Anthony Thorp and officially licensed by Sega of America, we are very excited to bring classic Sonic fun to the table. The fan-favorite franchise hits the gaming table in a dice-rolling adventure, taking 1-4 players through memorable zones, iconic obstacles, and handsome rewards. —description from the publisher
479132.name: Sonic Roll PLUS

479551.description: In Mal'oon players step into the shoes of baristas working in Mr. Coffee’s cafe, striving to assemble healthy drink orders while unmasking a traitor in their midst. Among the team hides the "Cursed Barista" (Mal'oon), a hidden-role player whose objective is to secretly sabotage drink orders by distributing spoiled cards, shift suspicion onto others, and disrupt the cafe's success. To win, loyal baristas must complete full drink sets and correctly identify the Mal'oon during the final accusation phase, whereas the Mal'oon wins by successfully deceiving the team or completing target drink sets…
479551.name: Mal'oon

479556.name: Mary Shelley's Frankenstein Cards: A Monster Deck of Card Games

479558.description: A push your luck game with domino-style cards. Each turn you score for you and your opponent. It’s a rat’s race. First to 100 wins. Action cards mix up play - the namesake action being “No Dice.” Features a NYC taxi theme with cartoon rats. —description from the designer
479558.name: No Dice Alley

479636.description: Board game set in the world of graffiti. Compete against other players to have the most painted train cars, even if it means being a lone wolf. ​The game features 2 phases. The first one involves gathering materials, racing against other players. The second one is about painting train cars in the train yard. For this reason, the board is double-sided. ​There are 3 train rounds, and the difficulty increases in each round. You keep the painted trains in your collection, and at the end of this phase, the player with the most painted cars wins the King Graffiti Bomber trophy. The game can be…
479636.name: Graffiti Rumble

479728.description: LEVEL UP is a push-your-luck card game from Japan. You are a Level 1 Hero. You clear the game by reaching Level 5; try to achieve this as quickly as possible. Success depends on luck and preparation. You level up if the card drawn from the deck is higher than your current target level. Enhancing your abilities will also increase your success rate. Aim for Level 5 efficiently. —description from the publisher あなたは勇者レベル1です。 レベル5になればゲームクリアです。いち早く達成させてください。 レベルアップに必要なのは運と下準備です。 山札から引いたカードが目標レベルより大きければレベルアップ成功です。 また、各能力を強化すると成功率が上がります。 効率よくレベル５を目指しましょう。
479728.name: LEVEL UP
publishers: 新ボードゲーム党 (New Board Game Party)

479809.description: In HYAKUJU PARADE, representatives from six continents have gathered together for a parade. Players race to empty their hands, but the order of the cards in each player's hand cannot be rearranged. Adjacent cards can be chained by matching digits to create larger numbers. On your turn, you can play a number greater than the current number, take a card from either end of another player's number and insert it into your hand, or add a card from your hand to another player's number. The first player to empty their hand wins the round and takes a Parade Member piece. If a player who already has a…
479809.name: Hyakuju Parade

479812.description: Fickle Cat Flip きまぐれにゃんこめくり (Kimagure Nyanko Mekuri) is a push-your-luck card game from Japan. The four cats have different personalities, the more cards you turn up, the chances go up you get a hiss instead of a purr. And the final round is treat time with double points. You aim to increase your affinity (victory points) by flipping over cat cards. During a turn, you flip 3 to 5 cards; a Meow card earns you 1 point, while a Purr card earns you 3 points. However, if you reveal a Hiss! card, the turn ends in failure, and you gain zero points. The four cats have different card counts and…
479812.name: Fickle Cat Flip
publishers: みすたーあんどみせすげーむず (MR. & MRS. GAMES)

479873.description: In Lovely Golem, players take on the roles of scientists in a fantastical world, gathering discarded Parts from Scrap Mountain to build their own Golems and compete in the annual Golem Exhibition. Over five rounds, players compete for Parts through face-down bidding using a hand of ten cards. Each player first chooses one available Part and places a card face down beneath it, then, in reverse turn order, places a second card beneath a different Part. Energy cards, with values from 1 to 6, are used for bidding, while Dynamite can cause explosions that disrupt competing bids. When a player wins…
479873.name: Lovely Golem

479903.description: To win One Chance Circus a player must roll 3 of the same number on 3 dice back to back. To pull off this amazing trick you need an amazing team of circus animals. There are 3 copies of 18 different animal cards, each with their own powers. On your turn; roll dice to scout animals from the center. The die spent are used for the turn and cannot be targeted by effects. If you gained an animal card on a previous turn, you can use its effect to manipulate your dice. You can have 5 different animals in your circus, so multiple of the same card don't count towards the limit. Discarding back down to…
479903.name: ワンチャンサーカス ( One Chance Circus )
publishers: Camellia Quintet (かめりあクィンテット)

480069.description: In Extra Roll, players embark on a frantic egg hunt to cook the world's biggest omelet. Over multiple rounds, players draw numbered cards featuring both a point value (number of eggs) and an elimination number (2–12). The higher a card's reward, the higher its probability of matching a dice roll! On each turn, the active player rolls two dice. If the sum matches any active card on the table, that card’s owner is eliminated and loses their uncollected eggs, while the roller scores 10 bonus points per opponent knocked out. Remaining players must decide to stop and bank their points, or press…
480069.name: Extra Roll

480073.description: A death game set in hell. Each player takes a character and must survive the trials set for them. On your turn you raise the difficulty of a trial, moving a marker up the track, and then attempt one. Attempting means rolling the 5 basic dice and trying to meet the trial cards' conditions; fail and you take a decay card. Trials only ever get harder, because the difficulty never resets. Between rounds, players can acquire cheat cards and secret skills (such as manipulating dice or rerolling.) When a player's decay cards total 8 or more, they die. Once someone dies, the survivors go to a final…
480073.name: 戦獄ReBORN (Sengoku ReBORN)

480167.name: Cassiopée
publishers: メリーアンドリューワークス (merry-andrew-works)

480362.description: Explore the sky and collect as many cards as possible to gain altitude. Keep the other players from climbing higher by trapping them with card effects and accusing them of having duplicates. In Cumulus, draw cards, avoid being caught with duplicates in hand, and deal with the chain reactions created by the different card effects. At the end of the game, the player with the tallest cloud column wins. No math required. Every card in Cumulus was originally painted on canvas by the incredible artist Math Lamarre. —description from the developer
480362.name: Cumulus

480382.name: King of the Dice: The Magic Guild

480640.name: Thou Art the Man: The Trick-Taking Game

480807.description: In BanaNo!, players push their luck to draw cards from a deck before they draw a NO! card. The game ends when the fifth NO! card is drawn and the player with the longest banana (most cards) wins.
480807.name: BanaNO!

480809.description: A murder in this case is a set of 3 cards or more of the same value OR a run of 3 or more cards of consecutive values (1,2,3…). Players may gradually build a set AND a run at the same time. These will be two separate piles in front of the player, the left pile will be the RUN, the right pile will be the SET. Each turn the player begins by revealing 2 cards. They keep one, if possible, and discard the other, or discard both if they cannot be used to continue a RUN or SET. The player may continue to reveal one card at a time then stop at any point. If they stop before busting, that is they have…
480809.name: Murder, She Crows

480814.description: 5 kilos to lose. 16 days to do it. And neighbors who'll stop at nothing to sabotage your diet. In Croc Miam, anything goes when it comes to making your cat the next face of the famous cat food brand! Play Diet cards to help your cat shed those extra pounds, make your opponents’ cats gain weight, and bring out the claws to thwart their moves! Secretly choose your action, call out “Meow!”, then reveal all your cards at the same time. May the best cat win! A fast-paced, simultaneous, and chaotic card game where humor and trickery reign supreme. —description from the publisher
480814.name: Croc Miam

480848.name: F41 Fray Bentos: 72 hours in the crater

480892.name: Dinner Party: A Lot To Unpack

480985.description: The rain has finally stopped, and after a week stuck indoors, you're heading straight for the puddles. On your turn, either take one card from the center, or flip 1–3 cards from the deck and grab every card of one type. Your clothes score in a strange way: one wet item is fine, two is just annoying, and three means you're soaked so you might as well enjoy it. Get a fourth, though, and Mom takes the whole lot off to the wash. Taking your third matching card makes a Splash, and every other player has to draw. Use Umbrellas to block a Splash and Hair Dryers to dry off, and keep playing until Mom…
480985.name: One More Puddle!

481038.name: Labores de Bizâncio: Dionísio e as Bacantes

481094.description: This is a climbing card game and a shedding game in which you try to be first to get rid of all your cards. Each card has two ends, and these two ends are of different numbers and colours. The end you are holding up is the active side, but this may change during the game. On your turn you either play a meld or declare "Change". A meld can be a single card, or a set of cards. There are only two types of sets, either sets of the same value, or sets of the same colour. When you make a set of the same colour, the cards must form a valid number and it must be the smallest possible number. E.g. if…
481094.name: 峰迴數轉 (Change)

481169.description: Become phantom thieves and work together to steal a legendary painting! But be careful - security guards will be alerted at the slightest sound. Can you work together to infiltrate the art museum, steal the painting and escape without being caught? Phantom Thieves can’t be infiltrating an art museum and making noise - and neither can you! In this limited communication game, you must work together to play cards, progress through the art museum, steal the art, and make it back out. As you progress, you’ll come across security guards. Play your cards right, and they won’t notice your movements.…
481169.name: Quiet Now, Phantom Thieves!

481190.description: Road Rage is a competitive deck-building and push-your-luck card game about the frustrations of everyday traffic. Over the course of six rounds, players encounter annoying traffic situations, collect rage points and improve their decks with new cards. Different card categories and special abilities create opportunities to influence scoring and adapt strategies throughout the game. Players must decide how far to push their luck while building a deck that can generate as many rage points as possible. The player with the most rage points at the end of the game wins. -description from designer
481190.name: Road Rage

481204.description: In this press-your-luck card game, you are invited to join Jack Skellington and the citizens of Halloweentown as they plan their spine-chilling takeover of Christmas. You score points based on the presents on the cards in front of you. The more presents on a card, the more valuable a card is . . . Beware, though, there are more copies of that card in the deck! If you ever draw a second card with the same number of presents as one already in your line, you bust and are out of the round, scoring nothing. Flip 7: The Nightmare Before Christmas has a zero card with a unique special ability - You…
481204.name: Flip 7: The Nightmare Before Christmas

481281.description: The greatest card game of all time is back, this time with some holiday cheer! Based on the smash hit Flip 7, comes this special holiday edition that brings more joy than even 12 days of Christmas could! All-new special cards can help or hurt your opponents - and you! Gift Wrap allows you to place this card on top of one of your number cards; Gift Three works like the Flip 3 card; and Gift Card allows you or someone to stay with a bonus +10. The Zero Number Card (Gift Exchange) allows you to swap The Zero card with any visible number card from any active player. Can you Flip 7 number cards…
481281.name: Flip 7: The 12 Days of Flipmas

481346.description: Midnight Miso is a lightweight tabletop card game that balances simple mechanics with strategic depth. It is easy to learn, quick to play, and surprisingly competitive. Players attempt to use all their 'ingredient cards' each round to earn awards. The player with the most awards after three rounds wins it all! Midnight Miso is a risk management card game with a hint of trick-taking. It is suitable for all ages and skill levels. —description from the publisher
481346.name: Midnight Miso

481470.description: Run the Table is a card-driven pool strategy game that captures the real skill of pool — not making shots, but playing position. Players run racks on an illustrated 9-foot table board. On each shot you call your ball and pocket, check the difficulty on the board's chart (straight-on 5+, angled cut 7+, thin cut 9+, long table +2), then play a Shot card — Stop, Follow, Draw, Bank, Kick, Combo, or Safety — and roll two dice against the difficulty. Make it and you keep shooting; the Shot card you played determines where the cue ball finishes, which sets up — or wrecks — your next shot. Miss, and…
481470.name: Run the Table

481511.description: Kings & Peasants is a ladder-climbing card game for 3 or more players in which the first player to empty their hand becomes King and adds a new rule that everyone must obey. It is played with a fully illustrated medieval deck and belongs to the same family as President, Daifugō and The Great Dalmuti. It takes about two minutes to learn. Setup Deal the 52 cards out evenly (Jokers are not used); any leftover cards are set aside. 2 is the highest card, then Ace, King and down to 3, the lowest. Rounds A game is played over a series of rounds. In the first game the holder of the 3♣ leads (if it…
481511.name: Kings & Peasants

481545.name: 夜連 Who Follows Me?  (Yozure: Who Follows Me?)

481565.name: From Stray to Stay: Végre otthon

481574.name: Pass the Pigs: Barnyard or Bust

481637.description: 5 of a Kind is a shedding game with a deckbuilding twist. Each turn, you have a choice: Will you beat the active poker hand, or pass to augment your deck with better cards? You get a VP chip each time you run through your entire deck. So, are you fighting over the pot, or going all-in on dropping straight flushes every turn? The game ends when there are no more VP chips left in the supply (triggered by players shuffling up their decks). —description from the publisher
481637.name: 5 of a Kind

481658.name: 砂時計は裏返す (Flip the Hourglass)

481680.name: SNOOKER 147: The Ultimate Snooker Strategy Game

481709.description: Miai is a climbing/shedding game for two players with very simple, agonizing choices at nearly every turn. "Miai" is a Japanese term used by Go players that means "equivalence," and the focus of this game is around the balance of trying to win tricks, shed out first, and still have more captured points than your opponent. Players have three choices each turn: Beat, Swap, or Pass. When a player beats the meld on the table by playing a better one, they add the beaten meld to their score pile. A player could also Swap by scoring one card from the current meld and adding one from their hand that…
481709.name: Miai

481743.name: Pig Pick Trick
publishers: Bodoge Radio Kenkyukai(BoardGame Radio Study Group)

481884.name: Cosmo Chauffeur
publishers: 卸売センターサンエイ (Oroshiuri Sentaa San'ei)

481886.description: An unexpected disaster has thrown your spaceship into chaos, and the galaxy's most important passengers need to escape! Team up with fellow VIPs and other aliens to find your way out before everyone else. But with limited opportunities and a ship full of desperate passengers, making your escape might require some clever maneuvering. Escape to Cosmo is a ladder climbing and shedding game in which players race to empty their hands without being allowed to rearrange their cards. Players can play consecutive groups of matching ranks, two equal groups of matching ranks, or runs of five or six…
481886.name: Escape to Cosmo
publishers: 卸売センターサンエイ (Oroshiuri Sentaa San'ei)

481888.description: As daylight fades and darkness approaches, the balance between the sun, the moon, and the horizon begins to shift. Every move changes the landscape, and every card brings a new opportunity to reshape the fading light. In this contest of timing and anticipation, knowing when to rise and when to fall is the key to staying ahead. Duskline is a card shedding and hand management game in which players compete to play their cards or force others to run out of options. Each turn, players must play cards higher or lower than the current card, depending on whether the active direction is UP or DOWN.…
481888.name: Duskline
publishers: 篠原遊戯重工 (Shinohara Yugi Juko)

481895.description: Year 2XXX. A meteor strike pushed humanity to the brink, and the space programs of the old world were lost with it. A century later, civilization has recovered, and a new generation of scientists has begun building exploration ships from the relics their predecessors left behind. The space race has started again. In Minimum Journey, you are an astronaut in charge of your nation's exploration ship. Each round, all players secretly and simultaneously choose to Draw or Stop. Drawing flips the top card of your deck and adds its exploration power to your ship, but be careful: if you are the only…
481895.name: Minimum Journey

481898.description: The orders are piling up, and the delivery rush is in full swing! From morning donuts to late night pizza, hungry customers across the city are waiting for their food. Every delivery brings new demands, unexpected changes, and increasingly frantic orders. Keep up with the rush, adapt to the chaos, and be the first to finish your deliveries! Delivery Rush is a card shedding game in which players race to empty their hands by matching one of three attributes on the current card: time of day, delivery area, or food type. Matching two attributes triggers a Rush, allowing the player to immediately…
481898.name: Delivery Rush

481914.name: モノクロオーバータイム (Monochrome Overtime)
publishers: スタジオカヤノナカ (Studio Kaya no Naka)

481942.name: Jingle Bell Roll: Tricks & Treats Promo

481944.description: Peelin is a shedding game for two. You may never rearrange your hand. You lead only from its left or right side, but you may beat with cards from anywhere. The Queens are the strongest cards, but a Queen must reach a side before you can play it. When you pass, you may pick a card from your opponent's combination and put it anywhere into your hand. Before play, both players secretly stake one card on going out. A Queen is a big bet but leaves your hand weaker. A 0 is a safe bet and takes a weak card out of your hand. When a player goes out, they score points for every card left in their…
481944.name: Peelin

designers: Suzuki Takayuki (鈴木 タカユキ)
482066.name: カンフートリテ (Kung Fu Trick)

482187.description: Magical Animal Rush is a climbing and shedding card game for 2–7 players. Most cards have two different ranks, and whenever you play one, you choose which rank to use. Combine cards that share a declared rank into a set and try to beat the current play. Under the standard rules, when you beat another player's play, you may take one card from it and add it to your hand. This means that every play can change not only what leaves your hand, but also what options become available for later turns. The first player to empty their hand finishes first, followed by the remaining players in order.…
482187.name: Magical Animal Rush

482270.name: Sightholder
publishers: シュレディンガーゲームズ (Schrodinger Games)

482285.description: Relive the epic battles of Encantadia as you lead your Sang'gre and their armies in this area control card game for 2-4 players. In Encantadia Chronicles: Sang'gre War of Gems, each player will control a kingdom from Encantadia: Lireo, Hathoria, Sapiro, and Adamya. Shuffle the location cards and then deal an amount based on the number of players on the center table. These will be the Locations you will fight for during the game. Everyone then takes their Sang'gre and corresponding decks, as well as their Brilyante card and charges, and places it in front of them. Shuffle the Kingdom decks and…
482285.name: Encantadia Chronicles Sang'gre: War of Gems

482287.name: 配る手見る目 (Eyes Watching the Hand as it Deals)

482288.description: Welcome to a peculiar world of abundance, where having more is not always a good thing! In this playful variation of the classic Japanese card game Daifugō, numbers accumulate, combinations grow, and the cards you thought you had gotten rid of might find their way back into your hand. Staying ahead requires more than simply playing your strongest cards, especially when an unexpected twist can turn a promising position into a troublesome one. Kajitsu Tobu (Flying Fruit) is a ladder climbing and hand shedding card game inspired by the Japanese classic Daifugō, featuring a persistent central…
482288.name: 果実飛ぶ (Kajitsu Tobu)

482289.name: Buccaneers' Code
publishers: あーきっと.ゲームズ (Archit Games)

482317.description: Scurvy! is the first ever trick-taking deck builder. You take on the role of pirates setting out on a series of three voyages in search of treasure and citrus. Return to Tortuga to hire new crew members, purchase items for your ship including citrus reserves (you can never have too much citrus), or even increase the number of crew that can sail with you to each island increasing your chance at taking even more tricks. But beware, the threat of Scurvy! and other pirates aren't the only dangers lurking across the high seas. The islands may have active event cards for better or worse and they…
482317.name: Scurvy!

482368.description: Welcome to Witchling Academia, a prestigious magical school where aspiring witches from around the world gather to master the seven schools of magic. Today is their long awaited promotion exam, and each apprentice must demonstrate her magical abilities to advance toward becoming a fully fledged witch. But failing the exam twice means losing the chance for promotion, so every spell counts! Witchling Academia is a ladder climbing and hand shedding card game in which players compete to empty their hands by playing increasingly powerful combinations of spells. Cards may be played individually or…
482368.name: Witchling Academia

482394.name: Artsy Hype: The Trader Mini Expansion

482395.name: Gods of Egypt: Judgment Seat Mini Expansion

482544.description: A rule-building card game based on Big Two, where players create, use, and manipulate rules to gain an advantage over their opponents. Players must adapt to changing rules each round, making strategic decisions about how to play their cards and how to outwit their opponents. Winning isn't just about having the strongest cards — it's about understanding and exploiting the rules of the game. The game includes 59 player cards (five suits of cards numbered 3 through King, plus four Jokers), 18 Rule Craft cards, and one King Token. The Rule Craft cards include three basic rules — Revolution,…
designers: Akihiko Toyama (トオヤマアキヒコ)
482544.name: ど平民 (An Utter Commoner)

482565.description: The Return of the King Trick-Taking Game is a cooperative card game for 1 to 4 players that takes you through the conclusion of J.R.R. Tolkien’s classic story over the course of 20 chapters. This game is a continuation of The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring – Trick-Taking Game and The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers – Trick-Taking Game but is playable on its own. (Chapters 1 through 36 can be found in the previous games.) Based on the epic conclusion to J.R.R. Tolkien’s legendary tale, The Return of the King Trick-Taking Game brings players to the climactic final chapters of…
482565.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King – Trick-Taking Game

482616.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King – Trick-Taking Game: Deathless & Eldest

482641.description: Gloomy Bear Dead Giveaway: The Card Game is a darkly funny push-your-luck card game where players pass an ever-growing hand around the table, trying to avoid making a pair before the gift turns deadly. It is a fast, interactive card game where players secretly add cards to a shared hand and pass it around the table, bluffing that it’s safe. If a pair appears, the hand becomes deadly and someone takes the penalty. Easy to learn, quick to play, and full of tension and laughs. The first player draws one card from the deck, looks at it but keeps it secret from the other players, and adds one card…
482641.name: Gloomy Bear Dead Giveaway: The Card Game

482700.description: Dealing Damage is a ladder climbing, card shedding battle game for two players, with the goal of depleting your enemy’s health bar to zero. Thematically, each meld played is an attack or blow dealt by one of the kaiju. Playing a Successful Climb implies that the sparring continues and hits are being matched blow for blow. Playing a weaker meld, an Unsuccessful Block, implies the previous meld played by the player before you hit you hard and you couldn’t keep up!
482700.name: Dealing Damage

482816.name: Hero Slam: Curse of Cat Demon!

483087.description: Las Ligas de la Ñ: El fuego de las Bernardas ("The Ñ Leagues: The Fire of the Bernardas") is a card game of challenges, social interaction, and culture, designed for 1 to 12 players and set in the universe of Las Ligas de la Ñ. Inspired by the symbolic confrontation between Bernarda Alba, a character created by Federico García Lorca, and Bernarda X, a figure derived from a famous Spanish popular saying, the game presents an entertaining clash between two opposing views of morality, social conventions, and individual freedom, in which fire represents both repression and rebellion. In this new…
483087.name: Las Ligas de la Ñ: El fuego de las Bernardas

483112.description: Counting sheep to fall asleep? No way! Here, the goal is to stay awake! Carefully assess the cards in your hand, place bets, play strategically, and bluff when it’s worth it. If you make exact predictions, you’ll earn plenty of extra points — but if you bet too high, you’ll walk away empty-handed. It takes good timing and just the right amount of risk-taking. The goal is to score the most points by managing your hand and betting as closely as possible to the amount of cards on the table at the end of each round. The game ends after 4 rounds. The player with the most points wins! -description…
483112.name: One More

483166.description: BANANOVA is a deck-building trick-taking game. Players are monkey assistants working in a laboratory, carrying out experiments to create a brand-new banana energy from bananas. Each round consists of eight tricks. At the start of the round, players predict how many experiments (tricks) they will succeed in. Succeeding in experiments earns points and research notes. At the end of the round, players buy new research cards and add them to their decks. With each purchase, players gain more kinds of cards, and their decks grow steadily stronger. Buying cards also advances markers on tracks, with…
designers: Takanari Yamaguchi (ヤマグチ タカナリ)
483166.name: BANANOVA

483184.name: Icecread よくばりトッピング (Icecread: Greed Toppings)

483185.description: Deep beneath the waves lives Hugo, a carefree shark with a rather unusual feature: a head shaped like a die! Despite their easygoing appearance, Hugo and the other sea creatures are fiercely territorial, constantly fighting over the best spots in the ocean. Players command these underwater rivals in a chaotic struggle for valuable territory, where strength can change with a single roll of the dice. Even the strongest creature can suddenly find itself outmatched, and a well-timed mutation might turn the tide of the entire battle. Dice Hugo is a shedding game in which 2 to 6 players compete to…
483185.name: Dice Hugo

483195.description: Inside Direct Company, the company behind the wildly popular video-sharing platform Direct, a fierce competition is taking place among its video directors. Every day brings a flood of new content to publish, but what audiences want is constantly changing. A video that's trending today might be forgotten tomorrow, and knowing which content deserves priority can make all the difference. By monitoring trends, adjusting their strategies, and outmaneuvering their colleagues, directors race to publish their videos and claim the company's Outstanding Performance Award. Direct Company is a…
483195.name: Direct Company

483305.name: KPop Demon Hunters: Derpy Tiger Delivery Game

483434.description: Green Fairy Frenzy is a card game of bluffing, hidden information, and memory for 2 to 5 players. Each player is a smuggler trying to move absinthe from Canada into the United States and sell it to the Fence, while steering rivals into trouble with the Law and the Fence. Each round is a single border crossing. All players and bags start in Canada. Players are dealt four cards, keep two in hand, and place two face down as a starting bag. Bags belong to no one. On a turn, a player must take exactly one action and may not pass. In Canada, a player can pick up a bag, pack cards from hand into one…
483434.name: Green Fairy Frenzy

483454.description: A competitive card game for 2–4 players using a standard deck. The objective of 'Rivalry' is to have the highest scoring kingdom by the end of the game. Your kingdom includes all the cards placed face up in front of you.You build your Kingdom by adding cards from your hand, gambling for better cards, and taking cards from your opponents through stealing and plundering. The player with the highest Kingdom score at the end wins. Setup Use a standard 54-card deck, including both Jokers.Each player receives five starting cards: One ace, one seven, one jack, one queen, one king.The cards in your…
483454.name: Rivalry

483520.description: Gatuperio is a trick-taking betting game with cat theme. Each round, you must bet on how many fish you’ll catch while playing your cats to make your opponents miss their bets. The winner isn’t the player who catches the most fish, but the one who scores the most points by correctly predicting their catches. Test your cunning and animal instincts, and claim your place as the leader cat! —description from the publisher (English) Gatuperio es un juego de apuesta de bazas con temática de gatos. En cada ronda deberás apostar cuántos pescados vas a conseguir y jugar bien tus gatos mientras intentas…
483520.name: Gatuperio

483580.description: Every story has a legend. Now they meet face to face. Lore Wars is a fast head-to-head card duel between legendary characters. Every turn is a gamble. Flip cards one at a time to build up what you can spend, then use your character’s powers to strike, block, heal and outsmart your opponents. One more flip could pay for your biggest move, or it could turn up an impact card and wreck your turn. Wear down your opponent’s life track and bring their character to zero to win. No two characters play alike. Some play it safe, some push their luck and some just hit hard. Find the one that fits the way…
483580.name: Lore Wars

483597.description: Würfelkönig Pocket is a clever dice game in which players compete to recruit the most valuable followers for their kingdom. Each round, players roll dice up to three times, trying to fulfill the requirements shown on available cards. The goal is to collect valuable followers while avoiding troublesome rogues and dangerous dragons. Special cards provide unique advantages and can help players improve their chances at key moments. Choosing which cards to pursue and deciding which dice to reroll requires careful planning, risk management, and a bit of luck. At the end of the game, the player with…
483597.name: Wülfelkönig Pocket

483598.description: Across the globe, lighting a candle has been intertwined with light and wishes, and the evolution of humanity within. There is something special when lighting a candle: watching the flame dancing while holding a wish in silence and entrusting our deepest longings to life itself. Ask and it shall be given to you. In this push your luck game you will be playing your wishes and your main objective is to make them come true by gaining intention points. Roll dice through your night board. Manifest your wishes and shift the energy of the night. Share this moment with your family and friends as you…
483598.name: Candlelight Wishes

483622.description: Flip over cards one by one without flipping the same number twice. Sound easy? Think again! This isn't just any deck of cards… In Flip 7 there's only one 1 card, two 2's, three 3’s, etc plus a bunch of special cards that can score you extra points, give you a second chance, or freeze you or your opponents in your tracks. Are you the type of player to play it safe and bank points before you bust, or are you going to risk it all and go for the bonus points by flipping over seven in a row? Press your luck meets strategy in this addictive card game that's sure to be the greatest card game you’ve…
483622.name: Flip 7: Hello Kitty and Friends

483657.description: The northern winter has fallen, and the encroaching Shadow threatens to swallow the night sky. Only the ancient animal spirits of the North can rekindle the fading lights before darkness becomes absolute. Dancing Lights is a cooperative, hand-management,and survival card game for 1 to 6 players (with dedicated solo rules). Players work together as celestial guardians gathering sacred offerings to awaken northern spirits and protect the aurora borealis. Setup & The Skyline At the center of the table lies the Skyline —a 4×3 grid of 12 lenticular Aurora cards. Cards begin on their bright,…
483657.name: Dancing Lights

483658.description: Talaia — Balearic Islands, 18th century. Barbary corsairs from Algiers, Tunis and Tripoli prowl the coasts of Mallorca, Menorca, Ibiza and Formentera. Along the shore, watchtowers called talaies keep guard, ready to send up smoke by day and fire by night. Meanwhile, merchants trade the islands’ goods: olive oil, cheese, salt and dried fish. Their prices rise and fall with every ship that makes it, or fails to make it, to port. Talaia is a trick-taking game for 3–5 players with no trump suit in the deck. Each island is a suit, with cards from 1 to 12 that follow its production chain, from raw…
483658.name: Talaia

483744.description: Golem Run: Raising the Stakes is an expansion for Golem Run. Raising the Stakes expansion adds two new features to the game: - Team play with 4 team cards - 4 Personality cards for the Golems
483744.name: Golem Run: Raising the Stakes

483795.description: Litter Box is a card game for 2-4 players that packs three fast, chaotic games into one tiny box, all played with the same deck. Each card shows a cat (Loopy Loo, Miss Hissy, Hangry Tom, or Honey Hairball), a treat (Mouse, Fish Bones, Birdy, or Tuna Can), and a color (red, green, blue, or purple). Hangry Tom Says You Ain't Got Squat (15 min) is a shedding game. Deal 8 cards each and flip one to start the litter box. Play a card that matches the top litter-box card in two of its three attributes, and keep playing as long as you can match. If you can't match at the start of your turn, flip a…
483795.name: Litter Box

483837.description: The Tournament of the Enchanted Kingdoms is a competitive, tactical trick-taking game for 3 to 5 players. Step into the Enchanted Kingdoms, where knights brandish their swords, queens weave their intrigues, kings impose their laws, and sorcerers whisper forgotten spells. In this tournament, cunning is often worth as much as the blade! Each trick is an ordeal, each card a treasure or a danger. To triumph, players must win specific tricks to fulfill hidden or public Objectives and score points. You can increase the challenge by adding modular expansions included in the files : Danger Mode:…
483837.name: The Tournament of the Enchanted Kingdoms

483877.description: “Go on, there’s room for one more.” Would you trust the person who just said that? A new vehicle pulls up each round, and everyone secretly picks a card. Load one or two to earn coins, play zero if you think the others will overload it, or pass to pocket your pay and sit out the rest of the round. Hit the weight limit exactly and there’s a bonus. Go over and someone’s hard-earned coins are on the line. You can always ask what everyone plans to play. You might even get an honest answer. Whoever clocks out with the most coins wins.
483877.name: Load Up!

483958.description: Combo Panic is a fast-paced, exciting card game for 2–5 players that combines push-your-luck mechanics, strategic decisions, and clever card combinations! Will you play it safe or take the risk of revealing another card? The more cards you reveal, the better your chances of building the perfect combo. But watch out! Reveal two cards of the same color and you'll enter PANIC, earning yourself a penalty! Over eight action-packed rounds, everyone plays simultaneously, choosing cards and placing them strategically on their boards to score as many points as possible. Every decision matters, and…
483958.name: Combo Panic

483984.description: You are one of the magistrates governing Oct City, a city where eight different races live together. A magistrate's greatest responsibility is deciding which races to welcome into the city. In other words, you must manage the balance of power between the races. This balance of power is influenced not only by the individual strength of each race but also by the strength of their numbers. If you give even more power to an already powerful race, you will lose credibility as the magistrate who supported them. However, regardless of their race, those you have helped will remember your kindness.…
483984.name: OCTRICK

484055.name: Jingle Bell Roll: Tricks & Treats Promo

484109.description: Dino Wars (published by Friendly Games) is a tactical trick-taking card game with a retro aesthetic where your hand cards double as your life points. Once a year, usually peaceful dinosaurs enter an arena to determine who is the strongest, battling until only one dinosaur remains standing. Quick Facts • Players. 2 to 4 players (works very well as a two-player duel). • Age & Playtime. Ages 8 and up, taking about 15 to 30 minutes per game. How It Works • Character Selection. Each player chooses one of four unique dinosaur characters (such as the Triceratops), each featuring individual starting…
484109.name: Dino Wars

484142.description: TerraClash Skirmish is a fast card game set in the world of TerraClash. If you know Shed (also called Karma or Palace), you already know how it works, with a few twists from Terra. Each player has a hand, three face-up Guardians and three face-down Vault cards. On your turn you play a creature that matches or beats the rank on top of the Battle Pile, and two or three of the same creature can go down together. If you can't play, you pick up the whole pile. Draw back up to three while the Library lasts. Items and spells can be played on anything: Fireball burns the pile out of the game, Panacea…
484142.name: TerraClash Skirmish

484212.description: In a dimly lit corner of The Siren’s Call tavern, pirates, rogues and sellswords eye your cards; theirs to be won if they are as cunning as they would have you believe! You raise the stakes, willing anyone to challenge your bid, and a hush falls over the table. Inspired by Liar's Dice, Dead Man’s Bluff is a game of pushing your luck when the odds are in your favour and bluffing when they aren’t! Played over several rounds, the winner of each round takes their opponent’s cards as the spoils for a lie well told, or a truth well kept. Bluff your way into winning the most cards off the other…
484212.name: Dead Man's Bluff

484247.description: A traditional Luxembourgish game for four players in partnerships, played with a standard 52-card French pack. It features the earliest known use of Bright-calling as also found in Luxembourgish Tarock, which appears to have arisen later and overtaken this game in popularity. From the notes of the player who first introduced this game to the English-speaking world: "I was able to speak with one tarock player who recalled Blénkeg from her childhood, when some local tournament matches were still played. She described the game to me as she remembered it; however, it is likely that many localized…
484247.name: Blénkeg

484248.description: Luxembourg’s national tarock, blending French Tarot and Central European tarock traditions. A unique tarock for either three players playing alone or four players in fixed partnerships. The seven Honours (Éieren) and four Bright (Blénkeg) rank cards drive trick play each hand. The three-player game has no initial bidding or declarations at all, so everything revolves around the card play. A small menu of feats can override the usual card point counting, and Brights act as strict scoring gates. The four-player game features a subtle bidding round in which partners and opponents communicate and…
484248.name: Luxembourgish Tarock

484262.description: The circus is hiring, and you’re not the only juggler after the job. There’s no time for individual auditions or to get props in order, so you’ll all have to perform together. Out-throw the competition to win over the judges! On a turn, play one or more adjacent cards from one of your two ordered hands as a single, a set of matching ranks, or a run of consecutive ranks. If a throw is in play, your throw must beat it: more cards beat fewer, a set beats a run of equal length, and the higher card breaks ties. The player who beats a throw collects it in their score pile. When a throw is in play,…
484262.name: Juggling Act

484299.description: Across 5 frantic rounds, players compete to build the biggest tabloid bankroll by photographing four elusive cryptids—Yeti, Mothboy, Nessie, and Derpicorn—whose market values fluctuate wildly with every card flipped: Chant & Slap: Each turn, players chant "Ready... Yeti... SHOOT!" and simultaneously decide whether to Stay In (slap their dry-erase camera card) or Cash Out (keep hands off). Volatile Market: Flipped photo cards raise—or tank—specific cryptid payouts, while Camera Malfunctions delete existing shots and Breaking News cards flip News Van tokens. Exclusive Shot Bonus: Bail out alone…
484299.name: Ready Yeti Shoot

484324.description: There is a fox among the chicken! Every player is dealt an identity card. All are chicken except for one fox. Each player must reveal one piece of information, and they must be truthful in what they share. They can either share whether they are a chicken of a particular value, or they are not a chicken of a particular value. However there is one poisoned chicken who can claim to be a chicken of any value. After information is shared, there is a fox finding stage and a chicken hunting stage, in which players try to score points. First, the chicken players try to guess who the fox is. Correct…
484324.name: Heynard Hunt

484342.description: Mata Ratas is a fun family card game where you'll have to collect cheese, take risks, avoid traps and keep a close eye on what's happening at the table. But watch out! When the Mata Ratas card appears, you'll need quick reflexes to slap your hand onto the pile before the other players. Can you collect more cheese than your rivals? —description from the designer Mata Ratas es un divertido juego de cartas familiar en el que tendrás que conseguir queso, asumir riesgos, esquivar trampas y estar muy atento a lo que ocurre en la mesa. ¡Pero cuidado! Cuando aparezca la carta Mata Ratas, tendrás que…
484342.name: Mata Ratas

484424.description: DLTLLY × Ey yo! is the official card game of the German battle rap league Don’t Let The Label Label You (DLTLLY). The game principle is based on the mechanics of Top Trumps and comes with 5 different variants. Players use their battle MCs to compete against each other in categories such as punchlines, flow, and rhymes. They also try to play rappers with specific skills that are currently in demand to excite the crowd. Action cards shake up the battle and, for example, change the category or add skill points to your MC. Each player has the same set of action cards and has to use them…
484424.name: DLTLLY × Ey yo!

484440.name: Zoo King: America 250 Promo Card Pack

484445.description: Gruvfrun is the spirit of the mountain. Every miner knows to treat her with respect. Knock before you enter so she knows that you are coming. Don’t swear and don’t whistle. Perhaps then you will emerge from the mine with the most valuable ore. Players take turns mining ore by flipping cards over in a 4 by 4 tableau. If you find cards with the same ore, collect them for points. Otherwise shuffle a row or column. Beware of Gruvfrun! She can never be collected. —description from the designer
484445.name: Gruvfrun

5105.description: Null Bock is the game of deer mating rituals. Cards include Bucks and Does which are played to a central "arena" or to peripheral areas by each player. Those in the center must constantly better the previous buck or doe, while there are separate rules for the periphery. Points are scored by collecting doe cards. The "null bock" (zero buck) is too cool to fight and has special abilities to overcome the strongest buck.
5105.name: Null Bock!

53168.description: In ripis Rubiconis passus militis bellum civile fert et movet cursum eventorum e quibus imperator surget. Quomodo dominabis proelia quae in agro, in senatu, et per vias Romae accident? On the banks of the Rubicon a legionnaire’s footstep brings Civil War and sets upon a course of events from which an emperor will emerge. How will you master the battles that are to come on the field, in the senate and through the streets of Rome? Triumvirate is a fast-paced game for two that requires subtle hand management and card play to win consistently. The mechanisms in the core rules make for a very…
53168.name: Triumvirate

54152.name: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?

54307.description: Box blurb translated from Japanese: An irregular trick taking game where various individual abilities of persons forming history are tangled together. Who will use their powers to adequately handle the events of the lands? Who will leave their name behind in The Chronicle? This is the 2009 release from Kanai Factory. Recommended suggestions for beginners from the designer Seiji Kanai: Play with 3 or 4 players. 5 or 6 players make the game more difficult to control. Until you are familiar with all the cards effects, remove the following History cards from the game: "Dark age" (have evil…
54307.name: Chronicle

5451.description: Hanafuda cards originated in beginning of 18th-century Japan. Legend says stewards of Edo Shogunate created it from Portuguese playing cards. A deck consists of forty-eight cards divided into twelve suits of four cards each. Each suit represents one of the twelve months of the year or individual plants (almost all flowers). The cards are small (about 1 x 2 inches), made from stiff cardboard, and are beautifully illustrated. Many different games can be played with a Hanafuda deck. The standard game was Hachi-Hachi (Eighty-eight), which resembles the Western game Casino, but is more complicated…
5451.name: Hanafuda

5910.name: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi – The Play-for-Power Card Games

619.description: In this trick-taking game based on the short story by Robert Louis Stevenson of the same name, the goal is to gain the most points over a series of hands (usually the goal is set to 200 pts). Cards are numbered 1-37 and are found in three colors, red (comprising largely the highest numbers), blue (mostly in the middle) and yellow (mostly the lowest numbers) with colors being analogous to the suit in a standard deck. There is one neutral card, the 19, that sets the "price of the bottle." The entire deck is dealt to the three or four players in the game and then, similarly to hearts, cards are…
619.name: The Bottle Imp

64244.description: You and your opponent lead rival caravans across the vast eastern desert, carrying goods between Jacynth and the Valley. Between the sand and the bandits, you just want to be done with it. The goal of the game is to score points, which you can do by collecting cards during the hand and by being the first player to lay down your last cards. Which suits are bonuses or penalties changes from hand to hand. Each hand is played as a series of trade seasons, and the score is tallied up at the end of each hand. The game is inspired by Haggis and other climbing games.
64244.name: Caravan

6887.description: Hearts is a trick taking, standard deck playing card game, without trumps, which has been played popularly for generations and has many variations. The object is to avoid capturing hearts at one (1) point apiece and (in the most commonly played version today) the queen of spades, at thirteen (13) points, the card on which the whole game pivots. But to make it interesting, it is also possible to "shoot the moon," taking all the hearts and the queen, a coup that gives 26 points to each of your opponents instead!
6887.name: Hearts

6901.description: Euchre is a trick taking card game. Although for two to seven players, Euchre is best with four playing as partners. This is a relatively simple bidding and trick-taking game, and one of the best non-threatening partnership games. Conventional Euchre uses a deck of 24 standard playing cards consisting of A, K, Q, J, 10, and 9 of each of the four suits. A standard deck 52-card deck can be used, omitting the cards from 2 to 8. Players are dealt a five-card hand and the object is to win three of the five tricks. A card is turned up to determine trump, which can be either accepted or refused by…
6901.name: Euchre

76447.description: Today is your last day on the job. Corporate decided to close the store and everybody is getting the boot. You could spend the rest of the day helping those miserable, wretched wastes of human skin who come in and demand service, or you could do what you always wanted - tell them were to go and have a good time. And you know which one it’s going to be... From the instructions. In Severance each player assumes the role of one the characters at the store. They can steal items from the store, slack off, or keep performing their work duties. Each activity has risks and rewards. The player scores…
76447.name: Five Fingered Severance

81250.description: Stich-Meister is a trick-taking game in which the players alter the rules before each round of play. The game consists of two decks of cards: One deck of 60 cards with four suits of cards numbered 1 to 15, and one deck of 60 rule cards. Each player has three rule cards, and at the start of a round, each player plays one of these cards. The rule cards played determine the rules for that round. There are three types of rule cards: Trump cards, which determine the trump suit; Scoring cards, which determine how many points a trick is worth; Basic rule cards, which affect the way cards may be…
81250.name: Stich-Meister

8129.description: The gameplay for Sluff Off! follows the standard trick-taking formula: The cards are numbered 1-15 in five different suits, and blue is always trump. If someone leads a color, you must follow suit if you can; otherwise, you can throw off a card or trump the trick. It's an exact-bidding game, but you predict your tricks by taking colored chips. For each trick that you win, you toss a chip back. If you take a trick in a color for which you didn't have a chip, then you must take a black chip (worth -3 points). If you have any colored chips left at the end of the round, they're worth -2 points.…
8129.name: Sluff Off!

87732.description: A climbing game played with a standard 52 card deck primarily meant for three players, (though there is a four player variant). It is similar to "Fight the Landlord" (Dou Di Zhu) but with some noticeable differences - the biggest being that the 3 (not the 2) is the high card, but also in the number of cards in the pot and allowable plays. Because the runs are relatively limited (4 through K only) and because there are no "bombs" it is a bit more predictable in its gameplay than Dou Di Zhu. Each round starts with dealing the cards (except for four of them) and an auction for the remaining…
87732.name: Big Three

94389.description: For eons, Incubi (bad, negative dreams) and Sognae (happy, positive dreams) have dwelled in Equilibrion, opposed but complementary. As the king of this City, you must establish and maintain the delicate balance between those dreams: place them in the various districts, harness their power, and beware of the Chaos – fearsome entities that thrive on discord and hatred. Urbion is a solo/cooperative card game: You (and your partner) must work (together) against the game and claim all the cards from the City deck before the Dream deck runs out! Victory is achieved by balancing the twelve City…
94389.name: Urbion

96556.description: From website: Agent Saboteur is a face-paced card game full of bluffing and sabotage, where you command a team of international spies trying to stop the terrorists and build your reputation in the process. One of the great things about this game is that no one sits on the sidelines and waits for the other players to get done. For the casual gamer, Agent Saboteur is easy to teach, fun to play, and will quickly become the game you play most often. For the hobby gamer, it will become the go-to game you get out when friends or family stop by. The Story: “Welcome, handler XXXXXXXXXX. Your…
96556.name: Agent Saboteur

98315.name: The Adventurers: The Pyramid of Horus

99945.description: A super variation on the popular card game "President" (See also "Scum: The Food Chain Game "). Your goal is to become the Big Boss, replacing bigger face-up cards on the table with value from 1 to 13. Special cards added to the challenge. They will either help you or hurt you!
99945.name: Big Boss
